blanks.en: Do I need a card to enter the building?
blanks.zh: 我进这栋楼需要门卡吗？

blanks.en: Yes, you'll get your card this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 需要，你今天下午就会拿到门卡。

blanks.en: Now let me show you around and say hello to everyone, and then we'll talk about your job duties.
blanks.zh: 现在我带你四处看看，和大家打个招呼，然后我们再谈你的岗位职责。

blanks.en: Would you like some more roast beef?
blanks.zh: 你想再来一点烤牛肉吗？

blanks.en: It's the chef's signature dish.
blanks.zh: 这是主厨的招牌菜。

blanks.en: But I can't manage any more.
blanks.zh: 但我实在吃不下更多了。

blanks.en: Hey, look at this one in the newspaper.
blanks.zh: 嘿，看看报纸上的这一张。

blanks.en: Fishermen fishing in Lake Victoria in Tanzania.
blanks.zh: 渔民在坦桑尼亚的维多利亚湖捕鱼。

blanks.en: I like the unique atmosphere caught by the photographer.
blanks.zh: 我喜欢摄影师捕捉到的那种独特氛围。

blanks.en: It's almost midnight, Max.
blanks.zh: 马克斯，快到午夜了。

blanks.en: You've got a long drive tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 你明天还得开很长时间的车。

blanks.en: Another fifteen minutes from my travel blog, and I'll be done.
blanks.zh: 再给我十五分钟写旅行博客，我就写完了。

blanks.en: This is Sarah Jones.
blanks.zh: 我是萨拉·琼斯。

blanks.en: I'm stuck on the highway.
blanks.zh: 我堵在高速公路上了。

blanks.en: There's a serious accident.
blanks.zh: 这里发生了一起严重的事故。

blanks.en: I'm afraid I can't arrive before noon.
blanks.zh: 恐怕我中午之前赶不到了。

blanks.en: I'll see my doctor at one and will be available after two.
blanks.zh: 我一点要去看医生，两点以后有空。

blanks.en: It has everything big cities offer—cafes, theaters, museums—but it is still relaxing and manageable.
blanks.zh: 大城市有的东西这里都有，比如咖啡馆、剧院、博物馆，但这里依然让人放松，生活也容易安排。

blanks.en: Unlike London, you don't feel constant pressure here.
blanks.zh: 和伦敦不同，在这里你不会总感到有压力。

blanks.en: Was this lifestyle why you first came?
blanks.zh: 你最初是因为这种生活方式才来这里的吗？

blanks.en: I originally came for a three-month project at a law firm.
blanks.zh: 我最初是来一家律师事务所做一个为期三个月的项目的。

blanks.en: After finishing it, they offered me a permanent job.
blanks.zh: 项目完成后，他们给了我一份长期工作。

blanks.en: I took it and stayed.
blanks.zh: 我接受了这份工作，就留了下来。

blanks.en: Garden Hotel, may I help you?
blanks.zh: 这里是花园酒店，请问有什么可以帮您？

blanks.en: This is Mike Lee from Gilbert Company.
blanks.zh: 我是吉尔伯特公司的迈克·李。

blanks.en: We'd like to book a dinner for next Tuesday.
blanks.zh: 我们想预订下周二的晚宴。

blanks.en: Could you let me know how many guests you're expecting and if you have a specific budget in mind?
blanks.zh: 您能告诉我预计会来多少位客人，以及心里有没有具体的预算吗？

blanks.en: Yes, we're expecting twenty people, and we're aiming for thirty pounds per person.
blanks.zh: 有的，预计二十人，每人的预算是三十英镑。

blanks.en: Is this for a special occasion?
blanks.zh: 这是为了庆祝什么特别的事情吗？

blanks.en: It's to honor a staff member who is retiring next month.
blanks.zh: 是为了向一位下个月退休的员工表示敬意。

blanks.en: What time would you like the dinner to start?
blanks.zh: 您希望晚宴几点开始？

blanks.en: At six thirty p.m.
blanks.zh: 下午六点半。

blanks.en: Would you like a detailed menu with prices?
blanks.zh: 您需要一份附有价格的详细菜单吗？

blanks.en: Could you email it to Mike Lee at gilbert dot com?
blanks.zh: 能请您发邮件到mikelee@gilbert.com吗？

blanks.en: Dear listeners, the song we've just heard was made with an AI version of Jenny's singing voice.
blanks.zh: 亲爱的听众，刚才我们听到的那首歌，是用珍妮歌声的人工智能版本制作的。

blanks.en: Earlier this year, Jenny announced that she'd let anybody make a song using her AI voice, as long as they were entitled and shared their profits with her.
blanks.zh: 今年早些时候，珍妮宣布，只要获得授权并与她分享收益，任何人都可以用她的人工智能声音制作歌曲。

blanks.en: And in just a few weeks, more than three hundred new songs were created using her AI voice.
blanks.zh: 仅仅几周时间，人们就用她的人工智能声音创作了三百多首新歌。

blanks.en: Incredible! Just imagine: Jenny may have been at home, drinking a glass of wine, while her AI clone voice worked hard to sing her songs.
blanks.zh: 太不可思议了！想象一下：珍妮当时可能在家喝着葡萄酒，而她的人工智能克隆声音却在努力替她唱歌。

blanks.en: This could be an attractive new business model for a pop star.
blanks.zh: 对于流行歌星来说，这可能是一种很有吸引力的新商业模式。

blanks.en: But some of our listeners called to say they want to hear Jenny's real voice.
blanks.zh: 但有些听众打电话来说，他们想听到珍妮真正的声音。

blanks.en: Now let's play one of her greatest hits, Show Me Your Love.
blanks.zh: 现在就来播放她最受欢迎的歌曲之一《向我表达你的爱》。

blanks.en: Dr. Evans, you just said that these ancient texts are actually the recipes from ancient Babylonia.
blanks.zh: 埃文斯博士，您刚才说，这些古代文献其实是来自古巴比伦的食谱。

blanks.en: Can you tell us more?
blanks.zh: 您能再多讲一些吗？

blanks.en: Ancient Babylonia is home to many of the things that we use in our cooking today.
blanks.zh: 我们今天烹饪所用的很多东西都起源于古巴比伦。

blanks.en: I bet about fifty per cent of the energy you need every day comes from vegetables or animals that originated in this area.
blanks.zh: 我敢说，你每天所需能量中大约百分之五十，都来自起源于这一地区的蔬菜或动物。

blanks.en: Why have these texts taken so long to come to light?
blanks.zh: 为什么这些文献过了这么久才为人所知？

blanks.en: These ancient texts have been known since the nineteen twenties, but were thought to be medical texts.
blanks.zh: 人们从二十世纪二十年代就知道这些古代文献的存在，但当时认为它们是医学文献。

blanks.en: In the nineteen forties Mary Hussey, an American scholar, suggested that they might be about food.
blanks.zh: 二十世纪四十年代，美国学者玛丽·赫西提出，这些文献可能与食物有关。

blanks.en: But people didn't believe her until French author Jean Bottéro in the nineteen eighties was asked to write an article about cooking in the past.
blanks.zh: 但人们一直不相信她，直到二十世纪八十年代，法国作家让·博泰罗受邀写一篇关于过去烹饪方式的文章。

blanks.en: He had heard about the texts, so he went to Yale University and found out that they were indeed about food.
blanks.zh: 他听说过这些文献，于是去了耶鲁大学，发现它们确实是关于食物的。

blanks.en: Before we begin today's experiment, let's review the lab rules.
blanks.zh: 开始今天的实验前，我们先复习一下实验室规定。

blanks.en: First, safety glasses must be worn at all times, even if you're only watching.
blanks.zh: 第一，必须始终戴着护目镜，即使你只是在旁边观看。

blanks.en: Second, never mix chemicals unless the instructions tell you to do so.
blanks.zh: 第二，除非操作说明要求这样做，否则绝不要混合化学品。

blanks.en: Today we're using a strong acid, which can cause serious burns if it touches your skin.
blanks.zh: 今天我们要用一种强酸，接触皮肤可能会造成严重灼伤。

blanks.en: If any chemical container is knocked over, don't panic.
blanks.zh: 如果任何化学品容器被碰倒了，不要惊慌。

blanks.en: Tell me immediately and I'll handle the cleanup.
blanks.zh: 立刻告诉我，我会来处理清理工作。

blanks.en: Also keep your hair tied back and avoid wearing loose clothes.
blanks.zh: 另外，要把头发扎到脑后，避免穿宽松的衣服。

blanks.en: We will work in pairs.
blanks.zh: 我们将两人一组进行实验。

blanks.en: One person will handle the tools while the other records the data.
blanks.zh: 一人操作工具，另一人记录数据。

blanks.en: Switch roles after every three trials to ensure everyone gets practice.
blanks.zh: 每完成三次试验就交换角色，确保每个人都能得到练习。

blanks.en: Remember, the goal is accurate data, not speed.
blanks.zh: 记住，目标是数据准确，而不是速度快。

blanks.en: If you finish early, do not start a new experiment.
blanks.zh: 如果提前做完，不要开始新的实验。

blanks.en: Instead, clean your workspace thoroughly.
blanks.zh: 应该把自己的工作区彻底清理干净。

blanks.en: Let's have a safe and productive class.
blanks.zh: 希望这节课安全而富有成效。

blanks.en: We're going to the park for a picnic.
blanks.zh: 我们要去公园野餐。

blanks.en: Would you like to come, Rose?
blanks.zh: 罗丝，你想一起来吗？

blanks.en: I'd love to, but I have to go downtown to get Kevin a birthday present.
blanks.zh: 我很想去，可我得去市中心给凯文买生日礼物。

blanks.en: He invited me to his party.
blanks.zh: 他邀请我参加他的聚会。

blanks.en: Larry, how is your swimming class going?
blanks.zh: 拉里，你的游泳课上得怎么样？

blanks.en: Well, believe it or not, we haven't touched the water so far.
blanks.zh: 说出来你也许不信，我们到现在还没碰过水呢。

blanks.en: It's just the same body-building exercises every day.
blanks.zh: 每天都只是在做同样的健身练习。

blanks.en: What's for dinner tonight?
blanks.zh: 今晚吃什么？

blanks.en: I remember we've got some carrots and potatoes left.
blanks.zh: 我记得我们还剩下一些胡萝卜和土豆。

blanks.en: You are always working in the office and at home.
blanks.zh: 无论在办公室还是在家里，你总是在工作。

blanks.en: You should go to parks or to theaters.
blanks.zh: 你应该去公园走走，或者去剧院看看演出。

blanks.en: I have no time for parks or theaters, honey.
blanks.zh: 亲爱的，我没时间去公园或剧院。

blanks.en: Do you know Helen and Judy in the IT department?
blanks.zh: 你认识信息技术部的海伦和朱迪吗？

blanks.en: We studied in the same university.
blanks.zh: 我们在同一所大学读过书。

blanks.en: Helen is lively and talkative, while Judy is just the opposite.
blanks.zh: 海伦活泼健谈，而朱迪恰恰相反。

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I've booked a ticket for June twenty-second to Swansea.
blanks.zh: 我订了一张六月二十二日去斯旺西的机票。

blanks.en: I'd like to see if there's an earlier flight available.
blanks.zh: 我想看看有没有更早的航班。

blanks.en: What date do you have in mind?
blanks.zh: 您想改到哪一天？

blanks.en: I'd prefer the eighteenth if possible.
blanks.zh: 如果可以的话，我更想十八日走。

blanks.en: There are no departures for the eighteenth.
blanks.zh: 十八日没有出发的航班。

blanks.en: We have a flight leaving on the fifteenth and the seventeenth.
blanks.zh: 十五日和十七日有航班。

blanks.en: Will either of these days work for you?
blanks.zh: 这两天中有哪一天适合您吗？

blanks.en: The seventeenth would work better for me.
blanks.zh: 十七日对我更合适。

blanks.en: You've just set a record in rock climbing.
blanks.zh: 你刚刚创造了一项攀岩纪录。

blanks.en: How do you feel now?
blanks.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样？

blanks.en: Honestly, I feel great.
blanks.zh: 说实话，我感觉棒极了。

blanks.en: It's exactly what I'd hoped for.
blanks.zh: 这正是我一直盼望的。

blanks.en: Tell us about your state of mind before you started.
blanks.zh: 给我们讲讲开始攀爬之前你的心态吧。

blanks.en: Well, my heart was racing for a few moments.
blanks.zh: 嗯，有一阵子我的心跳得特别快。

blanks.en: I mean, it's a huge wall above you, with a glass-smooth surface and no handholds.
blanks.zh: 你想想看，上方是一堵巨大的岩壁，表面光滑得像玻璃，连个可供手抓握的地方都没有。

blanks.en: Are you going to climb more today?
blanks.zh: 你今天还会继续攀爬吗？

blanks.en: But I'll do some strength training this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 不过，我今天下午会做些力量训练。

blanks.en: There'll be more challenges ahead.
blanks.zh: 前面还会有更多挑战。

blanks.en: How was your interview, Bob?
blanks.zh: 鲍勃，面试怎么样？

blanks.en: I didn't get the job.
blanks.zh: 我没得到那份工作。

blanks.en: I'm sorry to hear that.
blanks.zh: 听到这个消息我很遗憾。

blanks.en: I want to try something different.
blanks.zh: 我想试点不一样的事。

blanks.en: Maybe I don't have to work for someone else.
blanks.zh: 也许我不一定非得为别人工作。

blanks.en: What kind of business?
blanks.zh: 做什么生意？

blanks.en: What about opening a small restaurant?
blanks.zh: 开一家小餐馆怎么样？

blanks.en: Well, but are you prepared both mentally and financially?
blanks.zh: 不过，你在心理和资金方面都做好准备了吗？

blanks.en: I can start from what I have, and I think I'm ready to do it.
blanks.zh: 我可以利用现有的条件起步，而且我觉得我已经准备好了。

blanks.en: It's easier said than done, Bob.
blanks.zh: 鲍勃，说起来容易，做起来难。

blanks.en: You should give it more thought.
blanks.zh: 你应该再多考虑考虑。

blanks.en: I'll choose a good location for my restaurant, and I'll do some careful research to get off to a solid start.
blanks.zh: 我会为餐馆选个好位置，再做些仔细的调研，好让创业有个稳妥的开端。

blanks.en: Sally, are you busy now?
blanks.zh: 萨莉，你现在忙吗？

blanks.en: I need some help.
blanks.zh: 我需要你帮个忙。

blanks.en: What can I do?
blanks.zh: 我能做些什么？

blanks.en: I broke Sophia's toy house yesterday.
blanks.zh: 我昨天把索菲娅的玩具屋弄坏了。

blanks.en: I need to rebuild it for her.
blanks.zh: 我得给她重新搭好。

blanks.en: She was really upset.
blanks.zh: 她特别难过。

blanks.en: I told her I'd finish rebuilding it before she gets back from school.
blanks.zh: 我告诉她，会在她放学回来之前重新搭好。

blanks.en: Just putting together some wood pieces shouldn't be that difficult.
blanks.zh: 只是把一些木料拼起来，应该不会那么难。

blanks.en: It's more complicated than that.
blanks.zh: 事情比那复杂多了。

blanks.en: We need to put in all those windows and doors, too.
blanks.zh: 我们还得把那些窗户和门全都装上。

blanks.en: Why don't we just build a simpler one without those small parts?
blanks.zh: 我们干脆搭个简单点的，不要那些小部件，怎么样？

blanks.en: I've promised Sophia a toy house just like the old one.
blanks.zh: 我答应过索菲娅，给她一个和原来一模一样的玩具屋。

blanks.en: But it will take us forever to build it.
blanks.zh: 不过，搭完恐怕要花很长很长的时间。

blanks.en: Maybe we should find Sophia's grandpa to help us.
blanks.zh: 也许我们该找索菲娅的爷爷来帮忙。

blanks.en: Now let's briefly review what we have done in the past few days.
blanks.zh: 现在，让我们简要回顾一下过去几天做过的事。

blanks.en: We set off on Monday morning and arrived in Melbourne after a two-hour bus ride.
blanks.zh: 我们星期一早上出发，坐了两个小时的大巴后到达墨尔本。

blanks.en: We started with a guided tour of Eureka Tower.
blanks.zh: 我们先在导游带领下参观了尤里卡大厦。

blanks.en: After lunch, we walked along Collins Street, taking in the view of Town Hall.
blanks.zh: 午饭后，我们沿着柯林斯街散步，欣赏了市政厅的景色。

blanks.en: We then took a walk through Chinatown to the State Library.
blanks.zh: 然后我们步行穿过唐人街，来到州立图书馆。

blanks.en: Unexpectedly, we also met Markus Zusak, the author of The Book Thief, at the library.
blanks.zh: 我们还意外地在图书馆见到了《偷书贼》的作者马克斯·苏萨克。

blanks.en: On Tuesday morning we enjoyed the beauty of the botanical gardens, followed by a tour of the Victoria Parliament House in the afternoon.
blanks.zh: 星期二上午，我们欣赏了植物园的美景，下午又参观了维多利亚州议会大厦。

blanks.en: We spent most of the morning on Swanston Street studying the historic architecture.
blanks.zh: 今天上午，大部分时间我们都在斯旺斯顿街探究那里的历史建筑。

blanks.en: Now we've finished lunch.
blanks.zh: 现在我们已经吃过午饭。

blanks.en: It's time to head back to school and you can enjoy the views through the bus windows on the way.
blanks.zh: 该回学校了，途中大家可以透过大巴车窗欣赏风景。

blanks.en: A big thank you to my fellow teachers and parent volunteers for your wonderful help.
blanks.zh: 特别感谢教师同事和家长志愿者们给予的大力帮助。

blanks.en: The students had a great time and learned a lot.
blanks.zh: 同学们玩得很开心，也学到了很多。

blanks.en: Excuse me, is there a flower shop nearby?
blanks.zh: 打扰一下，附近有花店吗？

blanks.en: Do you see the bakery over there?
blanks.zh: 你看到那边的面包店了吗？

blanks.en: Next to it, you'll see a red umbrella.
blanks.zh: 在它旁边，你会看到一把红色的伞。

blanks.en: That's where the flower shop is.
blanks.zh: 花店就在那里。

blanks.en: Are Tom and Anne getting married in June?
blanks.zh: 汤姆和安妮是六月结婚吗？

blanks.en: No, they have rescheduled their wedding for late July.
blanks.zh: 不是，他们把婚礼改到了七月下旬。

blanks.en: After the wedding, they'll go on their honeymoon.
blanks.zh: 婚礼之后，他们会去度蜜月。

blanks.en: Which supermarket do you usually go to?
blanks.zh: 你通常去哪家超市？

blanks.en: I always shop at Brown's.
blanks.zh: 我总在布朗超市购物。

blanks.en: A new supermarket has opened in this area.
blanks.zh: 这个地区新开了一家超市。

blanks.en: I know, but it's always packed with people.
blanks.zh: 我知道，但那里总是挤满了人。

blanks.en: Mrs. Palmer wants us in her office.
blanks.zh: 帕尔默女士叫我们去她办公室。

blanks.en: She wants us to meet the new sales manager.
blanks.zh: 她想让我们见见新来的销售经理。

blanks.en: I'd like to summarize what it is we're looking for.
blanks.zh: 我想总结一下我们的具体要求。

blanks.en: Basically, we want the printing cost to come down by fifteen per cent.
blanks.zh: 简单来说，我们希望印刷成本降低百分之十五。

blanks.en: Well, it's really hard for us to offer such a price cut.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我们实在很难给出这样的降价幅度。

blanks.en: Have you made any resolutions?
blanks.zh: 你立下什么新年目标了吗？

blanks.en: I'd like to eat less and exercise more this year.
blanks.zh: 我今年想少吃一点，多运动一些。

blanks.en: Three hamburgers a day is probably not a good idea.
blanks.zh: 每天吃三个汉堡大概不是个好主意。

blanks.en: Many people hope to be healthier in the new year.
blanks.zh: 很多人希望新的一年能更健康。

blanks.en: You always see a lot of people start joining gyms.
blanks.zh: 你总会看到很多人开始加入健身房。

blanks.en: I heard some kind of statistic that gyms are always fifty per cent more crowded in the month of January, and then usually by February it's back to normal.
blanks.zh: 我听过一项统计，说一月份健身房的人总会比平时多百分之五十，通常到二月份就恢复正常了。

blanks.en: It's always difficult to keep up the workout routine.
blanks.zh: 要坚持规律锻炼总是很难。

blanks.en: Fenny, if you're up in London tomorrow, I've got two tickets for the American Ballet Theater.
blanks.zh: 芬妮，如果你明天在伦敦，我有两张美国芭蕾舞剧院的演出票。

blanks.en: Thanks, but I'll be busy tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 谢谢，不过我明天有事。

blanks.en: Do you have plans?
blanks.zh: 你有安排了吗？

blanks.en: We went to the same art school.
blanks.zh: 我们以前在同一所艺术学校上学。

blanks.en: Some of her designs are going to be exhibited there.
blanks.zh: 她的一些设计将在那里展出。

blanks.en: She's hoping one of the big clothes companies might buy them.
blanks.zh: 她希望某家大服装公司会买下这些设计。

blanks.en: Setting her sights high, isn't she?
blanks.zh: 她的目标定得很高，是吧？

blanks.en: Yeah, she is aiming high, but she has what it takes to get there.
blanks.zh: 是啊，她目标很高，不过她具备实现目标的能力。

blanks.en: People are increasingly concerned about online security.
blanks.zh: 人们越来越关注网络安全。

blanks.en: And many experts are now offering advice on how to use smartphones safely.
blanks.zh: 现在，许多专家都在就如何安全使用智能手机提供建议。

blanks.en: Let me ask you first.
blanks.zh: 我先问问你。

blanks.en: How long have you kept your phone on so far?
blanks.zh: 到目前为止，你的手机已经连续开机多久了？

blanks.en: For over a year now.
blanks.zh: 已经一年多了。

blanks.en: It's not that I'm addicted to it or have important calls, but I need the alarm to wake me up every morning.
blanks.zh: 并不是我对手机上瘾，或是有重要电话要接，而是我每天早上都需要闹钟叫醒我。

blanks.en: Yeah, but that's where the risk is.
blanks.zh: 是的，可风险恰恰就在这里。

blanks.en: According to experts, we should switch our phones off and on once a day as a security measure.
blanks.zh: 专家说，作为一项安全措施，我们应该每天把手机关机后再开机一次。

blanks.en: It helps close the applications running in the background and stop data collection processes we're not aware of.
blanks.zh: 这样有助于关闭后台运行的应用程序，并停止那些我们不知道的数据收集进程。

blanks.en: Do we switch the phone off and switch it back on immediately?
blanks.zh: 我们是关机后马上再开机吗？

blanks.en: Well, better wait for a few minutes.
blanks.zh: 嗯，最好等几分钟。

blanks.en: When do you usually do that?
blanks.zh: 你通常什么时候这样做？

blanks.en: I do it every night before going to bed.
blanks.zh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都这样做。

blanks.en: Welcome to History of the English Language.
blanks.zh: 欢迎来到《英语语言史》课堂。

blanks.en: Since the class is quite small, I plan to run this course as a discussion.
blanks.zh: 由于班里人数不多，我打算以讨论的形式开展这门课。

blanks.en: I hope everyone will be fully engaged and volunteer to share your knowledge and opinions.
blanks.zh: 我希望大家都积极投入，主动分享自己的知识和看法。

blanks.en: I won't take attendance, but since part of your grade depends on participation, I encourage you to come to class.
blanks.zh: 我不会点名考勤，但你们的部分成绩取决于课堂参与情况，所以我鼓励大家来上课。

blanks.en: Could you tell us more about the assessment of the course?
blanks.zh: 您能再讲讲这门课的考核方式吗？

blanks.en: In addition to your participation in class, which accounts for ten per cent, there will be a midterm test, twenty per cent, a final exam, thirty per cent, and a research paper forty per cent.
blanks.zh: 除了占百分之十的课堂参与，还有占百分之二十的期中测验、占百分之三十的期末考试，以及占百分之四十的研究论文。

blanks.en: Do we have any reading assignments?
blanks.zh: 我们有阅读作业吗？

blanks.en: I believe you've all got your textbook.
blanks.zh: 我相信你们都已经拿到课本了。

blanks.en: Apart from that, there's a list of books that you're required to read.
blanks.zh: 除此之外，还有一份书单，上面的书你们都需要读。

blanks.en: Now, let's have a close look at it.
blanks.zh: 现在，我们仔细看一看这份书单。

blanks.en: Thanks for your consistent support for our weekly meeting, New Books Sharing.
blanks.zh: 感谢大家一直支持我们每周举行的“新书分享”活动。

blanks.en: Today, we've invited Dr. Caspar Melville, lecturer from the University of London.
blanks.zh: 今天，我们邀请到了伦敦大学的讲师卡斯帕·梅尔维尔博士。

blanks.en: Dr. Melville started out as a music journalist for a black music magazine called Blues and Soul.
blanks.zh: 梅尔维尔博士最初是一名音乐记者，为一本名叫《布鲁斯与灵魂乐》的黑人音乐杂志撰稿。

blanks.en: In nineteen ninety-two, he moved to San Francisco and founded a jazz magazine named On the One, with some friends.
blanks.zh: 1992年，他搬到旧金山，和几位朋友创办了一本名为《On the One》的爵士乐杂志。

blanks.en: They did a really good job, though there was not a lot of money in it.
blanks.zh: 他们做得非常好，虽然这份工作赚不到多少钱。

blanks.en: In nineteen ninety-seven, he moved back to London and started teaching, and made the decision to find another way to write about music.
blanks.zh: 1997年，他搬回伦敦，开始教书，并决定寻找另一种方式来写音乐。

blanks.en: He grew up in London.
blanks.zh: 他在伦敦长大。

blanks.en: He feels that the music in London clubs has formed him, but unfortunately it has been seriously undervalued by the academic world.
blanks.zh: 他觉得伦敦俱乐部里的音乐塑造了他，但遗憾的是，学术界严重低估了这些音乐的价值。

blanks.en: In black music studies, jazz has received great attention, but dance music has been largely ignored.
blanks.zh: 在黑人音乐研究中，爵士乐备受关注，舞曲却在很大程度上被忽视了。

blanks.en: His book, It's a London Thing, is meant to change that situation.
blanks.zh: 他的书《这是伦敦的特色》就是为了改变这种状况。

blanks.en: So let's welcome Dr. Melville to share with us his ideas in the book.
blanks.zh: 那么，让我们欢迎梅尔维尔博士分享他书中的观点。

blanks.en: I just arrived on the flight from Melbourne, and my suitcase is missing.
blanks.zh: 我刚坐从墨尔本来的航班到达，可我的行李箱不见了。

blanks.en: We're very sorry, sir.
blanks.zh: 先生，非常抱歉。

blanks.en: Could you put down your information in this form?
blanks.zh: 您能在这张表上填写个人信息吗？

blanks.en: We'll do everything we can to find your suitcase.
blanks.zh: 我们会尽一切努力找到您的行李箱。

blanks.en: Have you talked over your future plan with your parents, Sarah?
blanks.zh: 萨拉，你和父母讨论过将来的打算吗？

blanks.en: Well, my parents would like me to do my master's after graduation, but I'm thinking of volunteering as a social worker for a year.
blanks.zh: 嗯，父母希望我毕业后读硕士，但我想先做一年的志愿社工。

blanks.en: We really need to move, Steve.
blanks.zh: 史蒂夫，我们真的需要搬家了。

blanks.en: So many cars go by every day, and no sun comes through the windows.
blanks.zh: 每天有那么多车从这里经过，而且阳光一点都照不进窗户。

blanks.en: Yeah, this house is kind of old.
blanks.zh: 是啊，这房子有点旧了。

blanks.en: What do you have in mind?
blanks.zh: 你有什么想法？

blanks.en: Maybe we should have a look in the suburbs.
blanks.zh: 也许我们该去郊区看看。

blanks.en: Do you often ski here?
blanks.zh: 你经常来这里滑雪吗？

blanks.en: This is my first time.
blanks.zh: 这是我第一次来。

blanks.en: So, how do you like it so far?
blanks.zh: 那么，到目前为止你觉得这里怎么样？

blanks.en: The snow is brilliant.
blanks.zh: 这里的雪好极了。

blanks.en: It would be better if there were fewer people.
blanks.zh: 要是人少一些就更好了。

blanks.en: Now we've crossed the stone bridge.
blanks.zh: 现在我们已经过了石桥。

blanks.en: Look, here's the Art Center.
blanks.zh: 看，艺术中心在这里。

blanks.en: The Grand Theatre is two blocks away.
blanks.zh: 大剧院还有两个街区远。

blanks.en: We won't be late then.
blanks.zh: 那么我们就不会迟到了。

blanks.en: Miss, I'll need to see your driver's license.
blanks.zh: 女士，我需要看一下您的驾驶证。

blanks.en: Was I doing something wrong?
blanks.zh: 我做错什么了吗？

blanks.en: You're driving in a school zone around the time school lets out.
blanks.zh: 您现在是在学校附近路段行驶，而且正赶上放学的时间。

blanks.en: The speed limit is fifteen miles an hour, and you were going thirty-five.
blanks.zh: 这里限速每小时十五英里，而您刚才的车速达到了每小时三十五英里。

blanks.en: But it's only two ten p.m.
blanks.zh: 可现在才下午两点十分。

blanks.en: The students aren't dismissed until three thirty.
blanks.zh: 学生们三点半才放学。

blanks.en: Students are dismissed an hour and a half early on Wednesdays.
blanks.zh: 每逢星期三，学生会提前一个半小时放学。

blanks.en: I just forgot that.
blanks.zh: 我刚才忘了这件事。

blanks.en: Haven't seen you for some time.
blanks.zh: 有一段时间没见到你了。

blanks.en: Oh, Kevin. Nice to see you.
blanks.zh: 哦，凯文，很高兴见到你。

blanks.en: Are you also here for dinner?
blanks.zh: 你也来这里吃晚饭吗？

blanks.en: My cousin Fiona is in town, and this is her favorite steakhouse.
blanks.zh: 我的表亲菲奥娜来了，这里是她最喜欢的牛排餐厅。

blanks.en: You met her last year, right?
blanks.zh: 你去年见过她，对吧？

blanks.en: Look, are you here alone?
blanks.zh: 对了，你是一个人来的吗？

blanks.en: Would you like to join us?
blanks.zh: 愿意和我们一起吃吗？

blanks.en: That's very nice of you.
blanks.zh: 你太客气了。

blanks.en: But I'm meeting David and some other friends for dinner.
blanks.zh: 不过，我约了戴维和其他几个朋友吃晚饭。

blanks.en: You remember David, from Class Two?
blanks.zh: 你记得二班的戴维吧？

blanks.en: He was the captain of our school's basketball team.
blanks.zh: 他以前是我们校篮球队队长。

blanks.en: I haven't seen him since graduation.
blanks.zh: 毕业后我就没见过他了。

blanks.en: He worked abroad for three years and has just come back.
blanks.zh: 他在国外工作了三年，刚回来。

blanks.en: Well, I'll go and say a quick hello.
blanks.zh: 那我过去跟他简单打个招呼。

blanks.en: We definitely should get together sometime and have a drink.
blanks.zh: 我们一定要找个时间聚一聚，喝一杯。

blanks.en: There's nothing decent to watch these days on TV.
blanks.zh: 最近电视上没什么值得看的节目。

blanks.en: There's tons of stuff.
blanks.zh: 有好多节目呢。

blanks.en: They've cut down on the number of news programmes and the number of documentaries.
blanks.zh: 他们减少了新闻节目和纪录片的数量。

blanks.en: All have been replaced by these stupid reality shows and game shows, you know.
blanks.zh: 全都换成了这些无聊的真人秀和游戏节目，你知道吧。

blanks.en: People want to watch that kind of thing.
blanks.zh: 大家想看的就是那类节目。

blanks.en: It's good, you know, as long as there's a balance.
blanks.zh: 挺好的，只要各种节目保持平衡就行，你知道的。

blanks.en: There's a bit of this, a bit of that.
blanks.zh: 这类来一点，那类来一点。

blanks.en: Or should we be, you know, trying to educate them?
blanks.zh: 还是说，我们应该，怎么说呢，试着教育他们？

blanks.en: Well, TV's there for entertainment.
blanks.zh: 电视就是用来娱乐的。

blanks.en: If you want an education, you go to university or college or something, don't you?
blanks.zh: 要接受教育的话，去大学或学院之类的地方不就行了吗？

blanks.en: No, I really don't think so.
blanks.zh: 不，我实在不这么认为。

blanks.en: Welcome to Education Update.
blanks.zh: 欢迎收听《教育动态》。

blanks.en: We have Robert Hall from Mountainside High School with us today.
blanks.zh: 今天，山麓高中的罗伯特·霍尔来到了我们的节目。

blanks.en: Could you tell us about the service program in your school?
blanks.zh: 能给我们介绍一下贵校的服务项目吗？

blanks.en: It goes like this.
blanks.zh: 情况是这样的。

blanks.en: On certain days each month, adults from the neighborhood sit in class with the students and see what's going on in the school.
blanks.zh: 每个月的特定几天，附近社区的成年人会和学生一起坐在课堂里，了解学校里正在发生的事情。

blanks.en: What else can they do?
blanks.zh: 他们还可以做什么？

blanks.en: They can also take adult courses in the evenings for both fun and serious learning.
blanks.zh: 他们晚上还可以上成人课程，既可以为了兴趣，也可以认真学习。

blanks.en: What about the students?
blanks.zh: 那学生呢？

blanks.en: What can they do in the program?
blanks.zh: 学生能在这个项目中做什么？

blanks.en: Well, they can change places with adults and go working on a farm, or in a factory, or taking care of the housework.
blanks.zh: 他们可以与成年人交换角色，去农场或工厂工作，或者承担家务。

blanks.en: This helps them better understand the lives of their parents and know more about their neighborhood.
blanks.zh: 这有助于他们更好地理解父母的生活，也更了解自己所在的社区。

blanks.en: Yes, students have a chance to work in hospitals, nursing homes, libraries and even in government offices.
blanks.zh: 是的，学生有机会去医院、养老院、图书馆，甚至政府机关工作。

blanks.en: So the school is not only part of the students' lives, but also part of the neighborhood.
blanks.zh: 这样一来，学校既是学生生活的一部分，也是社区的一部分。

blanks.en: That's exactly what our service program is for.
blanks.zh: 这正是我们开展服务项目的目的。

blanks.en: Thank you, Mr. Hall.
blanks.zh: 谢谢您，霍尔先生。

blanks.en: Tonight I'll continue to share how we can use art to spread the word about the changing climate.
blanks.zh: 今晚，我会继续和大家分享如何运用艺术，让更多人了解气候变化。

blanks.en: In our day-to-day lives, climate change can be hard to see.
blanks.zh: 在日常生活中，气候变化可能很难被察觉。

blanks.en: But some places will feel the changes sooner than others.
blanks.zh: 但有些地方会比其他地方更早感受到这些变化。

blanks.en: The city I live in is very flat and close to the water line, and rising sea levels are already creating floods.
blanks.zh: 我居住的城市地势非常平坦，离水位线很近，而海平面上升已经造成了洪水。

blanks.en: So I decided to do something to make it impossible to ignore.
blanks.zh: 所以，我决定做点什么，让人们再也无法忽视这个问题。

blanks.en: I started an art project called Underwater Homeowners' Association and painted numbers onto thousands of large signs.
blanks.zh: 我发起了一个叫“水下业主协会”的艺术项目，在数千块大标牌上画上数字。

blanks.en: Each number showed how high someone's house was above sea level.
blanks.zh: 每个数字都表示某栋房子比海平面高多少。

blanks.en: A one would mean that if the sea level rose one foot, the building would flood.
blanks.zh: 数字一表示，如果海平面升高一英尺，那栋建筑就会被水淹没。

blanks.en: I gave the signs to homeowners, who put them in their yards.
blanks.zh: 我把这些标牌送给了房主，他们把牌子插在自家院子里。

blanks.en: Kids painted more signs and put them near their schools and along busy roads.
blanks.zh: 孩子们画了更多标牌，放在学校附近和繁忙的道路旁边。

blanks.en: The project has already had a real-world effect.
blanks.zh: 这个项目已经在现实中产生了影响。

blanks.en: The people who put the signs in their yards created a real homeowners association to address climate change in their communities.
blanks.zh: 那些把标牌放在院子里的居民成立了一个真正的业主协会，着手应对各自社区的气候变化。

blanks.en: Is this bus going to Baxley, sir?
blanks.zh: 先生，这辆公交车去巴克斯利吗？

blanks.en: See the yellow taxi on the corner?
blanks.zh: 看见拐角处那辆黄色出租车了吗？

blanks.en: Turn left there to Mavis Street and take bus number four.
blanks.zh: 在那里左转，进入梅维斯街，然后乘四路公交车。

blanks.en: So, would you folks like some dessert?
blanks.zh: 那么，各位要来点甜点吗？

blanks.en: Just bring us the bill, please.
blanks.zh: 请直接把账单拿给我们吧。

blanks.en: We need to get back on the road and continue our journey.
blanks.zh: 我们得重新上路，继续赶路了。

blanks.en: Dad, I can't afford that computer, but I think I really need it for my research.
blanks.zh: 爸爸，那台电脑我买不起，但我觉得做研究真的需要它。

blanks.en: Just pay as much as you can, and I'll make up the rest.
blanks.zh: 你尽量付你能付的部分，剩下的我来补。

blanks.en: Then I can place the order.
blanks.zh: 这样我就可以下单了。

blanks.en: I'm from the Department of Psychology.
blanks.zh: 我来自心理学系。

blanks.en: I hope you can understand my English.
blanks.zh: 希望你能听懂我的英语。

blanks.en: Well, you speak very clearly.
blanks.zh: 嗯，你说得很清楚。

blanks.en: Linda, I need you to help me with my problem.
blanks.zh: 琳达，我有个麻烦，需要你帮忙。

blanks.en: Gee, you broke Mary's sports watch!
blanks.zh: 天哪，你把玛丽的运动手表弄坏了！

blanks.en: Ah, I wish I didn't touch it.
blanks.zh: 唉，真希望我没碰过它。

blanks.en: I've got two tickets for the National Theatre.
blanks.zh: 我有两张国家剧院的票。

blanks.en: Would you like to come?
blanks.zh: 你想一起来吗？

blanks.en: Oh, Sonny told me it was very good.
blanks.zh: 哦，桑尼跟我说这部戏非常好。

blanks.en: Yes, everyone says so.
blanks.zh: 是啊，大家都这么说。

blanks.en: Shall I meet you at your office at six o'clock?
blanks.zh: 我六点去你办公室和你碰面，好吗？

blanks.en: Then we can go and have a quick snack.
blanks.zh: 然后我们可以去随便吃点东西。

blanks.en: The play starts at seven o'clock.
blanks.zh: 戏七点开演。

blanks.en: See you Tuesday, then.
blanks.zh: 那就星期二见。

blanks.en: Hi Sam, how is your daughter doing at school?
blanks.zh: 嗨，萨姆，你女儿在学校的情况怎么样？

blanks.en: Well, since I bought a smartphone for Jillian last summer, it seems the phone has become an extension of her arm, and it has made it impossible for her to concentrate.
blanks.zh: 嗯，自从我去年夏天给吉莉恩买了一部智能手机，她的手机似乎就成了手臂的延伸，让她根本无法专心。

blanks.en: That really upsets me.
blanks.zh: 这真让我心烦。

blanks.en: You are not alone in that.
blanks.zh: 有这种烦恼的可不止你一个。

blanks.en: It is said that ninety-five per cent of teenagers either own or have access to a smartphone.
blanks.zh: 据说，百分之九十五的青少年拥有智能手机，或者能使用智能手机。

blanks.en: Some schools have put in place policies banning or controlling phone use during school hours.
blanks.zh: 一些学校已经出台规定，禁止或限制学生在校期间使用手机。

blanks.en: I'm all in favor of these policies.
blanks.zh: 我完全支持这些规定。

blanks.en: More and more schools have begun doing this.
blanks.zh: 越来越多的学校已经开始这样做了。

blanks.en: A friend of mine works at a school, and he told me that these policies had brought about positive changes.
blanks.zh: 我的一位朋友在学校工作，他告诉我，这些规定带来了积极的变化。

blanks.en: Max, are you ready to go?
blanks.zh: 马克斯，你准备好出发了吗？

blanks.en: I thought we were going to play table tennis with Billy and Karen.
blanks.zh: 我以为我们要和比利、卡伦一起打乒乓球。

blanks.en: Oh, change of plan.
blanks.zh: 哦，计划变了。

blanks.en: Billy suggested we go rock climbing instead.
blanks.zh: 比利建议我们改去攀岩。

blanks.en: But I was really looking forward to playing table tennis.
blanks.zh: 可我本来很期待打乒乓球。

blanks.en: We play table tennis all the time.
blanks.zh: 我们一直都在打乒乓球。

blanks.en: We'd like to go do some outdoor activities for a change, like rock climbing and horseback riding.
blanks.zh: 我们想换换花样，去做些户外活动，比如攀岩、骑马。

blanks.en: Oh, Jessie, I thought the point of this vacation was to relax.
blanks.zh: 哦，杰西，我以为这次度假就是为了放松。

blanks.en: Well, we can do something less demanding tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 嗯，明天我们可以做点不那么费力的事。

blanks.en: How about boating on the lake?
blanks.zh: 去湖上划船怎么样？

blanks.en: What do you think?
blanks.zh: 你觉得呢？

blanks.en: I like the idea of spending some time on the water.
blanks.zh: 我很喜欢在水上待一会儿这个主意。

blanks.en: I'm sure Billy and Karen will like it too.
blanks.zh: 我相信比利和卡伦也会喜欢的。

blanks.en: Hi Susanna, I had an interview with Anderson High Tech and they offered me the position of sales manager.
blanks.zh: 嗨，苏珊娜，我去安德森高科技公司面试了，他们给了我销售经理的职位。

blanks.en: I want to let you know before I make my decision.
blanks.zh: 我想在作决定之前先让你知道。

blanks.en: I'm sorry to hear that, Frank, but I appreciate you telling me before you accept the offer.
blanks.zh: 弗兰克，听到这消息我很遗憾，但谢谢你在接受聘用之前告诉我。

blanks.en: I really enjoy my work here.
blanks.zh: 我真的很喜欢在这里工作。

blanks.en: I put in effort for five years to gain more experience, but there seems no hope of being promoted.
blanks.zh: 这五年来，我一直努力积累经验，但似乎没有晋升的希望。

blanks.en: What would help you decide to stay?
blanks.zh: 什么条件能让你决定留下？

blanks.en: I would consider staying if I could change my position.
blanks.zh: 如果可以换个职位，我会考虑留下。

blanks.en: I would love working in this same department, but I would like to be doing something different.
blanks.zh: 我愿意继续在这个部门工作，但想做一些不同的事情。

blanks.en: And they offered me six per cent more than my present salary.
blanks.zh: 而且，他们给的薪水比我现在高百分之六。

blanks.en: When do you have to tell them your decision?
blanks.zh: 你必须什么时候告诉他们你的决定？

blanks.en: They want me to respond by Friday.
blanks.zh: 他们希望我最迟星期五答复。

blanks.en: I'll talk to the Human Resources Director and let you know the result on Thursday.
blanks.zh: 我会和人力资源总监谈谈，星期四把结果告诉你。

blanks.en: Can you wait until then?
blanks.zh: 你能等到那时吗？

blanks.en: That'll be too late.
blanks.zh: 那就太晚了。

blanks.en: Wednesday will be better.
blanks.zh: 星期三会更好。

blanks.en: I'm going to do everything I can to keep you on board.
blanks.zh: 我会尽一切努力把你留在公司。

blanks.en: I appreciate what you are doing for me.
blanks.zh: 谢谢你为我做的这些。

blanks.en: This summer, we provide two full-time summer camp programs.
blanks.zh: 今年夏天，我们开设两种全日制夏令营项目。

blanks.en: Both will last the entire time the children are out of school.
blanks.zh: 这两种项目都会覆盖孩子们离校放假的整个假期。

blanks.en: Our first summer camp is for our four-year-olds, called Mini Camp.
blanks.zh: 我们的第一种夏令营面向四岁儿童，叫作“迷你营”。

blanks.en: This mini camp will still have their normal everyday schedule, with a lot of fun activities.
blanks.zh: 迷你营仍会沿用日常作息安排，其中有很多有趣的活动。

blanks.en: At least once a week our mini campers will go on a field trip.
blanks.zh: 我们迷你营的小营员每周至少会参加一次外出活动。

blanks.en: These field trips could consist of a day at the beach, or exploring the natural museum.
blanks.zh: 这些外出活动可能是去海边玩一天，也可能是参观自然博物馆。

blanks.en: Our older summer camp is provided for ages five through twelve.
blanks.zh: 面向较大孩子的夏令营招收五至十二岁的儿童。

blanks.en: There are scheduled summer fun activities and games.
blanks.zh: 其中安排了暑期趣味活动和游戏。

blanks.en: The children will participate in art, outdoor play, games and much more.
blanks.zh: 孩子们将参加美术、户外玩耍、游戏以及更多活动。

blanks.en: Swimming at a nearby pool is often a weekly field trip for ages six and up.
blanks.zh: 六岁及以上的营员通常每周都会外出到附近的游泳池游泳。

blanks.en: Other field trips could include bowling, a day at the movies, or a picnic in the park.
blanks.zh: 其他外出活动可能包括保龄球、看一天电影，或者到公园野餐。

blanks.en: Permission of parents and activity fees are required to participate in all field trips.
blanks.zh: 参加任何外出活动，都需要家长许可并缴纳活动费。

blanks.en: Now, let's watch a five-minute film about last year's programs.
blanks.zh: 现在，我们来观看一段介绍去年项目情况的五分钟短片。

blanks.en: I'm looking for a new apartment.
blanks.zh: 我正在找一套新公寓。

blanks.en: Well, just for a change.
blanks.zh: 嗯，就是想换个环境。

blanks.en: And the rent is too high.
blanks.zh: 而且房租太高了。

blanks.en: Jennifer got her new book published last month.
blanks.zh: 詹妮弗的新书上个月出版了。

blanks.en: I learned it from the morning paper today.
blanks.zh: 我是从今天的早报上知道的。

blanks.en: It's based on her teaching experience in Africa last year.
blanks.zh: 这本书是根据她去年在非洲的教学经历写的。

blanks.en: Jim, have you seen Bob?
blanks.zh: 吉姆，你见到鲍勃了吗？

blanks.en: Not since he left my office an hour ago.
blanks.zh: 他一小时前离开我办公室后，我就没见过他。

blanks.en: He's supposed to be at the airport now to pick up Mr. Anderson, but he's nowhere to be found.
blanks.zh: 他现在应该在机场接安德森先生，可哪里都找不到他。

blanks.en: Slow down a bit, John.
blanks.zh: 约翰，开慢一点。

blanks.en: Keep it under sixty-five.
blanks.zh: 把车速控制在六十五以下。

blanks.en: We don't want to be pulled over by the police.
blanks.zh: 我们可不想被警察拦下来。

blanks.en: I just wanted to get to the service station sooner.
blanks.zh: 我只是想早点到服务站。

blanks.en: I'm kind of hungry.
blanks.zh: 我有点饿了。

blanks.en: I found the gas bill in the mailbox.
blanks.zh: 我在信箱里发现了燃气账单。

blanks.en: How much is it?
blanks.zh: 多少钱？

blanks.en: About a hundred and fifty.
blanks.zh: 大约一百五十。

blanks.en: Oh, it was due last Friday.
blanks.zh: 哦，这笔账上星期五就该付了。

blanks.en: I'll take care of it tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 我明天会处理好的。

blanks.en: How is your training going?
blanks.zh: 你的训练进行得怎么样？

blanks.en: My coach has a really good swim programme for me, and I think I'm in first-class condition.
blanks.zh: 教练为我制定了一套很棒的游泳训练计划，我觉得自己的状态非常好。

blanks.en: Do you have to get up very early?
blanks.zh: 你必须很早起床吗？

blanks.en: Well, I don't like training early in the morning, so I start at ten.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我不喜欢清晨训练，所以十点才开始。

blanks.en: What about lunch, then?
blanks.zh: 那午饭怎么安排呢？

blanks.en: I don't have lunch.
blanks.zh: 我不吃午饭。

blanks.en: Lunch makes me sleepy.
blanks.zh: 午饭会让我犯困。

blanks.en: I train all through the day until three.
blanks.zh: 我白天一直训练到三点。

blanks.en: With us tonight is Mark, a famous local artist.
blanks.zh: 今晚来到我们节目的是马克，一位本地著名的艺术家。

blanks.en: Thanks for joining us, Mark.
blanks.zh: 马克，谢谢你来参加我们的节目。

blanks.en: Have you done live drawing before?
blanks.zh: 你以前做过现场绘画吗？

blanks.en: Is there more pressure to draw in front of an audience?
blanks.zh: 在观众面前画画，压力会更大吗？

blanks.en: Yes, I have done live drawing before.
blanks.zh: 是的，我以前做过现场绘画。

blanks.en: I often draw pictures in pubs, and people always come over for a look and a chat.
blanks.zh: 我经常在酒吧画画，总有人过来看看、聊聊天。

blanks.en: I know that you've drawn pictures on many things, including maps and the covers of books and magazines.
blanks.zh: 我知道你在许多物品上画过画，包括地图，以及书籍和杂志的封面。

blanks.en: What's something you haven't drawn on yet, but really want to?
blanks.zh: 有没有什么东西，你还没在上面画过，却特别想试试？

blanks.en: I'd like to draw on personal diaries people have kept over the years, and draw the owner on it.
blanks.zh: 我想在人们保存多年的私人日记上作画，把日记主人的像画上去。

blanks.en: Could you also tell us where your inspirations come from?
blanks.zh: 你能再告诉我们，你的灵感来自哪里吗？

blanks.en: Most are from the people I've met and talked to when I was traveling.
blanks.zh: 大多数灵感来自我旅行时遇见并交谈过的人。

blanks.en: I always dreamed of traveling around the world and creating a series of drawings about different cities in the world.
blanks.zh: 我一直梦想着环游世界，创作一系列描绘世界各地城市的画作。

blanks.en: This is Carl's Commercial Cleaning.
blanks.zh: 这里是卡尔商业清洁公司。

blanks.en: May I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'm calling to ask about the cleaner position.
blanks.zh: 我打电话是想咨询清洁工这个职位。

blanks.en: Is it still available?
blanks.zh: 这个职位还空着吗？

blanks.en: We mainly work with small stores in the area, and the job is to clean the storefront windows.
blanks.zh: 我们主要为本地小商店服务，工作是清洁店面橱窗。

blanks.en: Do I need work experience?
blanks.zh: 需要有工作经验吗？

blanks.en: We offer on-the-job paid training.
blanks.zh: 我们提供带薪在岗培训。

blanks.en: As a company car is provided, you must have a driver's license and a good driving record.
blanks.zh: 由于公司会配车，你必须有驾照，而且驾驶记录良好。

blanks.en: You also need to have a smartphone for communication.
blanks.zh: 你还需要有一部智能手机，方便联系。

blanks.en: Can I ask about the pay?
blanks.zh: 我能问问工资吗？

blanks.en: It's ten to twelve dollars per hour plus tips.
blanks.zh: 每小时十到十二美元，另加小费。

blanks.en: Do you have other requirements?
blanks.zh: 还有其他要求吗？

blanks.en: Our employees must be dependable, and be able to lift heavy things and stand long hours at a time.
blanks.zh: 我们的员工必须可靠，能够搬重物，而且能连续站立很长时间。

blanks.en: Can you come tomorrow afternoon at two for an interview?
blanks.zh: 你明天下午两点能来面试吗？

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I've got a reservation.
blanks.zh: 我预订过房间。

blanks.en: My name is Hilary Langley.
blanks.zh: 我叫希拉里·朗利。

blanks.en: Just a moment, please.
blanks.zh: 请稍等。

blanks.en: How do you spell your last name?
blanks.zh: 您的姓怎么拼？

blanks.en: Well, I'm sorry, but we don't seem to have a reservation for you.
blanks.zh: 嗯，抱歉，我们这里似乎没有您的预订记录。

blanks.en: There must be some mistake.
blanks.zh: 一定是哪里弄错了。

blanks.en: I'm attending a conference in the city, and my secretary told me that the conference organizer made the reservation for me.
blanks.zh: 我来这里参加一个会议，秘书告诉我，会议组织者已经替我订好了房间。

blanks.en: You are not booked in here.
blanks.zh: 这里没有您的入住预订。

blanks.en: Well, but can you find me a single room anyway?
blanks.zh: 那么，不管怎样，能不能给我找一间单人间？

blanks.en: I'm afraid there's nothing available at the moment.
blanks.zh: 恐怕目前没有空房。

blanks.en: Look, I really need a room here.
blanks.zh: 是这样，我真的需要在这里住一间房。

blanks.en: Can I talk to your manager?
blanks.zh: 我能和你们经理谈谈吗？

blanks.en: The manager is away on business.
blanks.zh: 经理出差去了。

blanks.en: But, well, I may be able to help you if you could wait and prepare to check in after two in the afternoon.
blanks.zh: 不过，嗯，如果您愿意等一等，准备下午两点以后再入住，我也许能帮上忙。

blanks.en: We'll have some rooms at that time.
blanks.zh: 到那个时候，我们就会有一些空房。

blanks.en: That'd be very kind of you.
blanks.zh: 那您可真是太好了。

blanks.en: Could you give me a call when you have a room available?
blanks.zh: 有空房时，能给我打个电话吗？

blanks.en: I'll just wander around and have some coffee.
blanks.zh: 我就先四处逛逛，喝点咖啡。

blanks.en: Would you please give me your phone number?
blanks.zh: 请您告诉我电话号码，好吗？

blanks.en: I'm honored to have my voice heard to make a difference in the lives of those little birds that share our city.
blanks.zh: 很荣幸能让大家听到我的声音，为与我们共同生活在这座城市的小鸟们带来一些改变。

blanks.en: My name is Christina.
blanks.zh: 我叫克里斯蒂娜。

blanks.en: I'm an enthusiastic bird watcher.
blanks.zh: 我是个热心的观鸟爱好者。

blanks.en: Because we cut down too many trees in the nearby areas, many birds now find places within the city to live.
blanks.zh: 因为我们在附近地区砍伐了太多树木，现在许多鸟到城市里寻找栖息地。

blanks.en: The most common is the area behind the large advertisement boards on the poles.
blanks.zh: 最常见的地方，是立柱上大型广告牌后面的空间。

blanks.en: It's a natural choice for the birds, because the poles are similar to trees, tall and far from dangers on the ground.
blanks.zh: 这对鸟来说是自然的选择，因为这些柱子和树很像，高高的，远离地面上的危险。

blanks.en: The surprising thing is that there are likely more than five or six kinds of birds living together at each place.
blanks.zh: 令人惊讶的是，每处很可能有五六种以上的鸟共同生活。

blanks.en: While trying to learn more about these birds, I find that there have not been any consistent studies or monitoring of them.
blanks.zh: 在尝试更多地了解这些鸟时，我发现，一直没有针对它们的持续研究或监测。

blanks.en: Their eating habits, adaptation to life in the city, diseases, death rate, and such other information are not available.
blanks.zh: 关于它们的饮食习惯、对城市生活的适应、疾病、死亡率等信息，目前都无法获得。

blanks.en: I'd like to suggest that a programme be started to study these birds.
blanks.zh: 我想建议启动一个研究这些鸟类的项目。

blanks.en: It could be convenient to employ bird watchers to do the initial studies.
blanks.zh: 雇请观鸟者来做初步研究，可能是个方便的办法。

blanks.en: Look, we have time for a hamburger from a fast food restaurant.
blanks.zh: 看，我们还有时间去一家快餐店吃个汉堡。

blanks.en: I know a new restaurant on Maple Street, not far from our company.
blanks.zh: 我知道枫树街上有家新餐厅，离我们公司不远。

blanks.en: Is that okay with you?
blanks.zh: 你觉得可以吗？

blanks.en: Hi Vicky, I remember our class presentation is on Wednesday, but you said it's on Thursday.
blanks.zh: 嗨，维姬，我记得我们班的展示安排在星期三，可你说是在星期四。

blanks.en: It was a slip of the tongue.
blanks.zh: 刚才是我说错了。

blanks.en: I meant Tuesday for sure.
blanks.zh: 我说的是星期二，肯定是星期二。

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'm the one who asked about the price of a glass tea table top just now.
blanks.zh: 我是刚才咨询玻璃茶几桌面价格的那个人。

blanks.en: I'm sorry I made a mistake.
blanks.zh: 抱歉，我弄错了。

blanks.en: The size should be seventy-five centimeters by fifty centimeters.
blanks.zh: 尺寸应该是七十五厘米乘五十厘米。

blanks.en: Oh, that'll make a difference in the price.
blanks.zh: 哦，那价格就会有变化了。

blanks.en: Hold on and let me find out.
blanks.zh: 请稍等，我查一下。

blanks.en: These are our new arrivals.
blanks.zh: 这些是我们新到的商品。

blanks.en: Every man should own at least one woollen sweater, don't you think?
blanks.zh: 每个男士都应该至少有一件羊毛衫，你不觉得吗？

blanks.en: The one with two pockets sells best this year.
blanks.zh: 有两个口袋的那款今年卖得最好。

blanks.en: How do you like your school, Tom?
blanks.zh: 汤姆，你觉得你的学校怎么样？

blanks.en: Oh, I like it a lot.
blanks.zh: 哦，我很喜欢。

blanks.en: And I also like the area.
blanks.zh: 我也喜欢这片地区。

blanks.en: The nearby recreation center is cool.
blanks.zh: 附近的娱乐中心很棒。

blanks.en: What a relief that you're happy with your new home!
blanks.zh: 你喜欢这个新家，我就放心了。

blanks.en: I don't know if I want to go to college.
blanks.zh: 我不知道自己想不想上大学。

blanks.en: Because I'm not smart.
blanks.zh: 因为我不聪明。

blanks.en: Yeah, it can be scary.
blanks.zh: 是啊，这可能会让人害怕。

blanks.en: Did you ever come close to dropping out, Dad?
blanks.zh: 爸爸，你有没有差点退学的时候？

blanks.en: But I worried a lot before I went.
blanks.zh: 不过，上大学前我很担心。

blanks.en: Because I thought college would be full of brains.
blanks.zh: 因为我以为大学里全是聪明人。

blanks.en: Once I got there, I found out that most of the kids were just like me.
blanks.zh: 到了那里，我才发现大多数学生都和我一样。

blanks.en: People around the world are reporting that birds are much louder these days.
blanks.zh: 世界各地的人都反映，这些天鸟叫声响亮多了。

blanks.en: Now, I've connected with Doctor Zollinger, and let's hear what she will say.
blanks.zh: 现在，我已连线佐林格博士，来听听她怎么说。

blanks.en: Well, we feel that they're singing louder, because they sing in typically noisy places.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我们觉得它们唱得更响，是因为它们通常在嘈杂的地方鸣唱。

blanks.en: But when the noise is gone, they sing quieter than they normally do.
blanks.zh: 但噪声消失后，它们会比平时唱得更轻。

blanks.en: So, in other words, birds are like us.
blanks.zh: 所以，换句话说，鸟和我们一样。

blanks.en: In a noisy bar, for example, people will raise their voices.
blanks.zh: 比如在嘈杂的酒吧里，人们会提高嗓门。

blanks.en: We know that birds sing quieter on the weekend mornings.
blanks.zh: 我们知道，鸟在周末的早晨唱得比较轻。

blanks.en: This is because the noise levels are lower than the weekday rush, and that's probably what's happening now.
blanks.zh: 这是因为那时的噪声水平低于工作日的交通高峰期，而现在很可能也是这种情况。

blanks.en: Here, I've recorded a call of the songbird.
blanks.zh: 这里，我录下了一只鸣禽的叫声。

blanks.en: Listen to see if you can hear the difference.
blanks.zh: 听听看，你能不能听出区别。

blanks.en: Hi, I don't think we've met before.
blanks.zh: 嗨，我想我们以前没见过。

blanks.en: My name is Gina.
blanks.zh: 我叫吉娜。

blanks.en: Nice to meet you.
blanks.zh: 很高兴认识你。

blanks.en: Nice to meet you, Gina.
blanks.zh: 吉娜，很高兴认识你。

blanks.en: Where do you come from?
blanks.zh: 你来自哪里？

blanks.en: Well, originally I'm from Canada.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我原来来自加拿大。

blanks.en: But we moved to Australia when I was about five years old.
blanks.zh: 不过，我大约五岁时，我们搬到了澳大利亚。

blanks.en: Now my parents live in Tokyo.
blanks.zh: 现在我父母住在东京。

blanks.en: How about you, Mike?
blanks.zh: 迈克，你呢？

blanks.en: I was born in Glasgow, and we lived there until I was six.
blanks.zh: 我出生在格拉斯哥，我们在那里一直住到我六岁。

blanks.en: Then, since my father worked for an international trade company, we moved all over the place.
blanks.zh: 后来，因为我父亲在一家国际贸易公司工作，我们就到处搬家。

blanks.en: Where are some of the places you've lived?
blanks.zh: 你都在哪些地方住过呢？

blanks.en: Most of the time we lived abroad.
blanks.zh: 大多数时候，我们都住在国外。

blanks.en: We spent a total of ten years in Japan, Germany, and Korea.
blanks.zh: 我们在日本、德国和韩国一共住了十年。

blanks.en: We came back to the UK only two years ago; but I think my parents would prefer to stay overseas for another twenty years.
blanks.zh: 我们两年前才回到英国；不过我想，我父母更愿意再在海外住二十年。

blanks.en: It sounds like you've had an interesting life.
blanks.zh: 听起来你的人生经历很有趣。

blanks.en: Welcome the space hero, Mr Green, to my studio.
blanks.zh: 欢迎航天英雄格林先生来到我的演播室。

blanks.en: Hello, my dear friends.
blanks.zh: 亲爱的朋友们，大家好。

blanks.en: Well, let's start from the first question I collected from the audience.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我们先从我向观众收集的第一个问题开始吧。

blanks.en: Did you have any moments of dizziness since you landed back on the Earth?
blanks.zh: 回到地球后，你有没有过感到眩晕的时候？

blanks.en: The first three days back were pretty tough.
blanks.zh: 刚回来的前三天相当难熬。

blanks.en: Your body system is all messed up, so you feel dizzy.
blanks.zh: 身体系统全乱了，所以你会感到头晕。

blanks.en: It's quite normal though.
blanks.zh: 不过，这很正常。

blanks.en: Would you go for the first manned Mars travel, if you have the chance?
blanks.zh: 如果有机会，你愿意参加首次载人火星之旅吗？

blanks.en: A trip to Mars is hugely exciting.
blanks.zh: 去火星旅行令人无比兴奋。

blanks.en: I'm always ready for it.
blanks.zh: 我随时准备出发。

blanks.en: I know you can watch movies on the space station.
blanks.zh: 我知道你们可以在空间站看电影。

blanks.en: What's your favorite space movie?
blanks.zh: 你最喜欢哪部太空电影？

blanks.en: Apollo thirteen is probably my top one, and my sons love Blue Earth.
blanks.zh: 《阿波罗十三号》大概是我的首选，我的儿子们则喜欢《蓝色地球》。

blanks.en: It was brilliant watching the new movie on board the space station.
blanks.zh: 在空间站上看那部新电影，感觉太棒了。

blanks.en: Hello, my dear friends.

blanks.en: Our next dress-up day will be on Friday, October twenty-eighth, and it is our annual dress-up day.
blanks.zh: 我们的下一次装扮日定在十月二十八日，星期五，这也是我们一年一度的装扮日。

blanks.en: On this day students may dress up in fun clothes and there will be a march around the school.
blanks.zh: 当天，同学们可以穿上有趣的服装，并将绕学校游行。

blanks.en: Students are reminded not to carry sharp things such as knives and swords.
blanks.zh: 提醒同学们，不要携带刀、剑等尖锐物品。

blanks.en: And please make sure that you can see and breathe easily if you wear masks.
blanks.zh: 如果戴面具，请务必确保自己能看清东西，呼吸顺畅。

blanks.en: Parents are invited to watch the event, but are asked to stand either in front of the office, near the flagpole, or in the grassy courtyard.
blanks.zh: 欢迎家长观看活动，但请站在办公室前方、旗杆附近，或者草坪庭院里。

blanks.en: The students will be marching around on the sidewalks, so we do need to keep all sidewalks clear.
blanks.zh: 学生们会沿人行道绕行，所以我们确实需要让所有人行道保持畅通。

blanks.en: Parents and friends may also join in the march if they are dressed in appropriate clothes.
blanks.zh: 家长和朋友如果穿着合适的服装，也可以加入游行。

blanks.en: But if you're just watching, we'd like to ask you to stay in one spot to reduce traffic jams.
blanks.zh: 不过，如果您只是观看，我们希望您留在同一个地方，以减少人流拥堵。

blanks.en: Students who do not wish to take part in the event for religious or other reasons should inform their teacher, and they will be allowed to stay in the office until after the event.
blanks.zh: 因宗教或其他原因不愿参加活动的学生，应告知老师；这些学生可以留在办公室，直到活动结束。

blanks.en: Thanks for the wonderful weekend, Kate.
blanks.zh: 凯特，谢谢你让我度过了这么愉快的周末。

blanks.en: Bob and I are glad you came to see us.
blanks.zh: 鲍勃和我都很高兴你来探望我们。

blanks.en: Oh, I have to go in.
blanks.zh: 哦，我得进去了。

blanks.en: My flight will take off soon.
blanks.zh: 我的航班很快就要起飞了。

blanks.en: Do contact me when you're in Sydney.
blanks.zh: 你们来悉尼时一定要联系我。

blanks.en: Paul, listen to the radio.
blanks.zh: 保罗，听听收音机。

blanks.en: It's You've Stolen My Heart, one of the songs played at our wedding.
blanks.zh: 是《你偷走了我的心》，我们婚礼上放过的歌之一。

blanks.en: It has been popular for almost two decades.
blanks.zh: 这首歌已经流行了将近二十年。

blanks.en: David, forget about Mark.
blanks.zh: 戴维，别等马克了。

blanks.en: His aunt is in town.
blanks.zh: 他姑妈来城里了。

blanks.en: So he can't go with us today.
blanks.zh: 所以他今天不能和我们一起去了。

blanks.en: Oh, what a pity!
blanks.zh: 哦，真可惜！

blanks.en: It's the last day of the art show.
blanks.zh: 今天是艺术展的最后一天了。

blanks.en: I bought a desk and asked for it to be delivered to my house this Friday.
blanks.zh: 我买了一张书桌，并要求这周五送到我家。

blanks.en: I missed my nine o'clock train to Bedford.
blanks.zh: 我错过了九点开往贝德福德的火车。

blanks.en: Do I have to buy another ticket?
blanks.zh: 我必须再买一张票吗？

blanks.en: The next train leaves at a quarter to ten at platform eleven.
blanks.zh: 下一班火车九点四十五分从十一站台发车。

blanks.en: Honey, have you checked today's weather forecast?
blanks.zh: 亲爱的，你看过今天的天气预报了吗？

blanks.en: Yes, it's cold and wet.
blanks.zh: 看过了，天气又冷又潮湿。

blanks.en: There is a warning for strong winds up to a hundred kilometers per hour.
blanks.zh: 发布了大风预警，风速最高可达每小时一百公里。

blanks.en: There is a risk of falling trees and power lines.
blanks.zh: 树木和电线有倒落的危险。

blanks.en: And the low temperatures could bring snow to the forest area.
blanks.zh: 而且低温可能会让森林地区降雪。

blanks.en: I hope it's over quickly.
blanks.zh: 希望这天气快点过去。

blanks.en: Well, it won't get better until late Wednesday.
blanks.zh: 嗯，要到周三晚些时候天气才会好转。

blanks.en: Anyway, I have to move the car away from the trees.
blanks.zh: 不管怎样，我得把车从树旁边挪开。

blanks.en: Yeah, you cannot be too careful.
blanks.zh: 是啊，再小心也不为过。

blanks.en: This is Kathy from sunny California.
blanks.zh: 我是凯西，在阳光明媚的加利福尼亚给你打电话。

blanks.en: How was the move?
blanks.zh: 搬家怎么样？

blanks.en: Sorry I hadn't called sooner.
blanks.zh: 抱歉，我之前没能早点打电话。

blanks.en: But it's been a busy month.
blanks.zh: 不过，这一个月一直很忙。

blanks.en: We're slowly getting things set up in our new home.
blanks.zh: 我们正慢慢把新家的一切安排妥当。

blanks.en: How are Jeff and the children?
blanks.zh: 杰夫和孩子们怎么样？

blanks.en: Jeff is doing well with his new job.
blanks.zh: 杰夫的新工作做得挺顺利。

blanks.en: Fiona is fine, though she misses her grandma.
blanks.zh: 菲奥娜也挺好，不过她想奶奶了。

blanks.en: By the way, thank you for looking in on my mother from time to time.
blanks.zh: 顺便说一下，谢谢你不时去看望我母亲。

blanks.en: I call her every week, but it isn't the same as seeing her.
blanks.zh: 我每周都给她打电话，但这和亲眼见到她还是不一样。

blanks.en: Betty and I are friends now.
blanks.zh: 贝蒂和我现在已经是朋友了。

blanks.en: How is the weather there?
blanks.zh: 你们那里天气怎么样？

blanks.en: It's nice and warm.
blanks.zh: 天气很好，也很暖和。

blanks.en: And we are able to spend some time every week on the beach with the children.
blanks.zh: 我们每周都能抽出一些时间，和孩子们一起去海滩。

blanks.en: Jack, how did you get to school when you were in primary school?
blanks.zh: 杰克，你上小学的时候是怎么去学校的？

blanks.en: I lived close to my school, so I walked every day.
blanks.zh: 我住得离学校近，所以每天都走路去。

blanks.en: Well, I remember that when we were kids, we often walked, rode a bike, or caught the bus to school.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我记得我们小时候，经常走路、骑自行车或坐公共汽车上学。

blanks.en: Few of us were dropped off at the school gate by our parents.
blanks.zh: 我们当中很少有人由父母开车送到校门口。

blanks.en: I see what you mean.
blanks.zh: 我明白你的意思。

blanks.en: These days you can see traffic jams around schools at drop-off and pick-up times.
blanks.zh: 如今，在送孩子和接孩子的时候，学校周围常常会堵车。

blanks.en: But it's hard to blame the parents.
blanks.zh: 不过，也很难责怪这些父母。

blanks.en: They have good reasons for driving their kids to school, mostly to do with safety and convenience.
blanks.zh: 他们开车送孩子上学有充分的理由，主要与安全和便利有关。

blanks.en: Some parents are just being overprotective, with their children learning nothing but living in fear of everything.
blanks.zh: 有些父母就是保护过度，结果孩子们什么也没学到，却对一切都充满恐惧。

blanks.en: Studies have found that children who spend more time outside tend to be healthier, better-adjusted, and better at dealing with stress.
blanks.zh: 研究发现，在户外待得更多的孩子往往更健康、适应能力更好，也更善于应对压力。

blanks.en: So, Marie, your kitchen garden looks excellent.
blanks.zh: 那么，玛丽，你的家庭菜园看起来很棒。

blanks.en: What made you turn to social media to record your vegetable growing?
blanks.zh: 是什么让你开始用社交媒体记录种菜的过程？

blanks.en: Initially, I used the online platform as a diary, something to look back on, giving me a sense of achievement and keeping me motivated and moving forward.
blanks.zh: 起初，我把这个网络平台当作日记，留下些日后可以回顾的东西，让自己有成就感，也保持动力、继续前进。

blanks.en: As time went by, other gardeners and like-minded people began to follow my progress too.
blanks.zh: 随着时间推移，其他园艺爱好者和志同道合的人也开始关注我的进展。

blanks.en: I know you grow lots of fruit on your land.
blanks.zh: 我知道你在地里种了许多水果。

blanks.en: Which would you recommend to beginners as the best to grow?
blanks.zh: 你会推荐新手种哪一种最合适呢？

blanks.en: Strawberries would be a good choice.
blanks.zh: 草莓会是不错的选择。

blanks.en: They produce a lot of fruit in their first season.
blanks.zh: 它们在第一个生长季就能结出很多果实。

blanks.en: Well, do you have plans to try new or any particular crops next year?
blanks.zh: 那么，明年你有计划尝试新的作物，或者某种特定的作物吗？

blanks.en: Next season I will be adding some pear trees to the fruit area.
blanks.zh: 下个生长季，我会在水果种植区再种一些梨树。

blanks.en: I will be adding more herbs which I can use in the kitchen.
blanks.zh: 我还会多种一些能在做饭时使用的香草。

blanks.en: And, after a couple of years of failure, I will try growing carrots again.
blanks.zh: 而且，在失败了几年之后，我会再次尝试种胡萝卜。

blanks.en: What advice would you offer someone thinking of doing kitchen gardening?
blanks.zh: 对于想种家庭菜园的人，你会给什么建议呢？

blanks.en: Have a plan of what you want your kitchen garden to look like.
blanks.zh: 先规划好你希望家庭菜园是什么样子。

blanks.en: Don't be too discouraged if things don't go according to plan.
blanks.zh: 如果事情没有按计划进行，也不要太灰心。

blanks.en: Learn from your mistakes and move on.
blanks.zh: 从错误中吸取教训，然后继续前进。

blanks.en: There is always next season.
blanks.zh: 毕竟还有下一个生长季。

blanks.en: Welcome to Meet the Author.
blanks.zh: 欢迎收听《与作家见面》。

blanks.en: Well, many readers of Sports Times turn to the last page of their magazine first in order to read Jacob Johnson's weekly article under the title Life of Johnson.
blanks.zh: 嗯，《体育时报》的许多读者拿到杂志后，会先翻到最后一页，阅读雅各布·约翰逊每周撰写的《约翰逊的生活》专栏文章。

blanks.en: The articles, along with his novels and essay collections, have earned Johnson the reputation as one of the funniest humans on the planet.
blanks.zh: 这些文章，加上他的小说和散文集，为约翰逊赢得了“地球上最有趣的人之一”的名声。

blanks.en: Johnson began writing about sports as a second-year student at the University of Colorado, covering high school volleyball games for his hometown newspaper.
blanks.zh: 约翰逊在科罗拉多大学读二年级时，就开始为家乡的报纸报道高中排球比赛，从此从事体育写作。

blanks.en: After graduating in nineteen eighty-one he moved on to work at the Denver Weekly for two years and the Los Angeles Post for two more years before landing at Sports Times.
blanks.zh: 一九八一年毕业后，他先后在《丹佛周刊》和《洛杉矶邮报》各工作了两年，之后才到《体育时报》任职。

blanks.en: He has been voted National Sports Writer of the Year eleven times.
blanks.zh: 他曾十一次被评为全国年度体育作家。

blanks.en: So now let's welcome the funny man with serious talent, Jacob Johnson.
blanks.zh: 那么现在，让我们欢迎这位才华出众的幽默大师——雅各布·约翰逊。

blanks.en: Did you watch the talent show on TV last night?
blanks.zh: 你昨晚看电视上的才艺表演节目了吗？

blanks.en: No, I missed it.
blanks.zh: 没有，我错过了。

blanks.en: I went with my mom to buy some clothes.
blanks.zh: 我跟妈妈一起去买衣服了。

blanks.en: I love this park.
blanks.zh: 我喜欢这座公园。

blanks.en: Shall we stop by the lake for a few minutes?
blanks.zh: 我们要不要在湖边停下来歇几分钟？

blanks.en: Let's go to that cafe for a little refreshment.
blanks.zh: 我们去那家咖啡馆吃喝点东西吧。

blanks.en: Tom, shall we invite the Smiths around for dinner this Sunday?
blanks.zh: 汤姆，这个周日我们请史密斯一家来吃晚饭怎么样？

blanks.en: But I need to pack for Monday's business trip.
blanks.zh: 不过我得为周一的出差收拾行李。

blanks.en: Barbara, do you want to play table tennis with us tonight?
blanks.zh: 芭芭拉，你今晚想和我们一起打乒乓球吗？

blanks.en: I'd love to, but I can't.
blanks.zh: 我很想去，可是去不了。

blanks.en: I'm catching the last train to Denver to see my grandma.
blanks.zh: 我要赶末班火车去丹佛看我奶奶。

blanks.en: I need to take her to visit a doctor tomorrow morning.
blanks.zh: 明天上午我得带她去看医生。

blanks.en: Alex, did you feed the cat this morning?
blanks.zh: 亚历克斯，你今天早上喂猫了吗？

blanks.en: I don't think she can wait.
blanks.zh: 我觉得它等不及了。

blanks.en: All right, after I finish this chapter.
blanks.zh: 好，等我看完这一章就去。

blanks.en: I just can't let go of this book.
blanks.zh: 这本书我实在放不下。

blanks.en: Miss, do you need any help?
blanks.zh: 小姐，需要帮忙吗？

blanks.en: I want to get fit, but exercise doesn't seem to help.
blanks.zh: 我想练得身体健壮一些，但锻炼似乎不管用。

blanks.en: What kind of exercise have you done before?
blanks.zh: 你以前做过哪些锻炼？

blanks.en: I did jogging now and then, but it was so boring, so I changed to weightlifting.
blanks.zh: 我以前偶尔慢跑，但觉得太无聊，就改练举重了。

blanks.en: But it was so demanding, and I was afraid of getting injured, so I went bike riding.
blanks.zh: 可是举重太费劲，我又怕受伤，就改成骑自行车了。

blanks.en: You need to be consistent.
blanks.zh: 你需要坚持下去。

blanks.en: I suggest you do different kinds of exercise on one day, or on different days of the week.
blanks.zh: 我建议你可以在同一天做不同种类的锻炼，也可以把它们安排在一周的不同日子。

blanks.en: This will help hold your interest, so you can keep coming back.
blanks.zh: 这样可以让你保持兴趣，也就能一直坚持来锻炼。

blanks.en: How may I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'd like to book a table for Friday evening.
blanks.zh: 我想订一张周五晚上的餐桌。

blanks.en: How many people are there in your party?
blanks.zh: 您一行一共几位？

blanks.en: And what time would you like to come?
blanks.zh: 您想几点来？

blanks.en: Let's say at six thirty.
blanks.zh: 那就六点半吧。

blanks.en: I'm afraid we don't have anything available then.
blanks.zh: 抱歉，那个时间已经没有空桌了。

blanks.en: We could see you at five thirty or eight o'clock.
blanks.zh: 我们可以在五点半或八点接待您。

blanks.en: Oh, eight o'clock is better.
blanks.zh: 哦，八点更合适。

blanks.en: May I have your name?
blanks.zh: 请问您贵姓？

blanks.en: We'll see you on Friday.
blanks.zh: 那我们周五见。

blanks.en: By the way, we've moved to Howard Street.
blanks.zh: 顺便说一下，我们搬到霍华德街了。

blanks.en: Oh yeah, I know.
blanks.zh: 哦，对，我知道。

blanks.en: How may I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'd like to book a table for Friday evening.
blanks.zh: 我想订一张周五晚上的餐桌。

blanks.en: How many people are there in your party?
blanks.zh: 您一行一共几位？

blanks.en: And what time would you like to come?
blanks.zh: 您想几点来？

blanks.en: Let's say at six thirty.
blanks.zh: 那就六点半吧。

blanks.en: I'm afraid we don't have anything available then.
blanks.zh: 抱歉，那个时间已经没有空桌了。

blanks.en: We could see you at five thirty or eight o'clock.
blanks.zh: 我们可以在五点半或八点接待您。

blanks.en: Oh, eight o'clock is better.
blanks.zh: 哦，八点更合适。

blanks.en: May I have your name?
blanks.zh: 请问您贵姓？

blanks.en: We'll see you on Friday.
blanks.zh: 那我们周五见。

blanks.en: By the way, we've moved to Howard Street.
blanks.zh: 顺便说一下，我们搬到霍华德街了。

blanks.en: Oh yeah, I know.
blanks.zh: 哦，对，我知道。

blanks.en: Jacob, do you have a minute now?
blanks.zh: 雅各布，你现在有空吗？

blanks.en: Well, it's not easy to say, but I have to tell you, you're not in our group for the class project.
blanks.zh: 嗯，这事不太好开口，但我得告诉你，这次课堂项目你没分在我们组。

blanks.en: Sarah, what do you mean?
blanks.zh: 萨拉，你是什么意思？

blanks.en: You know I'm always in a group with you.
blanks.zh: 你知道，我一直都和你一组。

blanks.en: It's just that this time... this time we made the group differently.
blanks.zh: 只是这次……这次我们用了不同的分组方式。

blanks.en: And because you were late, we've already made the group.
blanks.zh: 而且因为你来晚了，我们已经组好队了。

blanks.en: There are four of us already.
blanks.zh: 我们已经有四个人了。

blanks.en: We can't be a group of five?
blanks.zh: 我们不能五个人一组吗？

blanks.en: Well, Professor North said there should be no more than four people in each group.
blanks.zh: 嗯，诺思教授说，每个小组不能超过四个人。

blanks.en: It's not about you or your work or anything like that.
blanks.zh: 这并不是对你或你的工作有什么意见，也没有别的意思。

blanks.en: There is a music concert in Victoria Park at four o'clock.
blanks.zh: 四点钟维多利亚公园有一场音乐会。

blanks.en: Do you want to go?
blanks.zh: 你想去吗？

blanks.en: Professor Darwin's lecture is cancelled.
blanks.zh: 达尔文教授的讲座取消了。

blanks.en: I'm free this evening.
blanks.zh: 我今晚有空。

blanks.en: The band plays pretty good music.
blanks.zh: 那支乐队演奏的音乐很好听。

blanks.en: For the last three years I have never missed it.
blanks.zh: 过去三年，我每年都去听他们的演出。

blanks.en: How long ago did the band start playing in the park?
blanks.zh: 这支乐队多久以前开始来公园演出的？

blanks.en: I think it was five years ago.
blanks.zh: 我想是五年前。

blanks.en: Every year they arrive the first week of July and play for a week.
blanks.zh: 他们每年七月的第一周来这里，连续演出一个星期。

blanks.en: You're sure to enjoy this evening.
blanks.zh: 你今晚一定会听得很开心。

blanks.en: There will be good country music.
blanks.zh: 会有好听的乡村音乐。

blanks.en: My favorite is rock and roll, but I have to say that country music can be quite beautiful sometimes.
blanks.zh: 我最喜欢摇滚乐，不过不得不说，乡村音乐有时也相当动听。

blanks.en: I like all kinds of music, especially jazz.
blanks.zh: 我各种音乐都喜欢，尤其是爵士乐。

blanks.en: Oh, Jannie, we have to go now.
blanks.zh: 哦，珍妮，我们现在就得走了。

blanks.en: There's plenty of time.
blanks.zh: 时间还多着呢。

blanks.en: Many people are heading to the park.
blanks.zh: 很多人正往公园赶。

blanks.en: The traffic will be terrible.
blanks.zh: 路上会堵得很厉害。

blanks.en: All right, but I have to return these books first.
blanks.zh: 好吧，不过我得先把这些书还了。

blanks.en: I'll be waiting for you at the bus station.
blanks.zh: 我会在公交车站等你。

blanks.en: This lesson is a part of our leadership series.
blanks.zh: 这堂课是我们领导力系列课程的一部分。

blanks.en: Let me start by sharing a story of Richard Rochester, one of the most successful businessmen in Britain.
blanks.zh: 我先和大家分享一个理查德·罗切斯特的故事，他是英国最成功的商人之一。

blanks.en: Years ago I was given the task of organizing a conference in the south of England.
blanks.zh: 几年前，我接到一项任务，要在英格兰南部组织一场会议。

blanks.en: I chose a five-star hotel, owned by Rochester, as the venue.
blanks.zh: 我选了一家罗切斯特拥有的五星级酒店作为会场。

blanks.en: Susan, the receptionist, helped me arrange everything perfectly.
blanks.zh: 接待员苏珊帮我把一切都安排得十分妥当。

blanks.en: Once when we were chatting, I asked Susan if she'd ever met Mr. Rochester.
blanks.zh: 有一次我们聊天时，我问苏珊见没见过罗切斯特先生。

blanks.en: Shortly after Mr. Rochester bought the hotel, he made an appointment to see the hotel manager.
blanks.zh: 罗切斯特先生买下酒店后不久，就预约去见酒店经理。

blanks.en: When he arrived, the first person he met was Susan, who was cleaning the carpet.
blanks.zh: 他到酒店时，第一个遇见的人就是苏珊，当时她正在清理地毯。

blanks.en: He chatted with Susan for thirty minutes before keeping his appointment with the manager.
blanks.zh: 他和苏珊聊了三十分钟，之后才按约去见经理。

blanks.en: He spent all day at the hotel, talking with each member of the staff, from the top guy to the lady who cleaned the toilets.
blanks.zh: 他花了一整天在酒店里和每一名员工交谈，从最高负责人到打扫厕所的女士，都聊到了。

blanks.en: Six months later, Mr. Rochester paid another visit.
blanks.zh: 六个月后，罗切斯特先生又来了一次。

blanks.en: Susan had been promoted to receptionist, but he recognized her immediately, and addressed her by name.
blanks.zh: 苏珊那时已经升为接待员，但他立刻就认出了她，还叫出了她的名字。

blanks.en: He even remembered that she had a little girl, and what her name was.
blanks.zh: 他甚至记得她有个小女儿，还记得孩子叫什么。

blanks.en: Now, I don't believe that Richard Rochester has that good a memory.
blanks.zh: 不过，我可不相信理查德·罗切斯特的记性真有那么好。

blanks.en: It's time-consuming, but it shows the importance he places on human relationships.
blanks.zh: 这虽然费时，却表明他十分重视人际关系。

blanks.en: I think that's one of the secrets of his success.
blanks.zh: 我认为这就是他成功的秘诀之一。

blanks.en: How can I assist you?
blanks.zh: 我能为您提供什么帮助？

blanks.en: My computer is giving me a lot of trouble.
blanks.zh: 我的电脑给我添了不少麻烦。

blanks.en: I just need to check on a couple of things.
blanks.zh: 我只需要检查几样东西。

blanks.en: I'd like to have this blouse washed and pressed.
blanks.zh: 我想把这件女式衬衫洗一洗、熨一熨。

blanks.en: Okay, but I'm afraid you won't be able to collect it until next Friday.
blanks.zh: 好的，不过恐怕要到下周五你才能来取。

blanks.en: We've been very busy recently.
blanks.zh: 我们最近一直很忙。

blanks.en: Air travel’s more tiring than driving, I'm sure.
blanks.zh: 我敢说，坐飞机比开车还累。

blanks.en: I don't think you'd say that if you'd just driven four hundred miles.
blanks.zh: 如果你刚开了四百英里的车，我想你就不会这么说了。

blanks.en: Let's come to Seattle by train next time.
blanks.zh: 下次我们坐火车来西雅图吧。

blanks.en: It'll be more relaxing.
blanks.zh: 那样会更轻松。

blanks.en: Can I have fried rice or noodles for dinner for a change?
blanks.zh: 晚饭我能换个口味，吃炒饭或者面条吗？

blanks.en: I don't feel like steak today.
blanks.zh: 我今天不想吃牛排。

blanks.en: I'm in a hurry.
blanks.zh: 我赶时间。

blanks.en: I can't cook two different meals today.
blanks.zh: 我今天没法做两种不同的饭菜。

blanks.en: Tomorrow you can have what you want.
blanks.zh: 明天你想吃什么都行。

blanks.en: I'm just so down with writing this report.
blanks.zh: 写这份报告真让我心情低落。

blanks.en: And I've got to present it in class tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 而且我明天还得在课堂上作报告。

blanks.en: Richard, why are you taking everything out of your drawer?
blanks.zh: 理查德，你为什么把抽屉里的东西都拿出来？

blanks.en: I'm looking for a stamp, Sarah.
blanks.zh: 萨拉，我在找一枚邮票。

blanks.en: What do you want a stamp for?
blanks.zh: 你要邮票干什么？

blanks.en: I've written a letter to Aunt Vera, and I want to put it in the post before midday.
blanks.zh: 我给薇拉姑妈写了封信，想在中午之前寄出去。

blanks.en: Can't you just email her?
blanks.zh: 你就不能给她发电子邮件吗？

blanks.en: Yeah, but it's her seventieth birthday.
blanks.zh: 可以，不过这次是她七十岁生日。

blanks.en: Vera will be happy to get a real letter with a real birthday card.
blanks.zh: 收到真正的信和生日贺卡，薇拉一定会很高兴。

blanks.en: Could I speak with you for a few minutes?
blanks.zh: 我能和您谈几分钟吗？

blanks.en: Well, I was sick for two weeks, so I didn't take the midterm exam.
blanks.zh: 是这样的，我病了两个星期，所以没参加期中考试。

blanks.en: Could you give me another test?
blanks.zh: 您能让我再考一次吗？

blanks.en: You can take it next Thursday afternoon.
blanks.zh: 你可以下周四下午来考。

blanks.en: Thank you so much, Professor Brooks.
blanks.zh: 非常感谢您，布鲁克斯教授。

blanks.en: Could I come to you at three thirty after my English literature class?
blanks.zh: 我能在英语文学课结束后的三点半来找您吗？

blanks.en: Linda, you work on plays and shows, but you're not on stage.
blanks.zh: 琳达，你参与戏剧和演出工作，但不上台表演。

blanks.en: What do you do?
blanks.zh: 你是做什么工作的？

blanks.en: I'm a costume designer.
blanks.zh: 我是服装设计师。

blanks.en: I help the actors become their characters.
blanks.zh: 我帮助演员变成他们所扮演的角色。

blanks.en: Is it kind of like playing dress-up?
blanks.zh: 这有点像玩换装游戏吗？

blanks.en: But I need to study the play to create the characters' clothes, not just use my imagination.
blanks.zh: 但我得研究剧本，才能设计出角色的服装，不能只凭自己的想象。

blanks.en: How do you do that?
blanks.zh: 你具体怎么做呢？

blanks.en: I read the play and do research about the time and place of the story.
blanks.zh: 我先读剧本，再研究故事发生的时间和地点。

blanks.en: If the story is set in the past, I might study old magazines or paintings.
blanks.zh: 如果故事发生在过去，我可能会研究旧杂志或绘画。

blanks.en: For plays set now, I sometimes collect pictures of people on the street.
blanks.zh: 如果剧作以当下为背景，我有时会收集街头人们的照片。

blanks.en: I take my ideas and pictures to the director of the show.
blanks.zh: 我会把自己的想法和图片带给这部戏的导演。

blanks.en: We talk about whether I'm on the right track.
blanks.zh: 我们会讨论我的思路是否正确。

blanks.en: If it's good, we will hire a tailor to make the costume.
blanks.zh: 如果方案不错，我们就雇裁缝把戏服做出来。

blanks.en: Is it finished, then?
blanks.zh: 那就完成了吗？

blanks.en: We still need to try it on the actor to make sure everything fits and looks good.
blanks.zh: 我们还要让演员试穿，确保衣服合身、效果好看。

blanks.en: It takes so many steps to make a costume.
blanks.zh: 做一套戏服竟然要这么多步骤。

blanks.en: I just got back from the art gallery.
blanks.zh: 我刚从美术馆回来。

blanks.en: There is a wonderful show of abstract art.
blanks.zh: 那里有一场很精彩的抽象艺术展。

blanks.en: You should have come with me.
blanks.zh: 你真该跟我一起去的。

blanks.en: Abstract art seems like children's painting to me.
blanks.zh: 在我看来，抽象艺术就像小孩子的画。

blanks.en: Well, if you don't understand what the artist is trying to communicate, it can seem a little like that.
blanks.zh: 嗯，如果你不明白艺术家想表达什么，确实可能会有那种感觉。

blanks.en: There were two paintings that impressed me most.
blanks.zh: 有两幅画给我留下了最深的印象。

blanks.en: The first was a huge one, which I suppose was a tree, although it could have been anything.
blanks.zh: 第一幅很大，我猜画的是一棵树，不过也有可能是别的任何东西。

blanks.en: Just the way the tree looked.
blanks.zh: 就是那棵树呈现出来的样子。

blanks.en: It was like the tree was made of hard metal, and the mix of white and gray made everything look like it was winter—freezing winter.
blanks.zh: 那棵树仿佛是坚硬的金属做的，白色和灰色混在一起，让一切看上去都像冬天——冰冷刺骨的冬天。

blanks.en: What about the other one?
blanks.zh: 另一幅呢？

blanks.en: The second looked like a piece of grassland.
blanks.zh: 第二幅看着像一片草地。

blanks.en: All the grass was purple and red, and there was green sky in the background.
blanks.zh: 所有的草都是紫色和红色的，背景中的天空却是绿色的。

blanks.en: I looked at it and thought of summer.
blanks.zh: 我看着它，就想到了夏天。

blanks.en: Hmm, your description really teaches me something about appreciating abstract art.
blanks.zh: 嗯，你的描述真让我学到了一些欣赏抽象艺术的方法。

blanks.en: You are watching the morning news.
blanks.zh: 您正在收看早间新闻。

blanks.en: Sydney and the New South Wales coast have been hit by heavy rains.
blanks.zh: 悉尼和新南威尔士州沿海地区遭遇了强降雨。

blanks.en: Major roads, the airport, trains and buses were all thrown behind schedule, as more than a month's worth of rain fell in just one hour during the morning rush.
blanks.zh: 早高峰期间，仅一个小时的降雨量就超过了通常一个月的总量，主要道路、机场、火车和公共汽车都因此出现延误。

blanks.en: All traffic into Sydney remains very heavy.
blanks.zh: 所有进入悉尼的道路交通仍然十分拥堵。

blanks.en: Pittwater Road is closed due to a car crash.
blanks.zh: 皮特沃特路因车祸而封闭。

blanks.en: Consider using Wicks Road instead.
blanks.zh: 请考虑改走威克斯路。

blanks.en: A police officer has been hurt assisting drivers in North Ryde.
blanks.zh: 一名警察在北赖德协助司机时受了伤。

blanks.en: A woman is believed to have broken her leg after a tree fell on her car.
blanks.zh: 一名女子的汽车被倒下的树砸中，据信她的腿骨折了。

blanks.en: The roof of Town Hall Station has fallen in, causing delays for passengers.
blanks.zh: 市政厅站的屋顶坍塌，导致乘客出行延误。

blanks.en: The rain is expected to be at its heaviest from nine a.m. until eleven a.m.
blanks.zh: 预计上午九点到十一点之间雨势最强。

blanks.en: Today a total of up to two hundred millimeters of rain is being forecast, along with damaging winds of more than ninety kilometers per hour to follow.
blanks.zh: 预报今天总降雨量最高可达两百毫米，随后还会有时速超过九十公里、具有破坏力的大风。

blanks.en: All road users are advised to reconsider the need to be on the roads in such wild weather, and reschedule their day, and continue on their journey after the rain stops.
blanks.zh: 建议所有道路使用者重新考虑是否有必要在这种恶劣天气下出行，调整当天的安排，等雨停后再继续行程。

blanks.en: You finally became a game designer.
blanks.zh: 你终于当上游戏设计师了。

blanks.en: What does your family think of your new job?
blanks.zh: 家里人怎么看你的新工作？

blanks.en: They are glad I have realized my dream.
blanks.zh: 他们很高兴我实现了梦想。

blanks.en: Sue, where's my jacket?
blanks.zh: 苏，我的夹克在哪儿？

blanks.en: Anyway, what do you expect if you leave your things all around the house?
blanks.zh: 反正，你把东西丢得满屋都是，还指望怎样呢？

blanks.en: Jane, are you enjoying this year's best seller?
blanks.zh: 简，你喜欢今年这本畅销书吗？

blanks.en: The plots seem complicated.
blanks.zh: 情节看起来挺复杂。

blanks.en: I found it a bit difficult to get into, but now that I'm past the first few chapters I can't put it down.
blanks.zh: 我一开始觉得有点读不进去，不过现在读过前几章后，就再也放不下了。

blanks.en: Kathy, I am excited about this afternoon's lecture on Beijing Opera.
blanks.zh: 凯西，我很期待今天下午关于京剧的讲座。

blanks.en: It's this morning, only an hour away.
blanks.zh: 讲座是今天上午，再过一个小时就开始了。

blanks.en: That's the paper-cutting exhibition in the afternoon.
blanks.zh: 下午那个是剪纸展。

blanks.en: I found this phone in the canteen.
blanks.zh: 我在食堂捡到了这部手机。

blanks.en: Its case says Linda, so I thought it might be yours.
blanks.zh: 手机壳上写着“琳达”，所以我想可能是你的。

blanks.en: Yes, that's a weight off my mind.
blanks.zh: 是的，这下我可放心了。

blanks.en: Dad, I am running a marathon next Sunday.
blanks.zh: 爸爸，我下星期日要跑马拉松。

blanks.en: I wonder if you'd like to sponsor me.
blanks.zh: 我想问问，你愿不愿意赞助我？

blanks.en: Dave, you're not taking any time off work for your honeymoon, are you?
blanks.zh: 戴夫，你不打算请假去度蜜月，是吗？

blanks.en: I know how busy we are at the moment.
blanks.zh: 我知道我们眼下有多忙。

blanks.en: There is no room left in my suitcase.
blanks.zh: 我的行李箱已经没有空间了。

blanks.en: I still have shoes to pack.
blanks.zh: 我还有鞋子要装。

blanks.en: Fold your clothes properly, and you can maximize the amount you can store.
blanks.zh: 把衣服叠整齐，就能尽可能多装些东西。

blanks.en: I've persuaded my brother to see the circus show with me next week.
blanks.zh: 我说服了我的兄弟，下周和我一起去看马戏表演。

blanks.en: You two finally agreed on something.
blanks.zh: 你们俩总算在一件事上达成一致了。

blanks.en: I wonder how my grandchildren are doing.
blanks.zh: 我想知道孙辈们过得怎么样。

blanks.en: I haven't seen them in ages.
blanks.zh: 我很久没见过他们了。

blanks.en: Why don't you just head off to see how they are?
blanks.zh: 你干脆动身去看看他们怎么样，不就行了？

blanks.en: After each passage or conversation, you will be asked several questions.
blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话后，都会提出几个问题。

blanks.en: The passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
blanks.zh: 短文和对话会读两遍，但问题只读一遍。

blanks.en: When you hear a question, read the four possible answers on your paper and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
blanks.zh: 听到一个问题后，请阅读试卷上的四个备选答案，选出最能回答所听问题的一项。

blanks.en: Across the UK, a group of volunteer motorcyclists is helping hospitals by delivering blood.
blanks.zh: 在英国各地，一群骑摩托车的志愿者通过运送血液来帮助医院。

blanks.en: Angela Brown is one of them.
blanks.zh: 安杰拉·布朗就是其中一员。

blanks.en: She is on call for 80 hours each month.
blanks.zh: 她每个月要待命八十个小时。

blanks.en: At very short notice, she can be woken in the night and find herself riding a motorbike with a vital delivery for a hospital.
blanks.zh: 接到临时通知后，她可能半夜就被叫醒，骑摩托车为医院运送至关重要的物资。

blanks.en: But she's not an employee of any hospital.
blanks.zh: 但她并不是任何一家医院的员工。

blanks.en: She's just a volunteer, one of the 1,400 advanced qualified riders of the Association of Blood Bikers.
blanks.zh: 她只是一名志愿者，是送血骑手协会一千四百名具备高级驾驶资质的骑手之一。

blanks.en: Last year, the Association's bikers responded to around 35,000 rapid transport requests from 262 UK hospitals.
blanks.zh: 去年，协会的骑手回应了来自英国二百六十二家医院的大约三万五千次紧急运送请求。

blanks.en: Besides blood, the bikers also deliver surgical tools and medicine.
blanks.zh: 除了血液，骑手们还运送手术器械和药品。

blanks.en: Brown first discovered blood biking when she was on a course at the Institute of Advanced Motorists.
blanks.zh: 布朗最初是在高级驾驶员协会参加课程时，了解到骑摩托车送血这件事的。

blanks.en: Her trainer, who himself was a blood biker, warned that their training ride might be stopped if he was called away.
blanks.zh: 她的教练本人就是一名送血骑手，他提醒说，一旦自己临时被叫走，他们的训练骑行就可能中断。

blanks.en: Under his influence, Brown started volunteering as a rider.
blanks.zh: 在他的影响下，布朗开始自愿担任骑手。

blanks.en: She later discovered that blood bikers once helped her own nephew, Peter.
blanks.zh: 她后来发现，送血骑手们也曾帮助过她自己的侄子彼得。

blanks.en: He received blood delivered by a rider on New Year's Eve, 2015.
blanks.zh: 二〇一五年的跨年夜，他收到了骑手送来的血液。

blanks.en: Brown says being a blood biker is a way of helping the community and being on the bike at the same time.
blanks.zh: 布朗说，做送血骑手既能帮助社区，又能骑摩托车。

blanks.en: Across the UK, a group of volunteer motorcyclists is helping hospitals by delivering blood.
blanks.zh: 在英国各地，一群骑摩托车的志愿者通过运送血液来帮助医院。

blanks.en: Angela Brown is one of them.
blanks.zh: 安杰拉·布朗就是其中一员。

blanks.en: She is on call for 80 hours each month.
blanks.zh: 她每个月要待命八十个小时。

blanks.en: At very short notice, she can be woken in the night and find herself riding a motorbike with a vital delivery for a hospital.
blanks.zh: 接到临时通知后，她可能半夜就被叫醒，骑摩托车为医院运送至关重要的物资。

blanks.en: But she's not an employee of any hospital.
blanks.zh: 但她并不是任何一家医院的员工。

blanks.en: She's just a volunteer, one of 1,400 advanced qualified riders of the Association of Blood Bikers.
blanks.zh: 她只是一名志愿者，是送血骑手协会一千四百名具备高级驾驶资质的骑手之一。

blanks.en: Last year, the association's bikers responded to around 35,000 rapid transport requests from 262 UK hospitals.
blanks.zh: 去年，协会的骑手回应了来自英国二百六十二家医院的大约三万五千次紧急运送请求。

blanks.en: Besides blood, the bikers also deliver surgical tools and medicine.
blanks.zh: 除了血液，骑手们还运送手术器械和药品。

blanks.en: Brown first discovered blood biking when she was on a course at the Institute of Advanced Motorists.
blanks.zh: 布朗最初是在高级驾驶员协会参加课程时，了解到骑摩托车送血这件事的。

blanks.zh: 这篇讲话主要讲了什么？

blanks.en: How many advanced qualified riders does the Association of Blood Bikers have?
blanks.zh: 送血骑手协会有多少名具备高级驾驶资质的骑手？
