blanks.zh: 从讲话中能了解到关于安杰拉·布朗的什么情况？

blanks.en: Wearable devices are not just for humans anymore.
blanks.zh: 可穿戴设备已经不只供人使用了。

blanks.en: A growing range of electronic collars and cameras can help you monitor your pet's activity and even emotional state.
blanks.zh: 种类日益增多的电子项圈和摄像头，可以帮助你监测宠物的活动，甚至情绪状态。

blanks.en: Was your cat happy?
blanks.zh: 你的猫之前开心吗？

blanks.en: How much exactly did your dog eat today?
blanks.zh: 你的狗今天到底吃了多少？

blanks.en: Knowing the answers to such questions is becoming ever easier.
blanks.zh: 现在，要知道这类问题的答案，正变得越来越容易。

blanks.en: This week, the insurance group ASA invested in a company called All4Pet, which makes the PetMe, a wearable activity monitor for dogs.
blanks.zh: 本周，保险集团ASA投资了一家名为All4Pet的公司，这家公司生产供狗使用的可穿戴活动监测器PetMe。

blanks.en: The PetMe can feed back information on a dog's activity level and food intake.
blanks.zh: PetMe可以反馈狗的活动水平和食物摄入量的信息。

blanks.en: And healthier dogs may earn their owners a lower pet insurance fee.
blanks.zh: 更健康的狗还可能让主人少交一些宠物保险费。

blanks.en: According to Andy Wells, the chief designer of the PetMe, there are a lot of challenges with dogs now.
blanks.zh: PetMe的首席设计师安迪·韦尔斯说，现在狗面临很多问题。

blanks.en: He says about four million out of nine million dogs in our country are too fat.
blanks.zh: 他说，我国九百万只狗中，大约有四百万只过胖。

blanks.en: And about 25% are left home alone.
blanks.zh: 还有大约百分之二十五的狗被独自留在家里。

blanks.en: So pet care is worsening.
blanks.zh: 所以，宠物受到的照料正在变差。

blanks.en: Meanwhile, bills from pet doctors are rising each year, and so are insurance fees.
blanks.zh: 与此同时，宠物看病的费用年年上涨，保险费也一样。

blanks.en: Our purpose is to help owners keep their dogs fit and active in a fun way, which also helps insurance companies lower their costs.
blanks.zh: 我们的目的是帮助主人用有趣的方式，让狗保持健康、活跃，同时也帮助保险公司降低成本。

blanks.en: Our company, All4Pet, is using this data to build a database on dogs so we can understand what makes one dog healthy and another overweight, why certain conditions affect some dogs more than others.
blanks.zh: 我们All4Pet公司正利用这些数据建立犬类数据库，以了解为什么有的狗健康，有的却超重，以及为什么某些疾病对一些狗的影响比对另一些更大。

blanks.zh: 从讲话中能了解到关于PetMe的什么信息？

blanks.en: Why is the company All4Pet building a database on dogs?
blanks.zh: All4Pet公司为什么要建立犬类数据库？

blanks.en: What is the talk mainly about?
blanks.zh: 这篇讲话主要讲了什么？

blanks.en: Did you do anything special on Saturday?
blanks.zh: 你星期六做了什么特别的事吗？

blanks.en: I spent the whole morning driving around to yard sales.
blanks.zh: 我整个上午都在开车四处逛庭院旧货摊。

blanks.en: Yard sales? I seem to have seen the signs that say “yard sale” along the street.
blanks.zh: 庭院旧货出售？我好像在路边见过写着“庭院出售旧货”的牌子。

blanks.en: People often take out the things they don't need any more and sell them in their yards.
blanks.zh: 人们常把不再需要的东西拿出来，在自家院子里出售。

blanks.en: I like this idea.
blanks.zh: 我喜欢这个主意。

blanks.en: What did you buy?
blanks.zh: 你买了什么？

blanks.en: I got some real treasures: a toy train, a pretty new tablet, and a fridge.
blanks.zh: 我淘到了一些好东西：一辆玩具火车、一台挺新的平板电脑，还有一台冰箱。

blanks.en: Wow, what else was on sale?
blanks.zh: 哇，还卖些什么？

blanks.en: My friend bought a silver ring.
blanks.zh: 我的朋友买了一枚银戒指。

blanks.en: What times are the sales?
blanks.zh: 这些旧货摊什么时候开卖？

blanks.en: That's pretty early for shopping.
blanks.zh: 对购物来说，这可够早的。

blanks.en: It is, but you have to be an early bird to get good stuff.
blanks.zh: 是啊，不过想淘到好东西，就得做个早起的人。

blanks.en: I'll have to set my alarm early then.
blanks.zh: 那我得把闹钟设早一点了。

blanks.en: It'll be worth it if you find some good buys.
blanks.zh: 如果能淘到划算的东西，就值了。

blanks.en: I'd like to have a try.
blanks.zh: 我想试一试。

blanks.en: I'll watch for the signs on the lamp posts.
blanks.zh: 我会留意路灯杆上的那些牌子。

blanks.en: I'll look in newspapers this Friday.
blanks.zh: 我会看看这星期五的报纸。

blanks.en: If I see any good sale ads for this weekend, I'll let you know.
blanks.zh: 如果看到本周末有什么好的旧货出售广告，我会告诉你的。

blanks.zh: 说话者主要在谈论什么？

blanks.en: What did the man buy on Saturday?
blanks.zh: 男士星期六买了什么？

blanks.en: What does the man suggest the woman do to find some good stuff at yard sales?
blanks.zh: 男士建议女士怎样在庭院旧货摊上找到好东西？

blanks.en: What will the man turn to for information about this weekend's yard sales?
blanks.zh: 男士会到哪里查找本周末庭院旧货出售的信息？

blanks.en: Mrs. Wang, would you please tell me on which day the letters are delivered, and what time does the milkman call?
blanks.zh: 王太太，请问信件是星期几送来，送奶工又是什么时候来呢？

blanks.en: The postman will be here every Thursday afternoon.
blanks.zh: 邮递员每周四下午都会来。

blanks.en: The milk comes every morning at around six.
blanks.zh: 牛奶每天早上六点左右送来。

blanks.en: So all the houses are equipped with a dishwasher and a dryer?
blanks.zh: 这么说，所有房子都配有洗碗机和烘干机？

blanks.en: Right, and also the kitchen appliances.
blanks.zh: 对，还有厨房电器。

blanks.en: But I'm afraid you are responsible for your own lamps.
blanks.zh: 不过，恐怕灯具得由你自己准备。

blanks.en: Why have you chosen a rabbit instead of, let's say, a dog or a cat as your pet?
blanks.zh: 你为什么选兔子做宠物，而不是比方说狗或猫呢？

blanks.en: I can't stand walking dogs.
blanks.zh: 我受不了遛狗。

blanks.en: Cats may suit my lifestyle more, but rabbits are my favourite.
blanks.zh: 猫或许更适合我的生活方式，但兔子是我的最爱。

blanks.en: Reception. May I help you?
blanks.zh: 这里是前台。有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: This is Lee in room 215.
blanks.zh: 我是215房间的李。

blanks.en: The people in the next room are playing music too loud and I can't sleep.
blanks.zh: 隔壁房间的人音乐放得太响了，我没法睡觉。

blanks.en: I've registered for a guitar class.
blanks.zh: 我已经报名参加了吉他课。

blanks.en: I'll take up French cooking, find a new job, and no more chocolates.
blanks.zh: 我打算学法式烹饪，找份新工作，再也不吃巧克力了。

blanks.en: What do you think of joining a book club?
blanks.zh: 你觉得加入读书俱乐部怎么样？

blanks.en: If we join one, we can keep up with all the latest books.
blanks.zh: 如果加入一个，我们就能及时了解所有最新的书。

blanks.en: It isn't any more expensive than going to a movie.
blanks.zh: 这并不比去看电影更贵。

blanks.en: Should I go on a diet?
blanks.zh: 我该节食吗？

blanks.en: You'd better eat more natural food rather than packaged food.
blanks.zh: 你最好多吃天然食物，而不是包装食品。

blanks.en: Snack on vegetable sticks instead of chips.
blanks.zh: 吃点蔬菜条当零食，别吃薯片。

blanks.en: Doesn't it strike you as odd that our spring outing will be put off till the end of this month?
blanks.zh: 我们春游要推迟到这个月底，你不觉得这很奇怪吗？

blanks.en: How was the fireworks show last night?
blanks.zh: 昨晚的烟花表演怎么样？

blanks.en: I really didn't enjoy it.
blanks.zh: 我真的没觉得好看。

blanks.en: There was such a big crowd that we couldn't get very close, even though we got there an hour before it started.
blanks.zh: 人太多了，我们没法靠得很近，虽然我们在开始前一小时就到了。

blanks.en: I'll be promoted to editor-in-chief, but I wonder whether I'm a good fit.
blanks.zh: 我就要升任主编了，但我不知道自己是否合适。

blanks.en: Come on, you deserve it.
blanks.zh: 别这样想，你当之无愧。

blanks.en: Your work has been valued all these years.
blanks.zh: 这些年来，你的工作一直受到重视。

blanks.en: After each passage or conversation, you will be asked several questions.
blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话之后，你会听到几个问题。

blanks.en: The passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
blanks.zh: 短文和对话会播放两遍，但问题只读一遍。

blanks.en: When you hear a question, read the four possible answers on your paper and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
blanks.zh: 听到问题后，阅读试卷上的四个备选答案，选出你所听到的问题的最佳答案。

blanks.en: When people think of life in Europe hundreds of years ago, they often think of castles built of stones with huge towers.
blanks.zh: 人们想到几百年前欧洲的生活时，常会想到那些用石头建成、带有巨大塔楼的城堡。

blanks.en: The kitchen, a very important place in a castle, was usually located a good distance away from other castle rooms and buildings, especially the great hall, which was a large room where people gathered for meals and other activities.
blanks.zh: 厨房是城堡中非常重要的地方，通常设在离其他房间和建筑相当远的地方，尤其远离人们聚餐和进行其他活动的大厅。

blanks.en: This was because of the danger of fires.
blanks.zh: 这是因为有发生火灾的危险。

blanks.en: The kitchen staff needed to use fire for cooking.
blanks.zh: 厨房工作人员需要用火做饭。

blanks.en: But since the kitchen was busy all day and every day, sometimes kitchen fires grew out of control and could spread to other parts of the castle.
blanks.zh: 但厨房天天从早忙到晚，有时炉火会失控，并可能蔓延到城堡的其他地方。

blanks.en: Each kitchen also had a garden where vegetables were grown.
blanks.zh: 每个厨房还都有一座种植蔬菜的菜园。

blanks.en: Back then, food could not be kept in refrigerators like today.
blanks.zh: 那时不能像今天一样用冰箱储存食物。

blanks.en: Some vegetables could be stored underground, but not for long, so most vegetables were picked fresh from the castle garden as they were needed.
blanks.zh: 有些蔬菜可以储存在地下，但放不了太久，所以大部分蔬菜都是需要时才从城堡菜园里现摘的。

blanks.en: But, of course, dinner in the castle consisted of many other things like bread, meat and fish.
blanks.zh: 当然，城堡里的晚餐还包括面包、肉和鱼等许多其他食物。

blanks.en: So to prepare a full meal, many cooks were needed.
blanks.zh: 所以，要准备一顿完整的饭菜，需要很多厨师。

blanks.en: The castle kitchen employed a whole team of people.
blanks.zh: 城堡厨房雇用了一整队人。

blanks.en: Some of them made bread, and others prepared desserts or cooked meat dishes.
blanks.zh: 有些人烤面包，另一些人做甜点或肉菜。

blanks.en: When people think of life in Europe hundreds of years ago, they often think of castles built of stones with huge towers.
blanks.zh: 人们想到几百年前欧洲的生活时，常会想到那些用石头建成、带有巨大塔楼的城堡。

blanks.en: The kitchen, a very important place in a castle, was usually located a good distance away from other castle rooms and buildings, especially the great hall, which was a large room where people gathered for meals and other activities.
blanks.zh: 厨房是城堡中非常重要的地方，通常设在离其他房间和建筑相当远的地方，尤其远离人们聚餐和进行其他活动的大厅。

blanks.en: This was because of the danger of fires.
blanks.zh: 这是因为有发生火灾的危险。

blanks.en: The kitchen staff needed to use fire for cooking.
blanks.zh: 厨房工作人员需要用火做饭。

blanks.en: But since the kitchen was busy all day and every day, sometimes kitchen fires grew out of control and could spread to other parts of the castle.
blanks.zh: 但厨房天天从早忙到晚，有时炉火会失控，并可能蔓延到城堡的其他地方。

blanks.en: Each kitchen also had a garden where vegetables were grown.
blanks.zh: 每个厨房还都有一座种植蔬菜的菜园。

blanks.en: Back then, food could not be kept in refrigerators like today.
blanks.zh: 那时不能像今天一样用冰箱储存食物。

blanks.en: Some vegetables could be stored underground, but not for long so most vegetables were picked fresh from the castle garden as they were needed.
blanks.zh: 有些蔬菜可以储存在地下，但放不了太久，所以大部分蔬菜都是需要时才从城堡菜园里现摘的。

blanks.en: But, of course, dinner in the castle consisted of many other things like bread, meat and fish.
blanks.zh: 当然，城堡里的晚餐还包括面包、肉和鱼等许多其他食物。

blanks.en: So to prepare a full meal, many cooks were needed.
blanks.zh: 所以，要准备一顿完整的饭菜，需要很多厨师。

blanks.en: The castle kitchen employed a whole team of people.
blanks.zh: 城堡厨房雇用了一整队人。

blanks.en: Some of them made bread, and others prepared desserts or cooked meat dishes.
blanks.zh: 有些人烤面包，另一些人做甜点或肉菜。

blanks.en: Why was the kitchen located far away from other castle rooms and buildings?
blanks.zh: 为什么厨房要设在远离城堡其他房间和建筑的地方？

blanks.en: What can be learned about the vegetables for meals in the castle?
blanks.zh: 关于城堡里做饭用的蔬菜，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.en: What is the talk mainly about?
blanks.zh: 这段讲话主要讲什么？

blanks.en: Digital advertising is booming and this year it has become a $72 billion industry.
blanks.zh: 数字广告蓬勃发展，今年已成为一个规模达720亿美元的行业。

blanks.en: For the first time, more money has been spent on it than on TV ads.
blanks.zh: 投在数字广告上的钱首次超过了电视广告。

blanks.en: The explanation is simple.
blanks.zh: 原因很简单。

blanks.en: Online video ads are growing both in popularity for consumers and effectiveness for brands.
blanks.zh: 原因是，网络视频广告越来越受消费者欢迎，也越来越能为品牌带来效果。

blanks.en: To make video advertising easier for you, we published a new e-book, A Guide to Online Video Advertising, which features an in-depth look at the growing trends and the best opportunities for marketers.
blanks.zh: 为了让你们更轻松地开展视频广告业务，我们出版了一本新的电子书《网络视频广告指南》，深入介绍不断发展的趋势和营销人员的最佳机遇。

blanks.en: In general, people are watching more video than ever on their smartphones and tablets to consume content.
blanks.zh: 总的来说，人们用智能手机和平板电脑观看视频、获取内容的时间比以往任何时候都多。

blanks.en: Increasingly, consumers are turning their attention away from TV screens and toward digital brand messaging in the form of videos.
blanks.zh: 消费者正越来越多地将注意力从电视屏幕转向以视频形式传播的数字品牌信息。

blanks.en: Online video ads have proven to be more engaging than traditional TV buys, as viewers report heightened emotional response and a greater likelihood of taking action.
blanks.zh: 网络视频广告已被证明比传统电视广告投放更能吸引观众，因为观众表示，他们的情感反应更强，也更有可能采取行动。

blanks.en: In fact, young viewers show greater emotional engagement towards brand messages than non-branded content.
blanks.zh: 事实上，与非品牌内容相比，年轻观众对品牌信息的情感投入更深。

blanks.en: This means that with brand messages, online video ads may produce a better emotional effect on the audience.
blanks.zh: 这意味着，带有品牌信息的网络视频广告可能对观众产生更好的情感影响。

blanks.en: So it is crucial for advertisers to develop a strategy for effectively and efficiently reaching audiences across multiple devices.
blanks.zh: 因此，广告主必须制定策略，通过多种设备有效、高效地触达观众，这一点至关重要。

blanks.zh: 下列哪一项是数字广告发展成为庞大行业的原因之一？

blanks.zh: 这段讲话主要讲什么？

blanks.en: Jane, it's already eight o'clock.
blanks.zh: 简，已经八点了。

blanks.en: Why are you still in the office?
blanks.zh: 你怎么还在办公室？

blanks.en: I just don't want to go back to my apartment yet.
blanks.zh: 我只是还不想回公寓。

blanks.en: Well, it's because of the girl I share my apartment with.
blanks.zh: 嗯，是因为和我合租公寓的那个女孩。

blanks.en: You mean Mary, your friend since college?
blanks.zh: 你是说玛丽，你大学时就认识的朋友？

blanks.en: It's just some small things that make me feel bad.
blanks.zh: 就是一些小事让我心里不舒服。

blanks.en: She forgets to close the fridge door after taking a cold drink.
blanks.zh: 她拿了冷饮后总忘记关冰箱门。

blanks.en: And she never cares to take the garbage out or fetch the mails.
blanks.zh: 她也从来不主动倒垃圾、取信件。

blanks.en: Well, if I were you, I would talk to Mary about what's bothering me.
blanks.zh: 嗯，如果我是你，就会和玛丽谈谈让我烦心的事。

blanks.en: We've been friends for years.
blanks.zh: 我们已经是多年的朋友了。

blanks.en: Are you afraid you will offend her or something?
blanks.zh: 你是怕冒犯她之类的吗？

blanks.en: I still want to be friends with her.
blanks.zh: 我还是想和她做朋友。

blanks.en: Better to get things out in the open.
blanks.zh: 最好还是把事情摆到明面上说。

blanks.en: It's likely that she is just unaware of it.
blanks.zh: 她很可能只是没有意识到。

blanks.en: If you don't talk to her about how you feel, you could end up going your separate ways.
blanks.zh: 如果你不告诉她你的感受，你们最后可能会分道扬镳。

blanks.en: I'll think about it.
blanks.zh: 我会考虑的。

blanks.en: Eighteen. What can be learned about Mary?
blanks.zh: 第十八题。关于玛丽，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.en: Why does Jane choose not to talk to Mary about her thoughts?
blanks.zh: 简为什么选择不把自己的想法告诉玛丽？

blanks.en: What does the man suggest Jane do?
blanks.zh: 男士建议简做什么？

blanks.en: Could you please tell me how I can get to the student dorm building?
blanks.zh: 您能告诉我怎么去学生宿舍楼吗？

blanks.en: Turn left when you walk out of this register office, pass the bookstore, and you'll see it.
blanks.zh: 走出这间注册办公室后向左转，经过书店，就能看到了。

blanks.en: We couldn't ask for a better day, could we, Barbara?
blanks.zh: 芭芭拉，天气好得不能再好了，是吧？
blanks.answer: couldn't ask for a better day

blanks.en: There isn't a cloud in the sky.
blanks.zh: 天空中一朵云都没有。

blanks.en: I love this time of year.
blanks.zh: 我喜欢每年的这个时候。

blanks.en: The flowers are beautiful, but calling for rain, though.
blanks.zh: 花开得真美，不过天气预报说要下雨。

blanks.en: We got any plans this weekend?
blanks.zh: 我们这个周末有什么安排吗？

blanks.en: We might start with our vegetable garden, then the barbecue.
blanks.zh: 我们可以先打理菜园，再来烧烤。

blanks.en: Sounds fun, but I still want to go fishing with George.
blanks.zh: 听起来很有趣，但我还是想和乔治去钓鱼。

blanks.en: You mean the former designer of our company?
blanks.zh: 你是说以前在我们公司工作的那位设计师吗？

blanks.en: What's he doing these days?
blanks.zh: 他最近在做什么？

blanks.en: He said he's got a new job as an art reporter.
blanks.zh: 他说他找到了一份新工作，做艺术记者。

blanks.en: Do you often go to the student union, Andrew?
blanks.zh: 安德鲁，你经常去学生会吗？

blanks.en: Once in a while I meet friends there, and I spend a lot of time organizing activities in different clubs or associations.
blanks.zh: 我偶尔在那里见朋友，也花很多时间组织不同俱乐部或协会的活动。

blanks.en: Well, it has one more bedroom than the last flat.
blanks.zh: 嗯，这套比上一套公寓多一间卧室。

blanks.en: And the sitting room is big.
blanks.zh: 而且客厅很大。

blanks.en: But there is not enough cupboard space in the kitchen.
blanks.zh: 但厨房的橱柜空间不够。

blanks.en: It's cheaper than the last one we saw, and it is in a good neighborhood.
blanks.zh: 它比我们看的上一套便宜，而且社区环境不错。

blanks.en: Well, maybe we'll have to see if the agent has anything else to show us.
blanks.zh: 嗯，也许我们得看看房产中介还有没有别的房子可以带我们看。

blanks.en: Thank you, Mrs. Johnson, for what you've shared with our listeners.
blanks.zh: 约翰逊女士，感谢您向我们的听众分享这些。

blanks.en: Now please tell us, do you sometimes feel worried about your daughter now that she's grown up?
blanks.zh: 现在请告诉我们，女儿已经长大了，您有时还会担心她吗？

blanks.en: Oh, I worry about her like all parents do.
blanks.zh: 当然，我和所有父母一样会担心她。

blanks.en: After she graduated from medical school she went to volunteer medical service in Africa.
blanks.zh: 从医学院毕业后，她去了非洲，从事志愿医疗服务。

blanks.en: That's okay if communication was fine.
blanks.zh: 如果通信正常，那倒还好。

blanks.en: But if there was no Internet or telephone connection, we could sometimes go two weeks without getting in touch with each other.
blanks.zh: 但如果没有网络或电话连接，我们有时会整整两周联系不上彼此。

blanks.en: That often worries me.
blanks.zh: 这常常让我担心。

blanks.en: Now sell yourself in a minute, please.
blanks.zh: 现在请用一分钟推介一下自己。

blanks.en: I graduated from university two years ago and have since been working in an accounting company.
blanks.zh: 我两年前大学毕业，此后一直在一家会计公司工作。

blanks.en: Apart from the knowledge and skills related to my major, I'm really good with computers.
blanks.zh: 除了与专业相关的知识和技能，我还很擅长使用计算机。

blanks.en: I have a large amount of experience working with big data.
blanks.zh: 我有丰富的大数据处理经验。

blanks.en: I think I'm well qualified for the accountant position here.
blanks.zh: 我认为自己很能胜任贵公司的会计岗位。

blanks.en: Why did you choose this company?
blanks.zh: 你为什么选择这家公司？

blanks.en: Peterson has been my dream company all along.
blanks.zh: 彼得森公司一直是我梦寐以求的公司。

blanks.en: You value progress and focus on the quality of work more than the quantity.
blanks.zh: 贵公司重视进步，而且比起数量，更注重工作的质量。

blanks.en: The flexible working hours and working from home is also attractive.
blanks.zh: 弹性的工作时间和居家办公也很有吸引力。

blanks.en: What do you think is your biggest weakness?
blanks.zh: 你认为自己最大的弱点是什么？

blanks.en: Well, when I work, I often concentrate so much on what I'm doing that I may have a hard time dealing with things that come up unexpectedly.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我工作时常常非常专注于手头的事情，以至于遇到突发状况时，可能很难应付。

blanks.en: That may be annoying to some people.
blanks.zh: 这可能会让一些人感到烦恼。

blanks.en: All right, thank you very much.
blanks.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

blanks.en: So, Robert, I guess you must be well into your third decade as a writer.
blanks.zh: 那么，罗伯特，我想您从事写作已经进入第三个十年了吧。

blanks.en: How is life treating you?
blanks.zh: 您近来过得怎么样？

blanks.en: Fourth decade as a writer.
blanks.zh: 是从事写作的第四个十年了。

blanks.en: Let me get my calculator out.
blanks.zh: 让我把计算器拿出来算算。

blanks.en: Well, I guess I've been writing novels since the nineteen eighties.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我想我是从二十世纪八十年代开始写小说的。

blanks.en: But I have been writing all my life.
blanks.zh: 不过，我这一辈子一直都在写作。

blanks.en: And to answer your question, life has been treating me excellently.
blanks.zh: 回答您的问题，我过得非常好。

blanks.en: Can I ask you about your childhood?
blanks.zh: 我能问问您的童年吗？

blanks.en: Were you a bookish child?
blanks.zh: 您小时候爱读书吗？

blanks.en: In a strange way, I was a non-reader until I turned nine.
blanks.zh: 说来也奇怪，直到九岁之前，我都不怎么读书。

blanks.en: I used to play basketball in the schoolyards of Brooklyn.
blanks.zh: 我以前常在布鲁克林的学校操场上打篮球。

blanks.en: My father was a high school teacher of physics and chemistry, and he was a big reader.
blanks.zh: 我父亲是高中物理和化学老师，他非常爱读书。

blanks.en: He would bring books back from his high school library.
blanks.zh: 他常从所在高中的图书馆带书回来。

blanks.en: One day I read the last chapter of a book, the title of which I've long since forgotten.
blanks.zh: 有一天，我读到一本书的最后一章，那本书的名字我早就忘了。

blanks.en: I liked it so much that I started reading the remainder.
blanks.zh: 我特别喜欢那一章，于是开始读剩下的部分。

blanks.en: Interestingly, I read the chapters backwards until I got to the beginning.
blanks.zh: 有趣的是，我一章一章倒着读，一直读到开头。

blanks.en: I really loved the experience, and I soon became an eager reader.
blanks.zh: 我非常喜欢这次经历，很快就成了一个如饥似渴的读者。

blanks.en: Then my father would bring piles of books home from the library, and I would read them all, and they were all fiction.
blanks.zh: 后来，父亲总从图书馆一摞一摞地把书带回家，我都读完了，而且全是小说。

blanks.en: I must add that I started reading the books from the start, as opposed to working backwards.
blanks.zh: 我得补充一句，那以后我都是从开头读起，不再倒着读了。

blanks.zh: 我父亲是高中物理和化学老师，他非常爱读书。

blanks.zh: 他常从所在高中的图书馆带书回来。

blanks.en: One day I read the last chapter of a book, the title of which I've long since forgotten.
blanks.zh: 有一天，我读到一本书的最后一章，那本书的名字我早就忘了。

blanks.en: I liked it so much that I started reading the remainder.
blanks.zh: 我特别喜欢那一章，于是开始读剩下的部分。

blanks.en: Interestingly, I read the chapters backwards until I got to the beginning.
blanks.zh: 有趣的是，我一章一章倒着读，一直读到开头。

blanks.en: I really loved the experience, and I soon became an eager reader.
blanks.zh: 我非常喜欢这次经历，很快就成了一个如饥似渴的读者。

blanks.en: Then my father would bring piles of books home from the library, and I would read them all, and they were all fiction.
blanks.zh: 后来，父亲总从图书馆一摞一摞地把书带回家，我都读完了，而且全是小说。

blanks.en: I must add that I started reading the books from the start, as opposed to working backwards.
blanks.zh: 我得补充一句，那以后我都是从开头读起，不再倒着读了。

blanks.en: Hello, I'm Maxim Vengerov, and I'm very happy to share with you my connection with Open Tchaikovsky Competition.
blanks.zh: 大家好，我是马克西姆·文格洛夫，很高兴和大家分享我与柴可夫斯基公开赛的渊源。

blanks.en: It was June, nineteen eighty-six, when I came to Moscow to participate in Open Tchaikovsky Competition at the age of ten from Chelyabinsk.
blanks.zh: 1986年6月，我十岁，从车里雅宾斯克来到莫斯科参加柴可夫斯基公开赛。

blanks.en: This was actually the turning point of my life.
blanks.zh: 这实际上是我人生的转折点。

blanks.en: Then I attended a world music festival in Berlin, and it was interesting to say that a kid made his breakthrough already at the age of ten.
blanks.zh: 之后，我参加了柏林的一个世界音乐节，有意思的是，当时有个孩子十岁就已经取得了突破。

blanks.en: And that was me.
blanks.zh: 那个孩子就是我。

blanks.en: Now as a judge of the competition, I can see clearly the huge challenges facing the musicians in the competition.
blanks.zh: 如今作为比赛评委，我能清楚地看到参赛音乐家面临的巨大挑战。

blanks.en: Where else can you see young players playing within ten days classical works and Russian traditional music before coming to the final stage?
blanks.zh: 还有哪里能看到年轻选手在十天之内演奏古典作品和俄罗斯传统音乐，然后进入决赛阶段呢？

blanks.en: As a musician, it's important to give maximum attention and time to your own reflections of your own feelings.
blanks.zh: 作为音乐家，很重要的一点是，要花最多的时间、投入最大的注意力，体会和思考自己的情感。

blanks.en: So what I'm really looking for in the competition is to meet someone who can touch me musically.
blanks.zh: 所以，我真正希望在比赛中遇到的，是能用音乐打动我的人。

blanks.en: I want to see the seed, at least the seed of the great tree that can grow.
blanks.zh: 我想看到那颗种子，至少是一颗有望长成参天大树的种子。

blanks.en: I would go for this violinist.
blanks.zh: 我会选择这样的小提琴家。

blanks.en: I would go for this musician.
blanks.zh: 我会选择这样的音乐家。

blanks.en: Could you please tell me how I can get to the student dorm building?
blanks.zh: 您能告诉我怎么去学生宿舍楼吗？

blanks.en: Turn left when you walk out of this register office, pass the bookstore, and you'll see it.
blanks.zh: 走出这间注册办公室后向左转，经过书店，就能看到了。

blanks.en: We couldn't ask for a better day, could we, Barbara?
blanks.zh: 芭芭拉，天气好得不能再好了，是吧？
blanks.answer: couldn't ask for a better day

blanks.en: There isn't a cloud in the sky.
blanks.zh: 天空中一朵云都没有。

blanks.en: I love this time of year.
blanks.zh: 我喜欢每年的这个时候。

blanks.en: The flowers are beautiful, but calling for rain, though.
blanks.zh: 花开得真美，不过天气预报说要下雨。

blanks.en: We got any plans this weekend?
blanks.zh: 我们这个周末有什么安排吗？

blanks.en: We might start with our vegetable garden, then the barbecue.
blanks.zh: 我们可以先打理菜园，再来烧烤。

blanks.en: Sounds fun, but I still want to go fishing with George.
blanks.zh: 听起来很有趣，但我还是想和乔治去钓鱼。

blanks.en: You mean the former designer of our company?
blanks.zh: 你是说以前在我们公司工作的那位设计师吗？

blanks.en: What's he doing these days?
blanks.zh: 他最近在做什么？

blanks.en: He said he's got a new job as an art reporter.
blanks.zh: 他说他找到了一份新工作，做艺术记者。

blanks.en: Do you often go to the student union, Andrew?
blanks.zh: 安德鲁，你经常去学生会吗？

blanks.en: Once in a while I meet friends there, and I spend a lot of time organizing activities in different clubs or associations.
blanks.zh: 我偶尔在那里见朋友，也花很多时间组织不同俱乐部或协会的活动。

blanks.en: Well, it has one more bedroom than the last flat.
blanks.zh: 嗯，这套比上一套公寓多一间卧室。

blanks.en: And the sitting room is big.
blanks.zh: 而且客厅很大。

blanks.en: But there is not enough cupboard space in the kitchen.
blanks.zh: 但厨房的橱柜空间不够。

blanks.en: It's cheaper than the last one we saw, and it is in a good neighborhood.
blanks.zh: 它比我们看的上一套便宜，而且社区环境不错。

blanks.en: Well, maybe we'll have to see if the agent has anything else to show us.
blanks.zh: 嗯，也许我们得看看房产中介还有没有别的房子可以带我们看。

blanks.en: Thank you, Mrs. Johnson, for what you've shared with our listeners.
blanks.zh: 约翰逊女士，感谢您向我们的听众分享这些。

blanks.en: Now please tell us, do you sometimes feel worried about your daughter now that she's grown up?
blanks.zh: 现在请告诉我们，女儿已经长大了，您有时还会担心她吗？

blanks.en: Oh, I worry about her like all parents do.
blanks.zh: 当然，我和所有父母一样会担心她。

blanks.en: After she graduated from medical school she went to volunteer medical service in Africa.
blanks.zh: 从医学院毕业后，她去了非洲，从事志愿医疗服务。

blanks.en: That's okay if communication was fine.
blanks.zh: 如果通信正常，那倒还好。

blanks.en: But if there was no Internet or telephone connection, we could sometimes go two weeks without getting in touch with each other.
blanks.zh: 但如果没有网络或电话连接，我们有时会整整两周联系不上彼此。

blanks.en: That often worries me.
blanks.zh: 这常常让我担心。

blanks.en: Now sell yourself in a minute, please.
blanks.zh: 现在请用一分钟推介一下自己。

blanks.en: I graduated from university two years ago and have since been working in an accounting company.
blanks.zh: 我两年前大学毕业，此后一直在一家会计公司工作。

blanks.en: Apart from the knowledge and skills related to my major, I'm really good with computers.
blanks.zh: 除了与专业相关的知识和技能，我还很擅长使用计算机。

blanks.en: I have a large amount of experience working with big data.
blanks.zh: 我有丰富的大数据处理经验。

blanks.en: I think I'm well qualified for the accountant position here.
blanks.zh: 我认为自己很能胜任贵公司的会计岗位。

blanks.en: Why did you choose this company?
blanks.zh: 你为什么选择这家公司？

blanks.en: Peterson has been my dream company all along.
blanks.zh: 彼得森公司一直是我梦寐以求的公司。

blanks.en: You value progress and focus on the quality of work more than the quantity.
blanks.zh: 贵公司重视进步，而且比起数量，更注重工作的质量。

blanks.en: The flexible working hours and working from home is also attractive.
blanks.zh: 弹性的工作时间和居家办公也很有吸引力。

blanks.en: What do you think is your biggest weakness?
blanks.zh: 你认为自己最大的弱点是什么？

blanks.en: Well, when I work, I often concentrate so much on what I'm doing that I may have a hard time dealing with things that come up unexpectedly.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我工作时常常非常专注于手头的事情，以至于遇到突发状况时，可能很难应付。

blanks.en: That may be annoying to some people.
blanks.zh: 这可能会让一些人感到烦恼。

blanks.en: All right, thank you very much.
blanks.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

blanks.en: So, Robert, I guess you must be well into your third decade as a writer.
blanks.zh: 那么，罗伯特，我想您从事写作已经进入第三个十年了吧。

blanks.en: How is life treating you?
blanks.zh: 您近来过得怎么样？

blanks.en: Fourth decade as a writer.
blanks.zh: 是从事写作的第四个十年了。

blanks.en: Let me get my calculator out.
blanks.zh: 让我把计算器拿出来算算。

blanks.en: Well, I guess I've been writing novels since the nineteen eighties.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我想我是从二十世纪八十年代开始写小说的。

blanks.en: But I have been writing all my life.
blanks.zh: 不过，我这一辈子一直都在写作。

blanks.en: And to answer your question, life has been treating me excellently.
blanks.zh: 回答您的问题，我过得非常好。

blanks.en: Can I ask you about your childhood?
blanks.zh: 我能问问您的童年吗？

blanks.en: Were you a bookish child?
blanks.zh: 您小时候爱读书吗？

blanks.en: In a strange way, I was a non-reader until I turned nine.
blanks.zh: 说来也奇怪，直到九岁之前，我都不怎么读书。

blanks.en: I used to play basketball in the schoolyards of Brooklyn.
blanks.zh: 我以前常在布鲁克林的学校操场上打篮球。

blanks.en: My father was a high school teacher of physics and chemistry, and he was a big reader.
blanks.zh: 我父亲是高中物理和化学老师，他非常爱读书。

blanks.en: He would bring books back from his high school library.
blanks.zh: 他常从所在高中的图书馆带书回来。

blanks.en: One day I read the last chapter of a book, the title of which I've long since forgotten.
blanks.zh: 有一天，我读到一本书的最后一章，那本书的名字我早就忘了。

blanks.en: I liked it so much that I started reading the remainder.
blanks.zh: 我特别喜欢那一章，于是开始读剩下的部分。

blanks.en: Interestingly, I read the chapters backwards until I got to the beginning.
blanks.zh: 有趣的是，我一章一章倒着读，一直读到开头。

blanks.en: I really loved the experience, and I soon became an eager reader.
blanks.zh: 我非常喜欢这次经历，很快就成了一个如饥似渴的读者。

blanks.en: Then my father would bring piles of books home from the library, and I would read them all, and they were all fiction.

blanks.en: I would go for this violinist.
blanks.zh: 我会选择这样的小提琴家。

blanks.en: I would go for this musician.
blanks.zh: 我会选择这样的音乐家。

blanks.en: Jack, are you going camping with your friends this weekend?
blanks.zh: 杰克，你这周末要和朋友们去露营吗？

blanks.en: If it's sunny, we'll go.
blanks.zh: 如果天气晴朗，我们就去。

blanks.en: The weatherman says it's going to rain.
blanks.zh: 天气预报员说要下雨。

blanks.en: In that case, we'll go to the cinema instead.
blanks.zh: 那样的话，我们就改去看电影。

blanks.en: Excuse me, could you mind my bags for a moment?
blanks.zh: 打扰一下，你能帮我照看一会儿行李吗？

blanks.en: I want to buy some food at the convenience store.
blanks.zh: 我想去便利店买点吃的。

blanks.en: No problem, but be quick.
blanks.zh: 没问题，不过你得快一点。

blanks.en: It was announced that my train would arrive in ten minutes.
blanks.zh: 广播刚刚通知，我的火车十分钟后到站。

blanks.en: Bob came out of hospital last Friday.
blanks.zh: 鲍勃上周五出院了。

blanks.en: Have you got a chance to visit him?
blanks.zh: 你有机会去看他了吗？

blanks.en: I plan to see him this Saturday.
blanks.zh: 我打算这周六去看他。

blanks.en: Aren't you going to the conference then?
blanks.zh: 那时你不是要去开会吗？

blanks.en: It has been rescheduled for next Monday.
blanks.zh: 会议已经改到下周一了。

blanks.en: We made a terrible mistake adding up the bill.
blanks.zh: 我们算账单时出了个很严重的错误。

blanks.en: Here is the ten dollars we have to return to you.
blanks.zh: 这是我们应该退给您的十美元。

blanks.en: Oh, I didn't notice that.
blanks.zh: 哦，我都没注意到。

blanks.en: Don't blame the waiter.
blanks.zh: 别责怪那位服务员。

blanks.en: He's been really nice.
blanks.zh: 他一直服务得很好。

blanks.en: But Steve wouldn't take just any book.
blanks.zh: 不过，史蒂夫可不会随便什么书都喜欢。

blanks.en: He has to have this particular one on geography.
blanks.zh: 他一定得要这本特定的地理书。

blanks.en: I can't come for dinner tonight.
blanks.zh: 我今晚不能来吃晚饭了。

blanks.en: We've got a new case, and things get pretty crazy here in the office.
blanks.zh: 我们接了一个新案子，办公室这边忙得不可开交。

blanks.en: No, no, not tonight.
blanks.zh: 不，不，今晚不行。

blanks.en: Let me see if I can arrange another night.
blanks.zh: 我看看能不能另约一个晚上。

blanks.en: It's about my job.
blanks.zh: 是关于我工作的事。

blanks.en: Then tell me on the phone.
blanks.zh: 那就在电话里告诉我吧。

blanks.en: It's better if we do it in person.
blanks.zh: 我们最好还是当面谈。

blanks.en: How about tomorrow night?
blanks.zh: 明晚怎么样？

blanks.en: Jim will call on us this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 吉姆今天下午会来看我们。

blanks.en: Uh, wait, let me see.
blanks.zh: 呃，等等，让我看看。

blanks.en: He has sent two messages saying that he's done with his work at the office and got a taxi and... and he'll arrive in twenty minutes.
blanks.zh: 他发来了两条消息，说办公室里的工作已经做完，打到了出租车，而且……而且二十分钟后就到。

blanks.en: We have to hurry.
blanks.zh: 我们得快点了。

blanks.en: But it takes at least half an hour to get out of the city centre by bus.
blanks.zh: 可是坐公共汽车离开市中心至少要半个小时。

blanks.en: Look at the traffic.
blanks.zh: 看看这交通状况。

blanks.en: We can save at least twenty minutes by walking through the park.
blanks.zh: 我们步行穿过公园，至少能省二十分钟。

blanks.en: Yes, a hundred percent.
blanks.zh: 当然，百分之百确定。

blanks.en: How was your weekend?
blanks.zh: 周末过得怎么样？

blanks.en: I went to my grandpa's.
blanks.zh: 我去了爷爷家。

blanks.en: He invited us to pick vegetables on his farm.
blanks.zh: 他邀请我们去他的农场摘蔬菜。

blanks.en: My daughter had a great time there.
blanks.zh: 我女儿在那里玩得很开心。

blanks.en: Oh, I had a truly incredible experience.
blanks.zh: 哦，我有一次非常不可思议的经历。

blanks.en: I dropped by a yard sale on Saturday and got several books.
blanks.zh: 周六我顺便逛了一处庭院旧货出售摊，买了几本书。

blanks.en: A novel and two poetry collections.
blanks.zh: 一本小说和两本诗集。

blanks.en: As I leafed through the novel, a piece of paper fell out.
blanks.zh: 我翻阅那本小说时，一张纸掉了出来。

blanks.en: It was an air ticket from two thousand and twelve.
blanks.zh: 那是一张二〇一二年的机票。

blanks.en: The flight was from Los Angeles to Chicago, and the name on the ticket was Ashley Louis.
blanks.zh: 航班从洛杉矶飞往芝加哥，机票上的名字是阿什莉·路易斯。

blanks.en: In twenty twelve she lived in Los Angeles and her husband worked in Chicago.
blanks.zh: 二〇一二年，她住在洛杉矶，她丈夫在芝加哥工作。

blanks.en: Both of them often flew between the two cities.
blanks.zh: 他们俩经常往返于这两个城市之间。

blanks.en: I asked the seller where he got the book.
blanks.zh: 我问卖书的人，他是从哪里得到这本书的。

blanks.en: He said it was bought at a second-hand bookstore in Los Angeles three years ago.
blanks.zh: 他说，这本书是三年前在洛杉矶一家二手书店买的。

blanks.en: Last year he and his family moved from Los Angeles to Philadelphia.
blanks.zh: 去年，他和家人从洛杉矶搬到了费城。

blanks.en: So all the way across the country your sister's old book landed in your hands.
blanks.zh: 所以，你姐姐的旧书横跨整个国家，最后竟到了你手里。

blanks.en: How are you feeling?
blanks.zh: 你感觉怎么样？

blanks.en: I think I've got used to college life, going to classes, working out and hanging out with my friends.
blanks.zh: 我觉得自己已经适应了大学生活，去上课、锻炼身体，再和朋友们出去玩。

blanks.en: Though there's pressure to meet deadlines, life here is never boring.
blanks.zh: 虽然要按时完成任务有压力，但这里的生活从不无聊。

blanks.en: What's been hard about being an Indiana basketball player?
blanks.zh: 作为印第安纳的篮球运动员，有什么让你觉得困难？

blanks.en: Well, the training is very competitive: weightlifting and running every day.
blanks.zh: 嗯，训练的竞争性很强，每天都要举重和跑步。

blanks.en: It's not like high school.
blanks.zh: 这和高中不一样。

blanks.en: In high school I really didn't have to do that.
blanks.zh: 在高中时，我确实不用这样训练。

blanks.en: I'm just trying to get used to it.
blanks.zh: 我正在努力适应。

blanks.en: And I think I am.
blanks.zh: 而且我觉得自己正在适应。

blanks.en: At this point, how do you see yourself fitting into this group?
blanks.zh: 现阶段，你觉得自己融入这个团队的情况怎么样？

blanks.en: I think we are all different.
blanks.zh: 我觉得我们各不相同。

blanks.en: George is from Britain, Chris and Leo are from Australia, I'm from France, and the rest are Americans.
blanks.zh: 乔治来自英国，克里斯和利奥来自澳大利亚，我来自法国，其他人都是美国人。

blanks.en: But I get along with everybody.
blanks.zh: 不过，我和每个人都相处得很好。

blanks.en: You know, we are really starting to bond.
blanks.zh: 你知道，我们真的开始凝聚在一起了。

blanks.en: It's great to see how we grow each day as a team.
blanks.zh: 看到我们作为一个团队每天都在成长，真是太好了。

blanks.en: I wish you a very happy and fruitful stay in Indiana.
blanks.zh: 祝你在印第安纳度过一段非常愉快而且收获丰硕的时光。

blanks.en: Good evening, dear listeners.
blanks.zh: 各位亲爱的听众，晚上好。

blanks.en: When was the last time you enjoyed leisure activities?
blanks.zh: 你上一次享受休闲活动是什么时候？

blanks.en: Do you want to live a full and happy life?
blanks.zh: 你想过充实而幸福的生活吗？

blanks.en: Today I am going to introduce to you a magazine that features the art of living.
blanks.zh: 今天我要向大家介绍一本以生活艺术为特色的杂志。

blanks.en: The Idler was launched by Tom Hodgkinson back in nineteen ninety-three, with the intention of providing a bit of fun, freedom, and achievement in a busy world.
blanks.zh: 《闲人》杂志由汤姆·霍奇金森于一九九三年创办，旨在为忙碌的世界带来一点乐趣、自由和成就感。

blanks.en: It is now published bimonthly.
blanks.zh: 它现在每两个月出版一期。

blanks.en: In every issue you'll find an interesting mix of interviews and essays on the good life, history, philosophy, arts, and fashion photography.
blanks.zh: 每一期里，你都能看到访谈和文章的有趣组合，内容涵盖美好生活、历史、哲学、艺术以及时尚摄影。

blanks.en: You'll find much to laugh at and much useful stuff as well, from recipes for making bacon to guides to housekeeping.
blanks.zh: 你会找到许多让人开怀的内容，以及不少实用的东西，从制作培根的食谱到家务指南，应有尽有。

blanks.en: If you've ever felt that there's more to life than boring jobs, then why not subscribe to it?
blanks.zh: 如果你曾觉得生活不应只有无聊的工作，那为什么不订阅它呢？

blanks.en: The Idler is a cheering read that makes you feel better about life.
blanks.zh: 《闲人》是一本令人振奋的读物，会让你更积极地看待生活。

blanks.en: You can download the application and subscribe today to get your first issue free.
blanks.zh: 你可以下载应用程序，今天就订阅，免费获得第一期。

blanks.en: Jack, are you going camping with your friends this weekend?
blanks.zh: 杰克，你这周末要和朋友们去露营吗？

blanks.en: If it's sunny, we'll go.
blanks.zh: 如果天气晴朗，我们就去。

blanks.en: The weatherman says it's going to rain.
blanks.zh: 天气预报员说要下雨。

blanks.en: In that case, we'll go to the cinema instead.
blanks.zh: 那样的话，我们就改去看电影。

blanks.en: Excuse me, could you mind my bags for a moment?
blanks.zh: 打扰一下，你能帮我照看一会儿行李吗？

blanks.en: I want to buy some food at the convenience store.
blanks.zh: 我想去便利店买点吃的。

blanks.en: No problem, but be quick.
blanks.zh: 没问题，不过你得快一点。

blanks.en: It was announced that my train would arrive in ten minutes.
blanks.zh: 广播刚刚通知，我的火车十分钟后到站。

blanks.en: Bob came out of hospital last Friday.
blanks.zh: 鲍勃上周五出院了。

blanks.en: Have you got a chance to visit him?
blanks.zh: 你有机会去看他了吗？

blanks.en: I plan to see him this Saturday.
blanks.zh: 我打算这周六去看他。

blanks.en: Aren't you going to the conference then?
blanks.zh: 那时你不是要去开会吗？

blanks.en: It has been rescheduled for next Monday.
blanks.zh: 会议已经改到下周一了。

blanks.en: We made a terrible mistake adding up the bill.
blanks.zh: 我们算账单时出了个很严重的错误。

blanks.en: Here is the ten dollars we have to return to you.
blanks.zh: 这是我们应该退给您的十美元。

blanks.en: Oh, I didn't notice that.
blanks.zh: 哦，我都没注意到。

blanks.en: Don't blame the waiter.
blanks.zh: 别责怪那位服务员。

blanks.en: He's been really nice.
blanks.zh: 他一直服务得很好。

blanks.en: But Steve wouldn't take just any book.
blanks.zh: 不过，史蒂夫可不会随便什么书都喜欢。

blanks.en: He has to have this particular one on geography.
blanks.zh: 他一定得要这本特定的地理书。

blanks.en: I can't come for dinner tonight.
blanks.zh: 我今晚不能来吃晚饭了。

blanks.en: We've got a new case, and things get pretty crazy here in the office.
blanks.zh: 我们接了一个新案子，办公室这边忙得不可开交。

blanks.en: No, no, not tonight.
blanks.zh: 不，不，今晚不行。

blanks.en: Let me see if I can arrange another night.
blanks.zh: 我看看能不能另约一个晚上。

blanks.en: It's about my job.
blanks.zh: 是关于我工作的事。

blanks.en: Then tell me on the phone.
blanks.zh: 那就在电话里告诉我吧。

blanks.en: It's better if we do it in person.
blanks.zh: 我们最好还是当面谈。

blanks.en: How about tomorrow night?
blanks.zh: 明晚怎么样？

blanks.en: Jim will call on us this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 吉姆今天下午会来看我们。

blanks.en: Uh, wait, let me see.
blanks.zh: 呃，等等，让我看看。

blanks.en: He has sent two messages saying that he's done with his work at the office and got a taxi and... and he'll arrive in twenty minutes.
blanks.zh: 他发来了两条消息，说办公室里的工作已经做完，打到了出租车，而且……而且二十分钟后就到。

blanks.en: We have to hurry.
blanks.zh: 我们得快点了。

blanks.en: But it takes at least half an hour to get out of the city centre by bus.
blanks.zh: 可是坐公共汽车离开市中心至少要半个小时。

blanks.en: Look at the traffic.
blanks.zh: 看看这交通状况。

blanks.en: We can save at least twenty minutes by walking through the park.
blanks.zh: 我们步行穿过公园，至少能省二十分钟。

blanks.en: Yes, a hundred percent.
blanks.zh: 当然，百分之百确定。

blanks.en: How was your weekend?
blanks.zh: 周末过得怎么样？

blanks.en: I went to my grandpa's.
blanks.zh: 我去了爷爷家。

blanks.en: He invited us to pick vegetables on his farm.
blanks.zh: 他邀请我们去他的农场摘蔬菜。

blanks.en: My daughter had a great time there.
blanks.zh: 我女儿在那里玩得很开心。

blanks.en: Oh, I had a truly incredible experience.
blanks.zh: 哦，我有一次非常不可思议的经历。

blanks.en: I dropped by a yard sale on Saturday and got several books.
blanks.zh: 周六我顺便逛了一处庭院旧货出售摊，买了几本书。

blanks.en: A novel and two poetry collections.
blanks.zh: 一本小说和两本诗集。

blanks.en: As I leafed through the novel, a piece of paper fell out.
blanks.zh: 我翻阅那本小说时，一张纸掉了出来。

blanks.en: It was an air ticket from two thousand and twelve.
blanks.zh: 那是一张二〇一二年的机票。

blanks.en: The flight was from Los Angeles to Chicago, and the name on the ticket was Ashley Louis.
blanks.zh: 航班从洛杉矶飞往芝加哥，机票上的名字是阿什莉·路易斯。

blanks.en: In twenty twelve she lived in Los Angeles and her husband worked in Chicago.

blanks.en: Both of them often flew between the two cities.
blanks.zh: 他们俩经常往返于这两个城市之间。

blanks.zh: 我问卖书的人，他是从哪里得到这本书的。

blanks.en: He said it was bought at a second-hand bookstore in Los Angeles three years ago.

blanks.zh: 我觉得自己已经适应了大学生活，去上课、锻炼身体，再和朋友们出去玩。

blanks.zh: 嗯，训练的竞争性很强，每天都要举重和跑步。

blanks.en: It's not like high school.
blanks.zh: 这和高中不一样。

blanks.en: In high school I really didn't have to do that.
blanks.zh: 在高中时，我确实不用这样训练。

blanks.en: I'm just trying to get used to it.
blanks.zh: 我正在努力适应。

blanks.en: And I think I am.
blanks.zh: 而且我觉得自己正在适应。

blanks.en: At this point, how do you see yourself fitting into this group?
blanks.zh: 现阶段，你觉得自己融入这个团队的情况怎么样？

blanks.en: I think we are all different.
blanks.zh: 我觉得我们各不相同。

blanks.en: George is from Britain, Chris and Leo are from Australia, I'm from France, and the rest are Americans.
blanks.zh: 乔治来自英国，克里斯和利奥来自澳大利亚，我来自法国，其他人都是美国人。

blanks.en: But I get along with everybody.
blanks.zh: 不过，我和每个人都相处得很好。

blanks.en: You know, we are really starting to bond.
blanks.zh: 你知道，我们真的开始凝聚在一起了。

blanks.en: It's great to see how we grow each day as a team.
blanks.zh: 看到我们作为一个团队每天都在成长，真是太好了。

blanks.en: I wish you a very happy and fruitful stay in Indiana.
blanks.zh: 祝你在印第安纳度过一段非常愉快而且收获丰硕的时光。

blanks.en: Billy needs some beans for his science project at school.
blanks.zh: 比利在学校的科学项目需要一些豆子。

blanks.en: Maybe we can stop by a store on our way home.
blanks.zh: 也许我们回家路上可以顺便去趟商店。

blanks.en: It's just around the corner.
blanks.zh: 就在拐角处。

blanks.en: Guess who I saw at the City Library?
blanks.zh: 猜猜我在市图书馆看到谁了？

blanks.en: Andy Clarks, the leading actor in The Good Lawyer, the famous TV series.
blanks.zh: 安迪·克拉克斯，就是那部著名电视剧《好律师》的主演。

blanks.en: His popularity has slipped since the final season of the show.
blanks.zh: 自从那部剧的最后一季播完后，他的人气就下滑了。

blanks.en: It seems as if everybody's talking about Jason's retirement.
blanks.zh: 好像大家都在谈论贾森退休的事。

blanks.en: His office is filled with gifts.
blanks.zh: 他的办公室里堆满了礼物。

blanks.en: I gave him a T-shirt with a baseball pattern on it.
blanks.zh: 我送了他一件上面有棒球图案的T恤。

blanks.en: I'll get him something this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 我今天下午也会给他买点东西。

blanks.en: Hope it's not late.
blanks.zh: 希望还不晚。

blanks.en: Was there anything special?
blanks.zh: 有什么特别的事吗？

blanks.en: Yes, the employees dressed up as movie characters, and every customer received a discount card.
blanks.zh: 有啊，员工们装扮成电影角色，每位顾客都领到了一张打折卡。

blanks.en: Oh, the road is jammed with traffic again.
blanks.zh: 唉，又堵车了。

blanks.en: We're going to be late for work.
blanks.zh: 我们上班要迟到了。

blanks.en: Let's make a U-turn at the next crossroads and try another way.
blanks.zh: 我们在下个十字路口掉头，换条路试试吧。

blanks.en: Do you think Janet could make it?
blanks.zh: 你觉得珍妮特能及时赶到吗？

blanks.en: I'm sure she can.
blanks.zh: 我相信她能。

blanks.en: Have you tried calling her?
blanks.zh: 你试着给她打电话了吗？

blanks.en: But I can't get through.
blanks.zh: 但我打不通。

blanks.en: The flight has already been called twice.
blanks.zh: 航班已经广播通知登机两次了。

blanks.en: I should have reminded her at the office yesterday.
blanks.zh: 我昨天在办公室就该提醒她的。

blanks.en: She may have totally forgotten it.
blanks.zh: 她可能完全忘记了。

blanks.en: Take it easy, Sarah.
blanks.zh: 别着急，萨拉。

blanks.en: Let me call her home number.
blanks.zh: 让我打她家里的电话。

blanks.en: Welcome to our programme, Miss Johnson.
blanks.zh: 欢迎来到我们的节目，约翰逊老师。

blanks.en: Congratulations on winning the Teacher of the Year award.
blanks.zh: 祝贺您获得年度教师奖。

blanks.en: I'm more than happy to be here.
blanks.zh: 能来到这里，我非常高兴。

blanks.en: What inspired you to be a teacher, Miss Johnson?
blanks.zh: 是什么让您选择当老师，约翰逊老师？

blanks.en: Well, I've always loved to learn, but I've enjoyed teaching others even more.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我一直热爱学习，不过更喜欢教别人。

blanks.en: It's in the family.
blanks.zh: 我们家有这个传统。

blanks.en: Could you tell us what the best part about your job is?
blanks.zh: 您能告诉我们，工作中最棒的部分是什么吗？

blanks.en: Getting to know all of the different kids and communicating with them.
blanks.zh: 了解各种不同的孩子，并和他们交流。

blanks.en: I have always loved kids, so I will always enjoy that part of my job.
blanks.zh: 我一直很喜欢孩子，所以我会始终享受工作中的这一部分。

blanks.en: Then what do you hope to achieve by being a teacher?
blanks.zh: 那么，您希望通过当老师达成什么目标？

blanks.en: My goal is to help my students develop awareness of their strengths, weaknesses, and learning needs, and to enable them to learn throughout their lives.
blanks.zh: 我的目标是帮助学生了解自己的长处、弱点和学习需求，让他们具备终身学习的能力。

blanks.en: Ethan, have you thought about getting your own house?
blanks.zh: 伊桑，你想过自己买房吗？

blanks.en: But I'm convinced my parents love having me back.
blanks.zh: 但我确信，我父母很喜欢我搬回家住。

blanks.en: Um, not sure yet.
blanks.zh: 嗯，还没决定。

blanks.en: Right now I enjoy getting my meals cooked for me every day.
blanks.zh: 目前我挺享受每天都有人给我做饭。

blanks.en: Do you pay a contribution to the house?
blanks.zh: 你会分担家里的开支吗？

blanks.en: Of course I do.
blanks.zh: 当然会。

blanks.en: But it's still much less than I would pay to live in my own flat, right?
blanks.zh: 但还是远远少于我自己租公寓住的花费，对吧？

blanks.en: The only thing I don't like is that my mum wants to know every part of my life.
blanks.zh: 我唯一不喜欢的就是，我妈想知道我生活中的每一件事。

blanks.en: Becky, what are you doing tomorrow?
blanks.zh: 贝姬，你明天要做什么？

blanks.en: The same questions every day.
blanks.zh: 每天都是同样的问题。

blanks.en: Mums are like that.
blanks.zh: 妈妈们就是这样。

blanks.en: They ask because they care.
blanks.zh: 她们问是因为关心你。

blanks.en: You've got to be patient with them.
blanks.zh: 你得对她们有耐心。

blanks.en: But I may not move out soon.
blanks.zh: 不过，我可能不会很快搬出去。

blanks.en: The thought of leaving them fills me with fear.
blanks.zh: 一想到离开他们，我就很害怕。

blanks.en: What if one of them falls over?
blanks.zh: 要是他们其中一个摔倒了怎么办？

blanks.en: What if they both have a fall together?
blanks.zh: 要是他们两个一起摔倒了怎么办？

blanks.en: That would be terrible.
blanks.zh: 那可就糟了。

blanks.en: It's a pretty good conference, eh?
blanks.zh: 这个会议挺不错的，对吧？

blanks.en: All speakers are well known and knowledgeable in the subject matter.
blanks.zh: 所有讲者都很有名，而且精通自己所讲的主题。

blanks.en: Did you listen to John Miller's speech on how to avoid business risks this morning?
blanks.zh: 你今天上午听了约翰·米勒关于如何规避商业风险的演讲吗？

blanks.en: No, I missed that one.
blanks.zh: 没有，我错过了那一场。

blanks.en: I went to a speech at Alan Brown Hall.
blanks.zh: 我去听了在艾伦·布朗厅举行的一场演讲。

blanks.en: The speaker was David Thompson.
blanks.zh: 讲者是戴维·汤普森。

blanks.en: I attended his lecture last year.
blanks.zh: 我去年听过他的讲座。

blanks.en: By the way, there will be a workshop this afternoon on how to motivate employees.
blanks.zh: 顺便说一下，今天下午有个讲如何激励员工的研讨会。

blanks.en: Sure, I was promoted to the position of manager a few months ago, and I have to manage a staff of twelve people.
blanks.zh: 当然，我几个月前升任了经理，得管理十二名员工。

blanks.en: It can be quite a difficult situation sometimes.
blanks.zh: 有时候确实挺难应付的。

blanks.en: That's why I am here today.
blanks.zh: 所以我今天来这里了。

blanks.en: I only have seven people reporting to me yet sometimes I feel like pulling my hair out.
blanks.zh: 我只有七名下属，可有时还是烦得想抓狂。

blanks.en: I need to find a way to create harmony within my department.
blanks.zh: 我需要找到办法，让部门内部和睦相处。

blanks.en: Welcome to Star Fitness Club.
blanks.zh: 欢迎来到星光健身俱乐部。

blanks.en: Before you start, I'd like to offer you some tips.
blanks.zh: 开始之前，我想给大家一些建议。

blanks.en: We all know that regular exercise is important, but few of us know how to exercise properly.
blanks.zh: 我们都知道，经常锻炼很重要，但很少有人知道怎样正确锻炼。

blanks.en: I've seen many people make the same workout mistakes in this place.
blanks.zh: 我见过很多人在这里锻炼时犯同样的错误。

blanks.en: One mistake people often make is sticking to the same routine.
blanks.zh: 人们常犯的一个错误，就是总按同一套训练方案练习。

blanks.en: It is not good for building up your muscles.
blanks.zh: 这不利于增强肌肉。

blanks.en: I'd like to suggest that you change your routine every other month.
blanks.zh: 我建议大家每两个月换一套训练方案。

blanks.en: What's more, you can try different kinds of workouts, such as jogging, biking, or swimming.
blanks.zh: 此外，可以尝试不同类型的锻炼，例如慢跑、骑自行车或游泳。

blanks.en: This can help keep your whole body in shape.
blanks.zh: 这有助于让全身都保持良好状态。

blanks.en: Another mistake most people make is to work out intensely almost every day.
blanks.zh: 大多数人犯的另一个错误，就是几乎每天都高强度锻炼。

blanks.en: You need to give your body a break, and allow time for the muscles to grow.
blanks.zh: 你需要让身体休息，给肌肉留出增长的时间。

blanks.en: It is not the harder the better.
blanks.zh: 并不是练得越狠越好。

blanks.en: Two hard workout days every week is enough.
blanks.zh: 每周进行两天高强度训练就够了。

blanks.en: If you really hate to skip a day, you can plan easy exercises on other days.
blanks.zh: 如果你实在不想有一天不练，可以在其他日子安排轻松的运动。

blanks.en: However, experts' suggestion is that you take one day off completely each week.
blanks.zh: 不过，专家建议每周都要彻底休息一天。

blanks.en: The subway system has broken down.
blanks.zh: 地铁系统出故障了。

blanks.en: It's very kind of you, but there is a shuttle service.
blanks.zh: 你真好，不过有班车服务。

blanks.en: I heard you made a tour of Pearl Lake University last Sunday?
blanks.zh: 听说你上周日参观了珍珠湖大学？

blanks.en: We arrived at eight o'clock and then two senior students showed us around the campus.
blanks.zh: 我们八点到的，然后两名高年级学生带我们参观了校园。

blanks.en: We were deeply impressed.
blanks.zh: 我们印象非常深刻。

blanks.en: I missed the hiking last week.
blanks.zh: 我没参加上周的徒步活动。

blanks.en: I had to take my kitten to the clinic.
blanks.zh: 我得带小猫去诊所。

blanks.en: Is she all right now?
blanks.zh: 它现在好了吗？

blanks.en: Are you going back to Nantong after graduation next month?
blanks.zh: 你下个月毕业后要回南通吗？

blanks.en: After I graduate, I'll go back home and try to get a job there.
blanks.zh: 毕业后，我会回家，试着在那里找份工作。

blanks.en: Have you got any news about the mountain climbers?
blanks.zh: 有那些登山者的消息了吗？

blanks.en: Yes, the rescue team found them.
blanks.zh: 有了，救援队找到他们了。

blanks.en: Thank goodness they survived the cold.
blanks.zh: 谢天谢地，他们熬过了严寒，活了下来。

blanks.en: Do you have any idea of our future house?
blanks.zh: 你对我们未来的房子有什么想法吗？

blanks.en: For me, I don't particularly care whether it has got a garden or a garage.
blanks.zh: 就我而言，我并不特别在意有没有花园或车库。

blanks.en: I need just a little bit of space to sit out in when it's warm.
blanks.zh: 我只需要一小块空间，天气暖和时能坐在外面就行。

blanks.en: So you want to turn this room into a mini-library?
blanks.zh: 所以，你想把这个房间改成一个小图书馆？

blanks.en: Yes, my son is a keen reader.
blanks.zh: 是的，我儿子特别爱看书。

blanks.en: I am wondering whether I should buy this model car.
blanks.zh: 我在犹豫要不要买这辆模型车。

blanks.en: I already have a very similar one.
blanks.zh: 我已经有一辆很相似的了。

blanks.en: I see no reason not to.
blanks.zh: 我觉得没有理由不买。

blanks.en: You are entitled to a refund within a week if you don't like it.
blanks.zh: 如果你不喜欢，一周内有权退款。

blanks.en: The boss announced that the project we've been working on will be abandoned.
blanks.zh: 老板宣布，我们一直在忙的那个项目要取消了。

blanks.en: So, our eight months' hard work just goes down the drain?
blanks.zh: 所以，我们八个月的辛苦工作就这么打水漂了？

blanks.en: Sorry, Dad, I'm home late.
blanks.zh: 对不起，爸爸，我回家晚了。

blanks.en: We've all had our supper, but I've set aside a bite for you.
blanks.zh: 我们都吃过晚饭了，不过我给你留了点吃的。

blanks.en: After each passage or conversation, you will be asked several questions.
blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话之后，你会听到几个问题。

blanks.en: The passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
blanks.zh: 短文和对话会播放两遍，但问题只读一遍。

blanks.en: When you hear a question, read the four possible answers on your paper and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
blanks.zh: 听到问题后，阅读试卷上的四个备选答案，选出你所听到的问题的最佳答案。

blanks.en: Can't resist picking from the fridge or cupboard before dinner?
blanks.zh: 吃晚饭前，总忍不住从冰箱或柜子里拿东西吃吗？

blanks.en: A little cheese, some biscuits, an apple?
blanks.zh: 一点奶酪、几块饼干、一个苹果？

blanks.en: It never seems like much.
blanks.zh: 看起来总觉得没吃多少。

blanks.en: Yet, by the time dinner comes around, you are full.
blanks.zh: 可是等到晚饭时，你已经饱了。

blanks.en: If this is you, here are two strategies to help you out.
blanks.zh: 如果你也是这样，这里有两种方法能帮你。

blanks.en: Think about what you are eating earlier in the day.
blanks.zh: 想想你在当天早些时候吃了些什么。

blanks.en: If you are having a light lunch, then trying to last until dinner, you may be doing harm to yourself.
blanks.zh: 如果午饭吃得很少，却想一直撑到晚饭，你可能正在伤害自己。

blanks.en: By leaving it too long between food stops, you will get too hungry and overeat at dinner.
blanks.zh: 两次进食之间隔得太久，你会饿过头，晚饭时就会吃得过多。

blanks.en: Instead, try having a slice of toast or a piece of fruit and a cup of yogurt at about three thirty p.m.
blanks.zh: 不妨试着在下午三点半左右，吃片吐司或一份水果，再喝杯酸奶。

blanks.en: This should keep you going until dinner, so you can resist the pre-dinner snacking.
blanks.zh: 这样应该能让你撑到晚饭，免得晚饭前又忍不住吃零食。

blanks.en: The other strategy is that if you do have a snack before dinner, put it on a plate.
blanks.zh: 另一种方法是，如果你确实要在晚饭前吃零食，就把它放在盘子里。

blanks.en: Instead of picking and paying no attention to what you are eating, arrange some food properly on a small plate.
blanks.zh: 不要漫不经心地随手拿东西吃，而要在小盘子里摆好一些食物。

blanks.en: Then sit down to eat your snack.
blanks.zh: 然后坐下来吃这份零食。

blanks.en: Simply by doing this, you will eat a lot less and still be ready for the main event.
blanks.zh: 只要这么做，你就会少吃很多，并且还能留出胃口吃正餐。

blanks.en: How many trees are there in the world?
blanks.zh: 全世界有多少棵树？

blanks.en: Until now, scientists could only guess.
blanks.zh: 在此之前，科学家们只能猜测。

blanks.en: The estimate of global tree number is approximately 400 billion.
blanks.zh: 此前估计，全球树木的数量大约是四千亿棵。

blanks.en: In the Tree Survey Project, by using satellite images and on-site counting in more than 50 countries, researchers at an American university counted more than 3,000 billion trees in the world, roughly seven times more than previously estimated.
blanks.zh: 在树木调查项目中，一所美国大学的研究人员利用卫星图像，并在五十多个国家进行实地统计，得出全球有三万多亿棵树，比此前估计的数量大约多七倍。

blanks.en: Among all the countries, Russia is ranked first in the tree number.
blanks.zh: 在所有国家中，俄罗斯的树木数量排名第一。

blanks.en: But researchers also warn that the number of trees on Earth has fallen by 46% since the start of civilization.
blanks.zh: 但研究人员也警告，自人类文明开始以来，地球上的树木数量已减少了46%。

blanks.en: Due to demand for wood and farmland, humans cut down more than 15 billion trees each year, replanting only 5 billion.
blanks.zh: 由于对木材和耕地的需求，人类每年砍伐一百五十多亿棵树，却只补种五十亿棵。

blanks.en: At that rate, trees on Earth will be gone in about three centuries.
blanks.zh: 照这样的速度，地球上的树木大约再过三个世纪就会消失。

blanks.en: The project's goal is to draw attention to the importance of trees and their role in reducing the gravity of climate change.
blanks.zh: 该项目旨在引起人们对树木重要性的关注，以及树木在缓解气候变化严重程度方面的作用。

blanks.en: The project's lead researcher says trees store huge amounts of carbon.
blanks.zh: 项目的首席研究人员表示，树木储存了大量的碳。

blanks.en: They are among the most important and critical living things on Earth.
blanks.zh: 它们是地球上最重要、最关键的生物之一。

blanks.en: Helen, when is your brother Jerry getting into town?
blanks.zh: 海伦，你弟弟杰里什么时候到城里来？

blanks.en: I haven't seen him for ages.
blanks.zh: 我好久没见过他了。

blanks.en: I will pick him up around 8 p.m.
blanks.zh: 我会在晚上八点左右去接他。

blanks.en: Are you going to do anything together that night?
blanks.zh: 那天晚上你们打算一起做些什么吗？

blanks.en: No, I think he'll be too tired and will probably just want to go to bed early.
blanks.zh: 没有，我想他会太累，多半只想早点睡觉。

blanks.en: It's a long flight from Sanya.
blanks.zh: 从三亚飞过来要挺长时间。

blanks.en: How long is he going to stay?
blanks.zh: 他打算待多久？

blanks.en: Do you have any special plans for Friday?
blanks.zh: 你们周五有什么特别的安排吗？

blanks.en: He can relax in the apartment on Friday morning.
blanks.zh: 周五上午，他可以在公寓里休息。

blanks.en: And then in the afternoon, we are going to the forest park with some friends to have a picnic.
blanks.zh: 然后下午，我们和几个朋友一起去森林公园野餐。

blanks.en: And then in the evening?
blanks.zh: 那晚上呢？

blanks.en: I have booked a table in Domingo's, that Mexican restaurant.
blanks.zh: 我在多明戈那家墨西哥餐厅订了位。

blanks.en: Do you know it?
blanks.zh: 你知道那家店吗？

blanks.en: One of the waiters I know told me it is extremely difficult to book a table there.
blanks.zh: 我认识的一个服务员告诉我，那里的位子特别难订。

blanks.en: Not if you call them early enough, say a month earlier.
blanks.zh: 只要打电话打得够早，比如提前一个月，就不难。

blanks.en: In the morning, we are going to Shanghai Museum.
blanks.zh: 上午，我们要去上海博物馆。

blanks.en: They've got an exhibition Jerry will be interested in.
blanks.zh: 那里有个展览，杰里会感兴趣。

blanks.en: After lunch, we'll be doing some shopping.
blanks.zh: 午饭后，我们会去逛逛商店。

blanks.en: So I'm meeting you guys on Saturday evening at eight o'clock.
blanks.zh: 所以我周六晚上八点和你们见面。

blanks.en: The party is at Claire's house.
blanks.zh: 聚会在克莱尔家。

blanks.en: Come round here just before eight, and we can take a taxi over to Claire's together.
blanks.zh: 八点前到我这里来，我们可以一起打车去克莱尔家。

blanks.zh: 海伦，你弟弟杰里什么时候到城里来？

blanks.en: I haven't seen him for ages.
blanks.zh: 我好久没见过他了。

blanks.en: I will pick him up around 8 p.m.
blanks.zh: 我会在晚上八点左右去接他。

blanks.en: Are you going to do anything together that night?
blanks.zh: 那天晚上你们打算一起做些什么吗？

blanks.en: No, I think he'll be too tired and will probably just want to go to bed early.
blanks.zh: 没有，我想他会太累，多半只想早点睡觉。

blanks.en: It's a long flight from Sanya.
blanks.zh: 从三亚飞过来要挺长时间。

blanks.en: How long is he going to stay?
blanks.zh: 他打算待多久？

blanks.en: Do you have any special plans for Friday?
blanks.zh: 你们周五有什么特别的安排吗？

blanks.en: He can relax in the apartment on Friday morning.
blanks.zh: 周五上午，他可以在公寓里休息。

blanks.en: And then in the afternoon, we are going to the forest park with some friends to have a picnic.
blanks.zh: 然后下午，我们和几个朋友一起去森林公园野餐。

blanks.en: And then in the evening?
blanks.zh: 那晚上呢？

blanks.en: I have booked a table in Domingo's, that Mexican restaurant.
blanks.zh: 我在多明戈那家墨西哥餐厅订了位。

blanks.en: Do you know it?
blanks.zh: 你知道那家店吗？

blanks.en: One of the waiters I know told me it is extremely difficult to book a table there.
blanks.zh: 我认识的一个服务员告诉我，那里的位子特别难订。

blanks.en: Not if you call them early enough, say a month earlier.
blanks.zh: 只要打电话打得够早，比如提前一个月，就不难。

blanks.en: In the morning, we are going to Shanghai Museum.
blanks.zh: 上午，我们要去上海博物馆。

blanks.en: They've got an exhibition Jerry will be interested in.
blanks.zh: 那里有个展览，杰里会感兴趣。

blanks.en: After lunch, we'll be doing some shopping.
blanks.zh: 午饭后，我们会去逛逛商店。

blanks.en: So I'm meeting you guys on Saturday evening at eight o'clock.
blanks.zh: 所以我周六晚上八点和你们见面。

blanks.en: Oh yes, the party is at Claire's house.
blanks.zh: 哦，对，聚会在克莱尔家。

blanks.en: Come round here just before eight, and we can take a taxi over to Claire's together.
blanks.zh: 八点前到我这里来，我们可以一起打车去克莱尔家。

blanks.en: What are the two speakers mainly talking about?
blanks.zh: 两位说话人主要在谈什么？

blanks.en: What can be learned about Jerry?
blanks.zh: 关于杰里，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.en: Why was the woman able to reserve a table in Domingo's?
blanks.zh: 女士为什么能在多明戈餐厅订到位？

blanks.en: What will Jerry most probably be doing on Friday afternoon?
blanks.zh: 杰里周五下午最可能在做什么？

blanks.en: I'm baking cupcakes, but I've run out of sugar.
blanks.zh: 我正在烤纸杯蛋糕，可糖用完了。

blanks.en: Would you please spare me a spoonful?
blanks.zh: 能分给我一勺吗？

blanks.en: Sure, I'll fetch you a packet.
blanks.zh: 当然，我去给你拿一包。

blanks.en: Haven't seen the dog for two days.
blanks.zh: 两天没见到那只狗了。

blanks.en: I don't know if anything terrible has happened to it.
blanks.zh: 我不知道它是不是出了什么可怕的事。

blanks.en: We'd better prepare for the worst.
blanks.zh: 我们最好做最坏的打算。

blanks.en: Can you recommend something that a schoolboy of seven or eight will really like?
blanks.zh: 能推荐点七八岁男孩真正喜欢的东西吗？

blanks.en: I'd suggest this toy train, sir.
blanks.zh: 先生，我建议选这列玩具火车。

blanks.en: This new brand is popular these days.
blanks.zh: 这个新品牌最近很受欢迎。

blanks.en: I put my notebook on the bench a while ago, but now it's gone.
blanks.zh: 我刚才把笔记本放在长椅上，可现在不见了。

blanks.en: Well, you should have kept an eye on it.
blanks.zh: 嗯，你本来应该留心看着它的。

blanks.en: As you can see from the city map, the gallery is too far away from here.
blanks.zh: 从城市地图上可以看出来，美术馆离这里太远了。

blanks.en: We don't have enough time to go there.
blanks.zh: 我们没足够的时间去那里。

blanks.en: How about the memorial hall nearby?
blanks.zh: 去附近的纪念馆怎么样？

blanks.en: I heard it's breathtaking.
blanks.zh: 听说那里令人惊叹。

blanks.en: Linda, you'll have your chess game tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 琳达，你明天要参加国际象棋比赛。

blanks.en: You'd better stay at home to do more practice.
blanks.zh: 你最好待在家里多练习。

blanks.en: Dad, it was yesterday.
blanks.zh: 爸爸，比赛是昨天。

blanks.en: Charles, what do you think of the stage play?
blanks.zh: 查尔斯，你觉得这出舞台剧怎么样？

blanks.en: The storyline fascinates me a lot, yet the lighting and setting still need improving, let alone the music.
blanks.zh: 故事情节让我很着迷，但灯光和布景仍需改进，更别提音乐了。

blanks.en: The flower show in the Forest Park closes today.
blanks.zh: 森林公园的花展今天结束。

blanks.en: Do you want to join me for the last chance?
blanks.zh: 你想和我一起抓住最后这个机会去看看吗？

blanks.en: Mm, the movie can wait.
blanks.zh: 嗯，电影可以以后再看。

blanks.en: I can't get on well with my roommate Kate.
blanks.zh: 我和室友凯特相处不好。

blanks.en: Well, she's just different.
blanks.zh: 嗯，她只是和你不一样。

blanks.en: After all, diversity is a fact of life.
blanks.zh: 毕竟，生活中本来就存在差异。

blanks.en: I'm going to Beijing next week, but I haven't found a hotel within my budget.
blanks.zh: 我下周要去北京，可还没找到价格在预算内的酒店。

blanks.en: My parents can put you up for a couple of days.
blanks.zh: 你可以在我父母家住几天。

blanks.en: After each passage or conversation you will be asked several questions.
blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话之后，你会听到几个问题。

blanks.en: The passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
blanks.zh: 短文和对话会播放两遍，但问题只读一遍。

blanks.en: When you hear a question read the four possible answers on your paper, and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
blanks.zh: 听到问题后，阅读试卷上的四个备选答案，选出你所听到的问题的最佳答案。

blanks.en: Everbrown is a small town with a history of 1,400 years.
blanks.zh: 埃弗布朗是一个有一千四百年历史的小镇。

blanks.en: Each summer, the 300 hot springs nearby attract about 40,000 tourists.
blanks.zh: 每年夏天，附近的三百处温泉会吸引大约四万名游客。

blanks.en: For the rest of the year, it is home to just 3,000 people.
blanks.zh: 在一年中的其他时间，这里只有三千名常住居民。

blanks.en: It is not the kind of place you'd expect to find Kitten Coffee, a famous food company.
blanks.zh: 你很难想到，小猫咖啡这样一家知名食品公司会出现在这种地方。

blanks.en: After university in 1992, Miss Rosemary, founder of the company, wanted nothing more than to live in a small town.
blanks.zh: 公司创始人罗斯玛丽小姐1992年大学毕业后，最大的愿望只是住在一个小镇里。

blanks.en: With jobs hard to come by in Everbrown, she and her husband had to move into a cabin with no electricity or running water and began to run a fruit stand specifically for tourists during the summer months.
blanks.zh: 由于在埃弗布朗很难找工作，她和丈夫只好搬进一间既没电也没自来水的小木屋，在夏季摆水果摊，专门做游客的生意。

blanks.en: They quickly realized that they needed to set up a business that could be successful all year round.
blanks.zh: 他们很快意识到，需要创办一门一年四季都能做好的生意。

blanks.en: In 1996, they began roasting coffee beans in their garage, giving the business the name Kitten Coffee.
blanks.zh: 1996年，他们开始在自家车库里烘焙咖啡豆，并把这门生意命名为小猫咖啡。

blanks.en: As sales quickly took off, it soon became apparent that their product was going to be better known than the town from which it came.
blanks.zh: 随着销售额迅速增长，很快就能看出，他们的产品将会比它的发源小镇更出名。

blanks.en: Since then, Kitten Coffee has become one of the biggest success stories.
blanks.zh: 从那以后，小猫咖啡成为了最成功的创业案例之一。

blanks.en: Its special image of a brown kitten appears in grocery stores and cafes across the country.
blanks.zh: 它独特的棕色小猫标志出现在全国各地的食品杂货店和咖啡馆里。

blanks.en: What is the population of the town Everbrown?
blanks.zh: 埃弗布朗镇有多少人口？

blanks.en: What can we learn about the company Kitten Coffee?
blanks.zh: 关于小猫咖啡公司，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.en: What is the talk mainly about?
blanks.zh: 这段讲话主要讲什么？

blanks.en: Breaking through tightly sealed packaging can exhaust and frustrate you.
blanks.zh: 拆开密封严实的包装，可能让你又累又烦。

blanks.en: Five years ago, as a pioneer in e-commerce, we set up a team and announced a multi-year initiative to reduce your frustration.
blanks.zh: 五年前，作为电子商务的先行者，我们组建了一个团队，宣布启动一项持续多年的计划，来减少大家拆包装时的烦恼。

blanks.en: We named it Keep It Simple Packaging, or KIS Packaging for short.
blanks.zh: 我们把它叫做“保持简洁”包装，简称KIS包装。

blanks.en: At that time, we made an introduction video and got a great many comments like this.
blanks.zh: 当时，我们制作了一段介绍视频，并收到许多这样的评论。

blanks.en: The old packaging took scissors and sweat to open.
blanks.zh: 以前的包装得动剪刀、费一身汗才能打开。

blanks.en: The new way is perfect.
blanks.zh: 新的方式太好了。

blanks.en: Since the launch five years ago, our KIS team has worked hard.
blanks.zh: 自五年前推出以来，我们的KIS团队一直在努力。

blanks.en: We launched with 29 products.
blanks.zh: 最初推出时，只有二十九种产品。

blanks.en: Today, we offer more than 300,000 different products in KIS packaging, and they've been ordered more than 85 million times.
blanks.zh: 如今，我们提供三十多万种采用KIS包装的产品，订单数量已超过八千五百万次。

blanks.en: In addition to being frustration-free, this packaging is also better for the environment.
blanks.zh: 除了打开时省心，这种包装也更环保。

blanks.en: No clear plastic materials, and it's smaller.
blanks.zh: 不使用透明塑料材料，而且体积更小。

blanks.en: KIS Packaging has so far eliminated over 27.4 million pounds of packaging material.
blanks.zh: 到目前为止，KIS包装已减少使用了两千七百四十多万磅包装材料。

blanks.en: We still have further to go on this initiative, and we'll keep after it.
blanks.zh: 这项计划还要继续推进，我们会坚持做下去。

blanks.en: We want to say thank you to the millions of customers and thousands of sellers who have supported us on this journey so far.
blanks.zh: 我们想感谢迄今为止在这段历程中支持我们的数百万名顾客和数千名卖家。

blanks.en: If you'd like to share your feedback and suggestions with us this holiday season, you can reach us anytime at our website.
blanks.zh: 如果你想在这个假日季和我们分享反馈或建议，随时都可以通过网站联系我们。

blanks.en: Your comments are the driving force behind hundreds of packaging improvements every year.
blanks.zh: 你的评论是每年数百项包装改进背后的推动力。

blanks.en: Hey, Steven, I heard you are going to Paris as an exchange student.
blanks.zh: 嘿，斯蒂文，听说你要作为交换生去巴黎。

blanks.en: But you don't seem excited.
blanks.zh: 但你看上去不太兴奋。

blanks.en: The school doesn't have an on-campus dormitory for exchange students.
blanks.zh: 学校没有给交换生提供校内宿舍。

blanks.en: I'm thinking of renting an apartment.
blanks.zh: 我在考虑租套公寓。

blanks.en: But the places close to campus are expensive, and the affordable ones are too far.
blanks.zh: 但靠近学校的房子很贵，租得起的又太远。

blanks.en: Can't you take buses?
blanks.zh: 你不能坐公交吗？

blanks.en: Sometimes I have to stay on campus late for tons of laboratory work and assignments, after buses stop running.
blanks.zh: 有时我得为了大量实验和作业在学校待到很晚，错过公交末班车。

blanks.en: That's a point for being close to campus.
blanks.zh: 这确实是住得离学校近的一个理由。

blanks.en: Why not find a homestay family?
blanks.zh: 为什么不找个寄宿家庭呢？

blanks.en: You mean living with the local family?
blanks.zh: 你是说，和当地家庭一起住？

blanks.en: Yeah, you get your meals as well.
blanks.zh: 对，这样还有饭吃。

blanks.en: But the problem is my schedule.
blanks.zh: 但问题是我的作息安排。

blanks.en: I might not be able to have dinner at usual time, and I may wake people up when I come back late.
blanks.zh: 我可能没法按通常的时间吃晚饭，而且回来晚了可能吵醒别人。

blanks.en: Now, my only hope is to find a roommate.
blanks.zh: 现在，我唯一的希望就是找个室友。

blanks.en: Together we can afford a place close enough to the school.
blanks.zh: 我们一起分担，就能负担得起离学校足够近的住处。

blanks.en: But you may have different schedules.
blanks.zh: 但你们的作息可能不一样。

blanks.en: You could wake up your roommate as well.
blanks.zh: 你也可能吵醒室友。

blanks.en: I hope I can find one among my classmates, so we share the same schedule, and he might even give me a ride if he could drive.
blanks.zh: 我希望能从同班同学中找一个，这样我们作息相同；如果他会开车，说不定还能捎我一程。

blanks.zh: 现在，我唯一的希望就是找个室友。

blanks.en: Together we can afford a place close enough to the school.
blanks.zh: 我们一起分担，就能负担得起离学校足够近的住处。

blanks.en: But you may have different schedules.
blanks.zh: 但你们的作息可能不一样。

blanks.en: You could wake up your roommate as well.
blanks.zh: 你也可能吵醒室友。

blanks.en: I hope I can find one among my classmates, so we share the same schedule, and he might even give me a ride if he could drive.
blanks.zh: 我希望能从同班同学中找一个，这样我们作息相同；如果他会开车，说不定还能捎我一程。

blanks.en: What are the speakers mainly talking about?
blanks.zh: 两位说话人主要在谈什么？

blanks.en: According to the man, why does he have to live outside the campus?
blanks.zh: 根据男士所说，他为什么必须住在校外？

blanks.en: What does the man expect his life to be like in Paris?
blanks.zh: 男士预计自己在巴黎的生活会是什么样的？

blanks.en: Why does the man want to choose a classmate as his roommate?
blanks.zh: 男士为什么想选一个同班同学做室友？

blanks.en: Jenny, you can just drop me here.
blanks.zh: 珍妮，你把我放在这里就行。

blanks.en: But we're two streets away from the office.
blanks.zh: 可是这里离办公室还有两条街。

blanks.en: I had a big breakfast and feel like a bit of walk.
blanks.zh: 我早餐吃得很丰盛，想走一小段路。

blanks.en: Didn't sleep well last night?
blanks.zh: 昨晚没睡好吗？

blanks.en: No, not at all.
blanks.zh: 是的，一点也没睡好。

blanks.en: I had to work flat out to meet the project deadline.
blanks.zh: 我不得不全力工作，才能赶在项目截止日期前完成。

blanks.en: Now I'm really feeling a bit run down.
blanks.zh: 现在我真觉得有点精疲力竭了。

blanks.en: John, can't we go someplace and talk?
blanks.zh: 约翰，我们能不能换个地方聊？

blanks.en: It's so noisy in here.
blanks.zh: 这里太吵了。

blanks.en: Well, there's a small park across the street.
blanks.zh: 嗯，街对面有个小公园。

blanks.en: It's usually not crowded at this time of day.
blanks.zh: 一天中的这个时候，那里通常人不多。

blanks.en: We've got to do something about the neighbor's dog.
blanks.zh: 我们得想办法管管邻居家的狗了。

blanks.en: Has he been into your flower garden again?
blanks.zh: 它又跑进你的花园了吗？

blanks.en: The flower garden, the garbage can, and yesterday he started digging holes in the yard.
blanks.zh: 花园、垃圾桶它都去过，昨天还开始在院子里挖洞了。

blanks.en: We have a reservation in the name of Mr. Johns.
blanks.zh: 我们用约翰斯先生的名字订了位。

blanks.en: We've got this corner table for you.
blanks.zh: 我们给您安排了这张角落里的桌子。

blanks.en: It's quiet here, not close to the door.
blanks.zh: 这里很安静，离门也不近。

blanks.en: Dave, don't forget, we are invited out to dinner tonight.
blanks.zh: 戴夫，别忘了，今晚有人请我们出去吃饭。

blanks.en: Oh yeah, I almost forgot.
blanks.zh: 哦，对啊，我差点忘了。

blanks.en: We should leave the house by six thirty.
blanks.zh: 我们应该最迟六点半离开家。

blanks.en: You know how bad the traffic is that time of night.
blanks.zh: 你知道晚上那个时候交通有多拥堵。

blanks.en: It's informal, isn't it?
blanks.zh: 是非正式的聚餐，对吧？

blanks.en: You can wear your new sports jacket, the one I got you as an anniversary gift.
blanks.zh: 你可以穿你那件新的休闲西装外套，就是我送给你的结婚周年礼物。

blanks.en: Well, I've got to go.
blanks.zh: 好了，我得走了。

blanks.en: I'll try to get home a little earlier today.
blanks.zh: 我今天会尽量早点回家。

blanks.en: We need to decide exactly when we're going to move.
blanks.zh: 我们得确定究竟什么时候搬。

blanks.en: I think July would be the best time.
blanks.zh: 我认为七月是最合适的时候。

blanks.en: Our sales are always down that month.
blanks.zh: 我们那个月的销售额总会下降。

blanks.en: We could move all the office equipment at a weekend, do everything at once.
blanks.zh: 我们可以在一个周末搬走所有办公设备，一次全部搬完。

blanks.en: I think a weekend's too short.
blanks.zh: 我觉得一个周末太短了。

blanks.en: Maybe we should do it department by department.
blanks.zh: 也许我们应该分部门逐一搬迁。

blanks.en: What do you mean?
blanks.zh: 你是什么意思？

blanks.en: Well, each week a different department would move.
blanks.zh: 嗯，每周搬一个不同的部门。

blanks.en: That way there would always be people here to handle customer inquiries, phone calls, and so on.
blanks.zh: 那样这里就一直有人处理客户咨询、电话等事务。

blanks.en: Hm, that's a good idea.
blanks.zh: 嗯，这是个好主意。

blanks.en: So, Mr. Peter Sayles, I'd be curious to know what were the early connections in your life that led you into the art field.
blanks.zh: 那么，彼得·塞尔斯先生，我很想知道，你早年生活中的哪些接触让你走进了艺术领域？

blanks.en: My grandfather was an art dealer in Munich.
blanks.zh: 我的祖父是慕尼黑的一名艺术品商人。

blanks.en: They had a great museum in Munich.
blanks.zh: 慕尼黑有一座很棒的博物馆。

blanks.en: He took me to the museum, and I responded very strongly to what I saw on the walls there.
blanks.zh: 他带我去博物馆，那里墙上展出的作品让我有很强烈的感受。

blanks.en: I learned about art from him.
blanks.zh: 我从他那里学习艺术。

blanks.en: I learned about looking at art from him.
blanks.zh: 我从他那里学会了欣赏艺术。

blanks.en: Then, many years later, after I got out of the army, I went to study art history at the University of Chicago.
blanks.zh: 后来，过了很多年，我退伍后到芝加哥大学学习艺术史。

blanks.en: Well, we looked at the famous paintings by the great artists like Rembrandt, Botticelli, and Albrecht Dürer; Rubens' paintings were my favourites.

blanks.en: Yes, I remember these things.

blanks.en: When I was fourteen, I was so anxious to see more art that a friend of mine and I bicycled across the Alps to see Venice.

blanks.en: That was a pretty good idea, trying to have some work experience.

blanks.en: For the first three weeks, you know, I tried.
blanks.zh: 你知道，头三个星期我确实努力过。

blanks.en: But work was so fun, I met tons of new people, and soon I couldn't find even a minute for my paper.
blanks.zh: 可是工作太有意思了，我认识了好多新人，没多久就连一分钟写论文的时间都找不出来了。

blanks.en: So I had to quit my part-time job, and finally finished my paper in October.
blanks.zh: 所以我不得不辞掉兼职，最后在十月写完了论文。

blanks.en: Well, it's never too late to mend.
blanks.zh: 嗯，亡羊补牢，为时未晚。

blanks.en: It's kind of hard to find a balance between what you have to do and what you want to do.
blanks.zh: 在必须做的事和想做的事之间找到平衡，确实有点难。

blanks.en: Yeah, it's really important for me to balance study and work.
blanks.zh: 是啊，对我来说，平衡学习和工作真的很重要。

blanks.en: And I think I should learn to exercise some self-control.
blanks.zh: 而且我觉得，我应该学会克制自己。

blanks.en: Being an athlete is very fun, painful, and exciting.
blanks.zh: 当运动员很有趣，也很痛苦，还很令人兴奋。

blanks.en: Every time I come to the track, I feel like I'm out of this place.
blanks.zh: 每次来到跑道，我都感觉自己仿佛超脱了这里的一切。

blanks.en: This is Botswana National Stadium.

blanks.en: This is where I train.
blanks.zh: 我就在这里训练。

blanks.zh: 看到尤塞恩·博尔特在二〇一二年伦敦奥运会上奔跑时，我惊呆了。

blanks.en: Just watching him run got me motivated.
blanks.zh: 光是看他跑步，就让我有了动力。

blanks.en: I quit being a chess player and started to run.
blanks.zh: 我放弃了当国际象棋棋手，开始跑步。

blanks.en: I went to the twenty sixteen Olympics and went to the finals at the age of eighteen, and wow, I finished fifth.
blanks.zh: 我参加了二〇一六年奥运会，十八岁就进入了决赛，而且，哇，我获得了第五名。

blanks.en: It was a dream come true to me.
blanks.zh: 对我来说，那是梦想成真。

blanks.en: But I still wanted more.
blanks.zh: 但我仍然想取得更好的成绩。

blanks.en: The training is super hard, but the hardest part for me is that I got an injury, an injury which may take me out for years.
blanks.zh: 训练非常艰苦，但对我来说，最难熬的是我受了伤，这个伤可能让我好几年都无法参赛。

blanks.en: For a period of time, as a young athlete, I didn't know what to do.
blanks.zh: 作为一名年轻运动员，有一段时间我不知道该怎么办。

blanks.en: But now I'm back on the track.
blanks.zh: 但现在，我又回到了跑道上。

blanks.en: I really want to be there at the Olympics and do what I did before, do much, much greater.
blanks.zh: 我真的想再次参加奥运会，做到自己以前做过的事，而且要做得好得多。

blanks.en: I don't care about the gold, I don't care about the silver, I want to do my best, you know, take everything and show it to the world.
blanks.zh: 我不在乎金牌，也不在乎银牌；我想全力以赴，你知道，把自己的一切都展现给世界。

blanks.en: Fancy meeting you here on the train.
blanks.zh: 真没想到会在火车上碰见你。

blanks.en: How is your college life?
blanks.zh: 你的大学生活怎么样？

blanks.en: What can I say?
blanks.zh: 我还能说什么呢？

blanks.en: Well, early last March I started doing a part-time job in a law firm.
blanks.zh: 嗯，去年三月初，我开始在一家律师事务所做兼职。

blanks.en: A few weeks before, I had started writing my term paper.
blanks.zh: 在那之前几周，我已经开始写学期论文了。

blanks.en: That was a pretty good idea, trying to have some work experience.
blanks.zh: 想积累一些工作经验，这主意挺好的。

blanks.en: For the first three weeks, you know, I tried.
blanks.zh: 你知道，头三个星期，我确实努力了。

blanks.en: I got up early and worked for an hour on my paper before going to work.
blanks.zh: 我早早起床，上班前先写一个小时论文。

blanks.en: But work was so fun; I met tons of new people, and soon I couldn't find even a minute for my paper.
blanks.zh: 可是工作太有意思了，我认识了很多新朋友，很快连一分钟都腾不出来写论文了。

blanks.en: So I had to quit my part-time job and finally finished my paper in October.
blanks.zh: 所以，我只好辞掉兼职，最后到十月才写完论文。

blanks.en: Well, it's never too late to mend.
blanks.zh: 嗯，亡羊补牢，为时未晚。

blanks.en: It's kind of hard to find a balance between what you have to do and what you want to do.
blanks.zh: 在必须做的事和想做的事之间找到平衡，有点难。

blanks.en: Yeah, it's really important for me to balance study and work.
blanks.zh: 是啊，对我来说，平衡学业和工作真的很重要。

blanks.en: And I think I should learn to exercise some self-control.
blanks.zh: 而且我觉得自己应该学会克制。

blanks.en: Being an athlete is very fun, painful, and exciting.
blanks.zh: 当运动员很有趣，也很痛苦、很令人兴奋。

blanks.en: Every time I come to the track I feel like I'm out of this place.
blanks.zh: 每次来到跑道上，我都觉得自己仿佛置身别处。

blanks.en: This is Botswana National Stadium.
blanks.zh: 这里是博茨瓦纳国家体育场。

blanks.en: This is where I train.
blanks.zh: 我就在这里训练。

blanks.en: When I saw Usain Bolt running in twenty twelve London Olympics, I was amazed.
blanks.zh: 看到尤塞恩·博尔特在2012年伦敦奥运会上奔跑时，我惊叹不已。

blanks.en: Just watching him run got me motivated.
blanks.zh: 光是看着他跑，我就充满了动力。

blanks.en: I quit being a chess player and started to run.
blanks.zh: 我不再当国际象棋选手，开始跑步了。

blanks.en: I went to the twenty sixteen Olympics and went to the finals at the age of eighteen.
blanks.zh: 我参加了2016年奥运会，十八岁就进入了决赛。

blanks.en: And wow, I finished fifth.
blanks.zh: 哇，我获得了第五名。

blanks.en: It was a dream come true to me.
blanks.zh: 对我来说，那是梦想成真。

blanks.en: The training is super hard, but the hardest part for me is that I got an injury—an injury which may take me out for years.
blanks.zh: 训练极其艰苦，但对我来说最难的是，我受了伤，这次伤病可能让我好几年都无法参赛。

blanks.en: For a period of time, as a young athlete, I didn't know what to do.
blanks.zh: 有一段时间，作为一名年轻运动员，我不知道该怎么办。

blanks.en: But now I'm back on the track.
blanks.zh: 但现在，我重返跑道了。

blanks.en: I really want to be there at the Olympics and do what I did before—do much, much greater.
blanks.zh: 我真的希望再次站上奥运赛场，像以前那样比赛，取得好得多的成绩。

blanks.en: I don't care about the gold.
blanks.zh: 我不在乎金牌。

blanks.en: I don't care about the silver.
blanks.zh: 我不在乎银牌。

blanks.en: I want to do my best, you know.
blanks.zh: 我想全力以赴，你知道的。

blanks.zh: 当运动员很有趣，也很痛苦、很令人兴奋。
