blanks.en: We have to find a parking space.
blanks.zh: 我们得找个停车位。

blanks.en: Let's drive around the block one more time.
blanks.zh: 我们再绕这个街区开一圈吧。

blanks.en: Did you say the restaurant has no off-street parking at all?
blanks.zh: 你是说，这家餐馆除了路边就完全没地方停车吗？

blanks.en: Look, there's a space.
blanks.zh: 看，那里有个车位。

blanks.en: It's an hour's drive to the airport.
blanks.zh: 开车到机场要一个小时。

blanks.en: Don't forget to water my flowers.
blanks.zh: 别忘了给我的花浇水。

blanks.en: Where's my ticket, Dad?
blanks.zh: 爸爸，我的机票在哪儿？

blanks.en: Laura, what's in the mailbox?
blanks.zh: 劳拉，信箱里是什么？

blanks.en: It's a thank-you note from our neighbor.
blanks.zh: 是邻居写来的感谢信。

blanks.en: They thank us for visiting them last week when the baby was born.
blanks.zh: 他们感谢我们上周在宝宝出生后去看望他们。

blanks.en: They also invite us to have dinner next Friday.
blanks.zh: 他们还邀请我们下周五去吃晚饭。

blanks.en: Are they back home now?
blanks.zh: 他们现在已经回家了吗？

blanks.en: Good afternoon, Paper Museum.
blanks.zh: 下午好，这里是纸博物馆。

blanks.en: Could you tell me your opening hours for Saturday?
blanks.zh: 能告诉我你们星期六的开放时间吗？

blanks.en: Yeah, we're open from ten in the morning to five in the afternoon.
blanks.zh: 可以，上午十点到下午五点开放。

blanks.en: Where is the hotel gym, please?
blanks.zh: 请问，酒店的健身房在哪里？

blanks.en: It's on the top floor.
blanks.zh: 在顶楼。

blanks.en: You can take the lift over there.
blanks.zh: 你可以乘那边的电梯。

blanks.en: Do I have to pay extra?
blanks.zh: 我需要另外付费吗？

blanks.en: You just need to take your room key with you.
blanks.zh: 你只需要带上房间钥匙。

blanks.en: Mr. Wilson, students from Class Two want to visit the history museum.
blanks.zh: 威尔逊先生，二班的学生想去参观历史博物馆。

blanks.en: Will it be all right if I take them there this weekend?
blanks.zh: 我这周末带他们去，可以吗？

blanks.en: How about their revision test?
blanks.zh: 他们的复习测试怎么样了？

blanks.en: Are they through with it?
blanks.zh: 已经考完了吗？

blanks.en: In that case, you can go ahead.
blanks.zh: 这样的话，你可以安排了。

blanks.en: Try to finish it within one day, so that the students still have a whole day to rest on Sunday.
blanks.zh: 尽量在一天之内结束，这样学生星期天还能有一整天休息。

blanks.en: All right, I'll manage.
blanks.zh: 好的，我会安排好的。

blanks.en: Fancy seeing you here.
blanks.zh: 真没想到在这里见到你。

blanks.en: How long have you been shopping?
blanks.zh: 你逛多久了？

blanks.en: I have a lot to buy.
blanks.zh: 我要买的东西很多。

blanks.en: My daughter Melissa's birthday is coming.
blanks.zh: 我女儿梅莉莎的生日快到了。

blanks.en: I'm trying to get her a good gift, but I don't know what to choose.
blanks.zh: 我想给她买一份好礼物，可不知道选什么。

blanks.en: She seems to have everything she loves.
blanks.zh: 她喜欢的东西似乎都已经有了。

blanks.en: Yeah, the same as Clara.
blanks.zh: 是啊，克拉拉也一样。

blanks.en: We've already had bags of toys she's no longer playing with.
blanks.zh: 我们已经有一大堆她不再玩的玩具了。

blanks.en: So this year we didn't buy her material things.
blanks.zh: 所以今年我们没给她买实物礼物。

blanks.en: We gave her an experience gift.
blanks.zh: 我们送了她一份体验式礼物。

blanks.en: A city pass, with which she can visit twelve different attractions, including the National History Museum, the Science Museum, the zoo, and more.
blanks.zh: 一张城市游览通票，她可以凭票参观十二处不同的景点，包括国家历史博物馆、科学博物馆、动物园等等。

blanks.en: How much is it?
blanks.zh: 多少钱？

blanks.en: Fifty dollars per person for a year-long pass.
blanks.zh: 一张有效期一年的通票，每人五十美元。

blanks.en: I bought three for the whole family.
blanks.zh: 我买了三张，全家人都有。

blanks.en: So you can have a different outing every month for the entire year?
blanks.zh: 这么说，整整一年里，你们每个月都能去不同的地方游玩？

blanks.en: What a great idea.
blanks.zh: 真是个好主意！

blanks.en: Helen, busy doing anything?
blanks.zh: 海伦，你在忙什么吗？

blanks.en: Oh, Kevin, I'm preparing a presentation for the city library.
blanks.zh: 哦，凯文，我在给市图书馆准备一场报告。

blanks.en: It's about a girl named Tracy Woods.
blanks.zh: 讲的是一个叫特蕾西·伍兹的女孩。

blanks.en: What's special about her?
blanks.zh: 她有什么特别之处？

blanks.en: It was an amazing story.
blanks.zh: 这个故事很了不起。

blanks.en: She brought specially trained dogs to special education schools and helped children to build confidence.
blanks.zh: 她把受过专门训练的狗带到特殊教育学校，帮助孩子们建立自信。

blanks.en: She believes that dogs can help children in ways we can't.
blanks.zh: 她相信，狗能以我们做不到的方式帮助孩子。

blanks.en: Dogs don't judge, and they don't care who you are or what you look like.
blanks.zh: 狗不会评判别人，也不在乎你是谁、长什么样。

blanks.en: Aren't they going to mess up the school?
blanks.zh: 它们不会把学校弄得乱七八糟吗？

blanks.en: All the dogs are assessed and trained properly.
blanks.zh: 所有的狗都经过了评估和恰当的训练。

blanks.en: There are now forty dogs working with children aged from six to eighteen.
blanks.zh: 现在有四十只狗在陪伴六至十八岁的孩子。

blanks.en: I hope the children love them.
blanks.zh: 希望孩子们喜欢它们。

blanks.en: Of course they do.
blanks.zh: 他们当然喜欢。

blanks.en: I've got some pictures.
blanks.zh: 我有一些照片。

blanks.en: I'll show them at my presentation tomorrow morning.
blanks.zh: 明天上午作报告时，我会展示这些照片。

blanks.en: Emily, thank you for taking time out of your busy schedule to answer a few questions.
blanks.zh: 艾米莉，谢谢你在百忙之中抽出时间回答几个问题。

blanks.en: People say you're doing unpaid work in the new season of My Fair Lady.
blanks.zh: 听说你在新一季《窈窕淑女》中无偿参演。

blanks.en: Is this what the show business has become?
blanks.zh: 演艺圈现在已经变成这样了吗？

blanks.en: All of my acting in the new season is unpaid, but the crew is paid.
blanks.zh: 我在新一季中的所有表演都是无偿的，但工作人员是有报酬的。

blanks.en: This is to raise money for the post-production of the show.
blanks.zh: 这是为了给这部作品的后期制作筹款。

blanks.en: I notice you've tried many different kinds of things: film, TV and even theatre.
blanks.zh: 我注意到你尝试过许多不同的工作，电影、电视，甚至戏剧。

blanks.en: Yeah, that's how I was trained at university.
blanks.zh: 是的，我在大学接受的就是这样的训练。

blanks.en: I work on anything that excites me.
blanks.zh: 只要是让我感兴趣的工作，我都会做。

blanks.en: Tell us about the six months you recently spent at the workshop of the Film Center.
blanks.zh: 说说你最近在电影中心工作坊度过的那六个月吧。

blanks.en: It was an unbelievable experience, teaching young actors and actresses, and working with some great acting artists.
blanks.zh: 那是一段难以置信的经历：教年轻的男女演员，也和一些优秀的表演艺术家一起工作。

blanks.en: It was also great to work in various labs such as directors, writers, and so on.
blanks.zh: 在各种实践工作坊里参与导演、编剧等工作，也很棒。

blanks.en: It's very helpful for making you a really well-rounded and active member of the film and television industry.
blanks.zh: 这很有助于让你成为影视行业里一名全面发展、积极活跃的从业者。

blanks.en: Thank you very much, Emily.
blanks.zh: 非常感谢你，艾米莉。

blanks.en: We look forward to your new season.
blanks.zh: 我们期待你的新一季演出。

blanks.en: This is the monthly meeting of our club.
blanks.zh: 这是我们俱乐部的每月例会。

blanks.en: We've been fortunate to have got good advice from some famous athletes on how to improve our skills and build up our body.
blanks.zh: 我们很幸运，得到了一些著名运动员的好建议，学到了如何提升技能、增强体质。

blanks.en: Today we'll hear something different.
blanks.zh: 今天，我们要听一些不同的内容。

blanks.en: We're honored to have Emma Wilson here.
blanks.zh: 我们很荣幸请到了埃玛·威尔逊。

blanks.en: Emma is a health expert and lecturer from UBC, the University of British Columbia.
blanks.zh: 埃玛是不列颠哥伦比亚大学的健康专家和讲师，学校简称UBC。

blanks.en: Emma worked for a football team in Manchester, then for a very successful rugby team in Dublin, and finally ended up working here in Vancouver.
blanks.zh: 埃玛先为曼彻斯特的一支足球队工作，随后服务于都柏林一支非常成功的橄榄球队，最后来到温哥华工作。

blanks.en: Emma says it's challenging to be a health expert because people can be easily influenced by advertisements that lack scientific support.
blanks.zh: 埃玛说，做健康专家很有挑战性，因为人们很容易受到那些缺乏科学依据的广告影响。

blanks.en: Also, people aren't willing to change their views about food and nutrition as there is so much confusing information online.
blanks.zh: 另外，人们也不愿改变对食物和营养的看法，因为网上让人困惑的信息实在太多了。

blanks.en: It's really important to hear what experts say, and that's why we've invited Emma here.
blanks.zh: 听听专家怎么说真的很重要，这也是我们邀请埃玛来的原因。

blanks.en: She isn't going to tell us about everything we should eat, but she will teach us to make better choices.
blanks.zh: 她不会把我们该吃的所有食物都列出来，但她会教我们作出更好的选择。

blanks.en: Let's welcome Emma Wilson.
blanks.zh: 让我们欢迎埃玛·威尔逊。

blanks.zh: 我们得找个停车位。

blanks.zh: 能告诉我你们周六的开放时间吗？

blanks.zh: 可以，我们上午十点开放，下午五点闭馆。

blanks.zh: 请问酒店健身房在哪里？

blanks.zh: 在顶楼。

blanks.zh: 您可以乘那边的电梯。

blanks.zh: 我需要另外付钱吗？

blanks.zh: 我们送了她一份体验类礼物。

blanks.en: A city pass, with which she can visit twelve different attractions, including the National History Museum, the Science Museum, the Zoo, and more.
blanks.zh: 是一张城市通票，凭这张票她可以去十二个不同的景点，包括国家历史博物馆、科学博物馆、动物园等。

blanks.en: How much is it?
blanks.zh: 多少钱？

blanks.en: Fifty dollars per person for a year-long pass.
blanks.zh: 一张全年通票，每人五十美元。

blanks.en: I bought three for the whole family.
blanks.zh: 我买了三张，够全家人用。

blanks.en: So you can have a different outing every month for the entire year.
blanks.zh: 这样一来，一整年你们每个月都能去不同的地方游玩。

blanks.en: What a great idea!
blanks.zh: 这个主意真好！

blanks.en: Helen, busy doing anything?
blanks.zh: 海伦，在忙什么吗？

blanks.en: Oh, Kevin, I'm preparing a presentation for the City Library.
blanks.zh: 哦，凯文，我正在准备一场在市图书馆做的报告。

blanks.en: It's about a girl named Tracy Woods.
blanks.zh: 是关于一个叫特蕾西·伍兹的女孩的。

blanks.en: What's special about her?
blanks.zh: 她有什么特别之处？

blanks.en: It was an amazing story.
blanks.zh: 那是个令人惊叹的故事。

blanks.en: She brought specially trained dogs to special education schools and helped children to build confidence.
blanks.zh: 她把受过专门训练的狗带到特殊教育学校，帮助孩子们树立信心。

blanks.en: She believes that dogs can help children in ways we can't.
blanks.zh: 她认为，狗能以我们做不到的方式帮助孩子。

blanks.en: Dogs don't judge, and they don't care who you are or what you look like.
blanks.zh: 狗不会评判人，也不在乎你是谁、长什么样。

blanks.en: But putting dogs into a school?
blanks.zh: 可是，把狗带进学校？

blanks.en: Aren't they going to mess up the school?
blanks.zh: 它们不会把学校弄得一团糟吗？

blanks.en: All the dogs are assessed and trained properly.
blanks.zh: 所有的狗都经过了评估，也接受了规范的训练。

blanks.en: There are now forty dogs working with children aged from six to eighteen.
blanks.zh: 现在有四十只狗在陪伴六到十八岁的孩子开展活动。

blanks.en: I hope the children love them.
blanks.zh: 我希望孩子们喜欢它们。

blanks.en: Of course they do.
blanks.zh: 他们当然喜欢。

blanks.en: I've got some pictures.
blanks.zh: 我有一些照片。

blanks.en: I'll show them at my presentation tomorrow morning.
blanks.zh: 我会在明天上午做报告时展示这些照片。

blanks.en: Emily, thank you for taking time out of your busy schedule to answer a few questions.
blanks.zh: 埃米莉，谢谢你从繁忙的日程中抽出时间回答几个问题。

blanks.en: People say you're doing unpaid work in the new season of My Fair Lady.
blanks.zh: 听说你在新一季《窈窕淑女》中的工作不拿报酬。

blanks.en: Is this what the show business has become?
blanks.zh: 现在演艺行业已经变成这样了吗？

blanks.en: All of my acting in the new season is unpaid, but the crew is paid.
blanks.zh: 新一季里我的表演都不拿报酬，但制作团队是有工资的。

blanks.en: This is to raise money for the post-production of the show.
blanks.zh: 这样做是为了给节目的后期制作筹款。

blanks.en: I notice you've tried many different kinds of things: film, TV, and even theatre.
blanks.zh: 我注意到，你尝试过很多不同的领域：电影、电视，甚至还有戏剧。

blanks.en: Yeah, that's how I was trained at university.
blanks.zh: 是的，我在大学接受的就是这样的训练。

blanks.en: I work on anything that excites me.
blanks.zh: 只要能让我感到兴奋的工作，我都愿意做。

blanks.en: Tell us about the six months you recently spent at the workshop of the Film Center.
blanks.zh: 和我们谈谈你最近在电影中心工作坊度过的那六个月吧。

blanks.en: It was an unbelievable experience, teaching young actors and actresses, and working with some great acting artists.
blanks.zh: 那是一段非同寻常的经历，我教年轻的男女演员，也和一些优秀的表演艺术家共事。

blanks.en: It was also great to work in various labs such as directors, writers, and so on.
blanks.zh: 在导演、编剧等各类工作坊中工作也很棒。

blanks.en: It's very helpful for making you a really well-rounded and active member of the film and television industry.
blanks.zh: 这很有助于让你成为影视行业中能力全面、积极活跃的一员。

blanks.en: Thank you very much, Emily.
blanks.zh: 非常感谢你，埃米莉。

blanks.en: We look forward to your new season.
blanks.zh: 我们期待你的新一季作品。

blanks.en: This is the monthly meeting of our club.
blanks.zh: 这是我们俱乐部每月一次的例会。

blanks.en: We've been fortunate to have got good advice from some famous athletes on how to improve our skills and build up our body.
blanks.zh: 我们很幸运，曾得到一些著名运动员的建议，了解如何提高技能、增强体质。

blanks.en: Today we'll hear something different.
blanks.zh: 今天我们要听一些不一样的内容。

blanks.en: We're honored to have Emma Wilson here.
blanks.zh: 我们很荣幸请到了埃玛·威尔逊。

blanks.en: Emma is a health expert and lecturer from UBC, the University of British Columbia.
blanks.zh: 埃玛是不列颠哥伦比亚大学的健康专家和讲师，该校简称UBC。

blanks.en: Emma worked for a football team in Manchester, then for a very successful rugby team in Dublin, and finally ended up working here in Vancouver.
blanks.zh: 埃玛先在曼彻斯特的一支足球队工作，随后去了都柏林一支非常成功的橄榄球队，最后来到这里，在温哥华工作。

blanks.en: Emma says it's challenging to be a health expert because people can be easily influenced by advertisements that lack scientific support.
blanks.zh: 埃玛说，做健康专家很有挑战性，因为人们很容易受到缺乏科学依据的广告的影响。

blanks.en: Also, people aren't willing to change their views about food and nutrition as there is so much confusing information online.
blanks.zh: 而且，人们不愿改变自己对食物和营养的看法，因为网上令人困惑的信息实在太多了。

blanks.en: It's really important to hear what experts say, and that's why we've invited Emma here.
blanks.zh: 听听专家的意见真的很重要，这也正是我们邀请埃玛来的原因。

blanks.en: She isn't going to tell us about everything we should eat, but she will teach us to make better choices.
blanks.zh: 她不会一一告诉我们所有该吃的东西，而是会教我们如何作出更好的选择。

blanks.en: Let's welcome Emma Wilson.
blanks.zh: 让我们欢迎埃玛·威尔逊。

blanks.en: Professor Jackson, could I talk to you about my paper sometime today?
blanks.zh: 杰克逊教授，今天能找个时间和您谈谈我的论文吗？

blanks.en: When the class is over, I need to go to the lab first, and then I'll be at the cafeteria at about twelve thirty.
blanks.zh: 下课后我得先去实验室，然后大约十二点半会去食堂。

blanks.en: What are you cooking?
blanks.zh: 你在做什么菜？

blanks.en: I'm making a carrot cake.
blanks.zh: 我在做胡萝卜蛋糕。

blanks.en: Nice! I see a roast chicken and an apple pie over there, too.
blanks.zh: 真不错！我看那边还有烤鸡和苹果派。

blanks.en: The chicken is for dinner and the pie is for Jeff.
blanks.zh: 鸡是晚饭吃的，派是给杰夫的。

blanks.en: He has to take something to school tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 他明天得带点吃的去学校。

blanks.en: This neighborhood really needs a library.
blanks.zh: 这个社区真的需要一座图书馆。

blanks.en: How can we get one?
blanks.zh: 我们怎样才能有一座呢？

blanks.en: I think we should have a meeting to talk about it.
blanks.zh: 我觉得我们应该开个会讨论一下。

blanks.en: It's very exciting, and I'm really learning a lot.
blanks.zh: 很有意思，而且我真的学到了很多。

blanks.en: But it's also quite tiring.
blanks.zh: 不过也挺累的。

blanks.en: I feel like a good break this weekend.
blanks.zh: 这周末我想好好休息一下。

blanks.en: Amanda, what skill would you like to develop?
blanks.zh: 阿曼达，你想培养哪项技能？

blanks.en: Well, I want to learn to play the guitar.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我想学弹吉他。

blanks.en: I love writing songs, you know, and I think it would be lovely if I could play my own music and entertain people.
blanks.zh: 我喜欢写歌，你知道的。我想，要是能演奏自己创作的音乐，让大家开心，那一定很好。

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'm calling for information on opening a savings account.
blanks.zh: 我打电话来想了解开立储蓄账户的事。

blanks.en: Have you had any accounts in our bank before?
blanks.zh: 您以前在我们银行开过账户吗？

blanks.en: No, I don't think so.
blanks.zh: 没有，我想没有。

blanks.en: Then you'll have to go in person to one of our branches and talk to a clerk there.
blanks.zh: 那您必须亲自去我们的一家分行，找那里的职员办理。

blanks.en: Is there a bank near Brown College?
blanks.zh: 布朗学院附近有你们的银行吗？

blanks.en: We have one branch at 135 Dudley Road and one at 512 Kingfield Street.
blanks.zh: 我们在达德利路135号和金菲尔德街512号各有一家分行。

blanks.en: I think I will go to the one on Dudley.
blanks.zh: 我想我会去达德利路那家。

blanks.en: Good morning, Frank Sampson's.
blanks.zh: 早上好，这里是弗兰克·桑普森公司。

blanks.en: Could I speak to Mr. Smith, please?
blanks.zh: 请问史密斯先生在吗？

blanks.en: Mr. Smith is having a meeting right now.
blanks.zh: 史密斯先生现在正在开会。

blanks.en: Would you like to leave a message or call back later?
blanks.zh: 您想留言，还是稍后再打来？

blanks.en: What time is the meeting over?
blanks.zh: 会议什么时候结束？

blanks.en: Well, it started at one o'clock and it usually lasts about two hours.
blanks.zh: 会议一点钟开始，通常要开两个小时左右。

blanks.en: In that case, could you please tell him to check his email?
blanks.zh: 这样的话，能请您转告他查收电子邮件吗？

blanks.en: I've sent him an important document.
blanks.zh: 我给他发了一份重要文件。

blanks.en: I'm waiting for his reply.
blanks.zh: 我在等他回复。

blanks.en: I'd like to know what will be the best time for us to meet before Friday.
blanks.zh: 我想知道星期五之前什么时候最适合我们见面。

blanks.en: Please tell him to include the time in his reply.
blanks.zh: 请转告他在回复中写明时间。

blanks.en: Do you want to meet him in our office or in your office, sir?
blanks.zh: 先生，您想在我们办公室见他，还是在您那里？

blanks.en: I'll tell him when he's back.
blanks.zh: 他回来后我会告诉他。

blanks.en: It's for my sister.
blanks.zh: 这是送给我姐姐的。

blanks.en: It's her graduation day today.
blanks.zh: 今天是她毕业的日子。

blanks.en: I paid sixty dollars for it, but it's worth it.
blanks.zh: 我花了六十美元，不过很值得。

blanks.en: Jane worked very hard for her degree over the last four years.
blanks.zh: 过去四年里，简为了拿到学位一直很用功。

blanks.en: Today is a very important day for her, and I want it to be special.
blanks.zh: 今天对她来说很重要，我想让这一天特别一点。

blanks.en: That's very nice of you.
blanks.zh: 你真体贴。

blanks.en: I wish it were our graduation day, too.
blanks.zh: 我真希望今天也是我们毕业的日子。

blanks.en: Another three years and we'll be done too.
blanks.zh: 再过三年，我们也就毕业了。

blanks.en: Where are they going to hold the graduation ceremony?
blanks.zh: 他们打算在哪里举行毕业典礼？

blanks.en: In the conference hall at two p.m.
blanks.zh: 在会议厅，下午两点。

blanks.en: It'll be a big ceremony.
blanks.zh: 典礼的规模会很大。

blanks.en: I guess you should be there early.
blanks.zh: 我想你应该早点过去。

blanks.en: Otherwise you won't get a seat.
blanks.zh: 不然就没有座位了。

blanks.en: Yes, I'll try to find a seat close to the stage.
blanks.zh: 是的，我会尽量找个靠近舞台的座位。

blanks.en: Give Jane my best wishes.
blanks.zh: 替我向简送上最好的祝愿。

blanks.en: Oh, I can't believe it! Peter, I haven't seen you for ages.
blanks.zh: 哦，真不敢相信！彼得，好久没见你了。

blanks.en: Nice to meet you here.
blanks.zh: 真高兴在这里见到你。

blanks.en: It's really great to see you.
blanks.zh: 见到你真是太好了。

blanks.en: Do you have time to sit down?
blanks.zh: 你有时间坐一会儿吗？

blanks.en: I was leaving, but I can join you for a few minutes.
blanks.zh: 我刚准备走，不过可以陪你坐几分钟。

blanks.en: Great. So tell me, how's your family?
blanks.zh: 太好了。说说吧，你家里人都怎么样？

blanks.en: Well, it keeps getting bigger.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我们家的人越来越多了。

blanks.en: We have four kids now, all boys.
blanks.zh: 我们现在有四个孩子，全是男孩。

blanks.en: I suppose they keep you busy.
blanks.zh: 我想他们肯定让你忙得够呛。

blanks.en: The baby is only one month old, so Sally is not working right now.
blanks.zh: 最小的孩子才一个月大，所以萨莉现在没有上班。

blanks.en: And what's new with you and Jim?
blanks.zh: 你和吉姆最近有什么新情况？

blanks.en: Believe it or not, he's home with the kids.
blanks.zh: 说出来你也许不信，他在家带孩子。

blanks.en: Jim chose to work from home so we could spend less on childcare.
blanks.zh: 吉姆选择在家办公，这样我们就能少花些托育费。

blanks.en: I love it because he does all the shopping and cleaning.
blanks.zh: 我很喜欢这样，因为买东西和打扫卫生都由他来做。

blanks.en: It's already twelve thirty.
blanks.zh: 已经十二点半了。

blanks.en: I have to go now.
blanks.zh: 我现在得走了。

blanks.en: I have an important meeting this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 我今天下午有个重要会议。

blanks.en: Tell Jim I said hi, and I'll call you so we can have dinner sometime.
blanks.zh: 替我向吉姆问好，我会打电话给你，找个时间一起吃晚饭。

blanks.en: And say hi to Sally and the kids.
blanks.zh: 也替我向萨莉和孩子们问好。

blanks.en: Thanks for joining us.
blanks.zh: 感谢大家收听我们的节目。

blanks.en: In today's edition of Perfect Life, our guest is Brock Bastian, a social psychologist from the University of Melbourne.
blanks.zh: 今天的《完美生活》节目请到的嘉宾是墨尔本大学的社会心理学家布罗克·巴斯蒂安。

blanks.en: Professor Bastian's research focuses on pain, happiness, and morality.
blanks.zh: 巴斯蒂安教授的研究主要关注痛苦、幸福和道德。

blanks.en: Recently he published a book on the role of pain in promoting pleasure.
blanks.zh: 最近，他出版了一本探讨痛苦如何促进快乐的书。

blanks.en: The title of the book is The Other Side of Happiness.
blanks.zh: 这本书名叫《幸福的另一面》。

blanks.en: In this book he argues that as we seek to escape pain or sorrow, we are weakening ourselves and may lose our adaptive ability to deal with pain in the future.
blanks.zh: 他在书中提出，我们在设法逃避痛苦或悲伤时，也在削弱自己，将来可能失去适应和应对痛苦的能力。

blanks.en: Painful experiences are in fact vital for our development and how we face the unavoidable challenges ahead.
blanks.zh: 痛苦的经历其实对我们的成长，以及我们如何面对前方不可避免的挑战，都至关重要。

blanks.en: And they play a key role in helping us develop our ability to feel truly happy.
blanks.zh: 这些经历也在帮助我们培养感受真正幸福的能力方面发挥关键作用。

blanks.en: Now let's welcome Professor Bastian to talk about his ideas in the book.
blanks.zh: 现在，让我们欢迎巴斯蒂安教授来谈谈他书中的观点。

blanks.en: We have to find a parking space.
blanks.zh: 我们得找个停车位。

blanks.en: Let's drive around the block one more time.
blanks.zh: 我们再绕这个街区开一圈吧。

blanks.en: Did you say the restaurant has no off-street parking at all?
blanks.zh: 你是说，这家餐馆除了路边就完全没地方停车吗？

blanks.en: Look, there's a space.
blanks.zh: 看，那里有个车位。

blanks.en: It's an hour's drive to the airport.
blanks.zh: 开车到机场要一个小时。

blanks.en: Don't forget to water my flowers.
blanks.zh: 别忘了给我的花浇水。

blanks.en: Where's my ticket, Dad?
blanks.zh: 爸爸，我的机票在哪儿？

blanks.en: Laura, what's in the mailbox?
blanks.zh: 劳拉，信箱里是什么？

blanks.en: It's a thank-you note from our neighbor.
blanks.zh: 是邻居写来的感谢信。

blanks.en: They thank us for visiting them last week when the baby was born.
blanks.zh: 他们感谢我们上周在宝宝出生后去看望他们。

blanks.en: They also invite us to have dinner next Friday.
blanks.zh: 他们还邀请我们下周五去吃晚饭。

blanks.en: Are they back home now?
blanks.zh: 他们现在已经回家了吗？

blanks.en: Good afternoon, Paper Museum.
blanks.zh: 下午好，这里是纸博物馆。

blanks.en: Could you tell me your opening hours for Saturday?
blanks.zh: 能告诉我你们星期六的开放时间吗？

blanks.en: Yeah, we're open from ten in the morning to five in the afternoon.
blanks.zh: 可以，上午十点到下午五点开放。

blanks.en: Where is the hotel gym, please?
blanks.zh: 请问，酒店的健身房在哪里？

blanks.en: It's on the top floor.
blanks.zh: 在顶楼。

blanks.en: You can take the lift over there.
blanks.zh: 你可以乘那边的电梯。

blanks.en: Do I have to pay extra?
blanks.zh: 我需要另外付费吗？

blanks.en: You just need to take your room key with you.
blanks.zh: 你只需要带上房间钥匙。

blanks.en: Mr. Wilson, students from Class Two want to visit the history museum.
blanks.zh: 威尔逊先生，二班的学生想去参观历史博物馆。

blanks.en: Will it be all right if I take them there this weekend?
blanks.zh: 我这周末带他们去，可以吗？

blanks.en: How about their revision test?
blanks.zh: 他们的复习测试怎么样了？

blanks.en: Are they through with it?
blanks.zh: 已经考完了吗？

blanks.en: In that case, you can go ahead.
blanks.zh: 这样的话，你可以安排了。

blanks.en: Try to finish it within one day, so that the students still have a whole day to rest on Sunday.
blanks.zh: 尽量在一天之内结束，这样学生星期天还能有一整天休息。

blanks.en: All right, I'll manage.
blanks.zh: 好的，我会安排好的。

blanks.en: Fancy seeing you here.
blanks.zh: 真没想到在这里见到你。

blanks.en: How long have you been shopping?
blanks.zh: 你逛多久了？

blanks.en: I have a lot to buy.
blanks.zh: 我要买的东西很多。

blanks.en: My daughter Melissa's birthday is coming.
blanks.zh: 我女儿梅莉莎的生日快到了。

blanks.en: I'm trying to get her a good gift, but I don't know what to choose.
blanks.zh: 我想给她买一份好礼物，可不知道选什么。

blanks.en: She seems to have everything she loves.
blanks.zh: 她喜欢的东西似乎都已经有了。

blanks.en: Yeah, the same as Clara.
blanks.zh: 是啊，克拉拉也一样。

blanks.en: We've already had bags of toys she's no longer playing with.
blanks.zh: 我们已经有一大堆她不再玩的玩具了。

blanks.en: So this year we didn't buy her material things.
blanks.zh: 所以今年我们没给她买实物礼物。

blanks.en: We gave her an experience gift.
blanks.zh: 我们送了她一份体验式礼物。

blanks.en: A city pass, with which she can visit twelve different attractions, including the National History Museum, the Science Museum, the zoo, and more.
blanks.zh: 一张城市游览通票，她可以凭票参观十二处不同的景点，包括国家历史博物馆、科学博物馆、动物园等等。

blanks.en: How much is it?
blanks.zh: 多少钱？

blanks.en: Fifty dollars per person for a year-long pass.
blanks.zh: 一张有效期一年的通票，每人五十美元。

blanks.en: I bought three for the whole family.
blanks.zh: 我买了三张，全家人都有。

blanks.en: So you can have a different outing every month for the entire year?
blanks.zh: 这么说，整整一年里，你们每个月都能去不同的地方游玩？

blanks.en: What a great idea.
blanks.zh: 真是个好主意！

blanks.en: Helen, busy doing anything?
blanks.zh: 海伦，你在忙什么吗？

blanks.en: Oh, Kevin, I'm preparing a presentation for the city library.
blanks.zh: 哦，凯文，我在给市图书馆准备一场报告。

blanks.en: It's about a girl named Tracy Woods.
blanks.zh: 讲的是一个叫特蕾西·伍兹的女孩。

blanks.en: What's special about her?
blanks.zh: 她有什么特别之处？

blanks.en: It was an amazing story.
blanks.zh: 这个故事很了不起。

blanks.en: She brought specially trained dogs to special education schools and helped children to build confidence.
blanks.zh: 她把受过专门训练的狗带到特殊教育学校，帮助孩子们建立自信。

blanks.en: She believes that dogs can help children in ways we can't.
blanks.zh: 她相信，狗能以我们做不到的方式帮助孩子。

blanks.en: Dogs don't judge, and they don't care who you are or what you look like.
blanks.zh: 狗不会评判别人，也不在乎你是谁、长什么样。

blanks.en: Aren't they going to mess up the school?
blanks.zh: 它们不会把学校弄得乱七八糟吗？

blanks.en: All the dogs are assessed and trained properly.
blanks.zh: 所有的狗都经过了评估和恰当的训练。

blanks.en: There are now forty dogs working with children aged from six to eighteen.
blanks.zh: 现在有四十只狗在陪伴六至十八岁的孩子。

blanks.en: I hope the children love them.
blanks.zh: 希望孩子们喜欢它们。

blanks.en: Of course they do.
blanks.zh: 他们当然喜欢。

blanks.en: I've got some pictures.
blanks.zh: 我有一些照片。

blanks.en: I'll show them at my presentation tomorrow morning.
blanks.zh: 明天上午作报告时，我会展示这些照片。

blanks.en: Emily, thank you for taking time out of your busy schedule to answer a few questions.
blanks.zh: 艾米莉，谢谢你在百忙之中抽出时间回答几个问题。

blanks.en: People say you're doing unpaid work in the new season of My Fair Lady.
blanks.zh: 听说你在新一季《窈窕淑女》中无偿参演。

blanks.en: Is this what the show business has become?
blanks.zh: 演艺圈现在已经变成这样了吗？

blanks.en: All of my acting in the new season is unpaid, but the crew is paid.
blanks.zh: 我在新一季中的所有表演都是无偿的，但工作人员是有报酬的。

blanks.en: This is to raise money for the post-production of the show.
blanks.zh: 这是为了给这部作品的后期制作筹款。

blanks.en: I notice you've tried many different kinds of things: film, TV and even theatre.
blanks.zh: 我注意到你尝试过许多不同的工作，电影、电视，甚至戏剧。

blanks.en: Yeah, that's how I was trained at university.
blanks.zh: 是的，我在大学接受的就是这样的训练。

blanks.en: I work on anything that excites me.
blanks.zh: 只要是让我感兴趣的工作，我都会做。

blanks.en: Tell us about the six months you recently spent at the workshop of the Film Center.
blanks.zh: 说说你最近在电影中心工作坊度过的那六个月吧。

blanks.en: It was an unbelievable experience, teaching young actors and actresses, and working with some great acting artists.
blanks.zh: 那是一段难以置信的经历：教年轻的男女演员，也和一些优秀的表演艺术家一起工作。

blanks.en: It was also great to work in various labs such as directors, writers, and so on.
blanks.zh: 在各种实践工作坊里参与导演、编剧等工作，也很棒。

blanks.en: It's very helpful for making you a really well-rounded and active member of the film and television industry.
blanks.zh: 这很有助于让你成为影视行业里一名全面发展、积极活跃的从业者。

blanks.en: Thank you very much, Emily.
blanks.zh: 非常感谢你，艾米莉。

blanks.en: We look forward to your new season.
blanks.zh: 我们期待你的新一季演出。

blanks.en: This is the monthly meeting of our club.
blanks.zh: 这是我们俱乐部的每月例会。

blanks.en: We've been fortunate to have got good advice from some famous athletes on how to improve our skills and build up our body.
blanks.zh: 我们很幸运，得到了一些著名运动员的好建议，学到了如何提升技能、增强体质。

blanks.en: Today we'll hear something different.
blanks.zh: 今天，我们要听一些不同的内容。

blanks.en: We're honored to have Emma Wilson here.
blanks.zh: 我们很荣幸请到了埃玛·威尔逊。

blanks.en: Emma is a health expert and lecturer from UBC, the University of British Columbia.
blanks.zh: 埃玛是不列颠哥伦比亚大学的健康专家和讲师，学校简称UBC。

blanks.en: Emma worked for a football team in Manchester, then for a very successful rugby team in Dublin, and finally ended up working here in Vancouver.
blanks.zh: 埃玛先为曼彻斯特的一支足球队工作，随后服务于都柏林一支非常成功的橄榄球队，最后来到温哥华工作。

blanks.en: Emma says it's challenging to be a health expert because people can be easily influenced by advertisements that lack scientific support.
blanks.zh: 埃玛说，做健康专家很有挑战性，因为人们很容易受到那些缺乏科学依据的广告影响。

blanks.en: Also, people aren't willing to change their views about food and nutrition as there is so much confusing information online.
blanks.zh: 另外，人们也不愿改变对食物和营养的看法，因为网上让人困惑的信息实在太多了。

blanks.en: It's really important to hear what experts say, and that's why we've invited Emma here.
blanks.zh: 听听专家怎么说真的很重要，这也是我们邀请埃玛来的原因。

blanks.en: She isn't going to tell us about everything we should eat, but she will teach us to make better choices.
blanks.zh: 她不会把我们该吃的所有食物都列出来，但她会教我们作出更好的选择。

blanks.en: Let's welcome Emma Wilson.
blanks.zh: 让我们欢迎埃玛·威尔逊。

blanks.en: The beef looks fresh.
blanks.zh: 牛肉看起来很新鲜。

blanks.en: But I would recommend the chicken, which is tender.
blanks.zh: 不过我推荐鸡肉，鸡肉很嫩。

blanks.en: The beef is too salty and not juicy.
blanks.zh: 牛肉太咸，也不多汁。

blanks.en: Jack contributed a lot to my survey on the evolution of fashion.
blanks.zh: 杰克为我关于时尚演变的调查出了不少力。

blanks.en: I want to buy him a present like a scarf or a wallet.
blanks.zh: 我想送他一件礼物，比如围巾或者钱包。

blanks.en: I heard he likes reading.
blanks.zh: 我听说他喜欢读书。

blanks.en: If I were you, I would buy him a set of classics.
blanks.zh: 如果我是你，我会给他买一套经典名著。

blanks.en: I'd like to have my hair colored, but you seem up to your neck.
blanks.zh: 我想染个头发，不过你好像忙得不可开交。

blanks.en: Yes, we usually have a lot more customers on the weekend.
blanks.zh: 是的，周末我们的顾客通常多得多。

blanks.en: Please take a seat.
blanks.zh: 请坐。

blanks.en: I'm afraid you have to be patient.
blanks.zh: 恐怕你得耐心等一等。

blanks.en: I should have come back home earlier.
blanks.zh: 我本来应该早点回家的。

blanks.en: I'll never do it again.
blanks.zh: 我再也不会这样了。

blanks.en: Let's drop it this time.
blanks.zh: 这次就算了吧。

blanks.en: Oh, Alice, I have no idea what this newly coined term means.
blanks.zh: 哦，艾丽斯，我完全不明白这个新造的术语是什么意思。

blanks.en: Well, you are not alone.
blanks.zh: 嗯，不知道的可不止你一个。

blanks.en: Dad, did the alarm clock go off?
blanks.zh: 爸爸，闹钟响过了吗？

blanks.en: That was thirty minutes ago.
blanks.zh: 三十分钟前就响了。

blanks.en: Get up, or you'll be late for school.
blanks.zh: 快起床，不然上学要迟到了。

blanks.en: May I take another look at the Chinese painting?
blanks.zh: 我能再看看那幅中国画吗？

blanks.en: Is it still priced at 10,000 yuan?
blanks.zh: 它的标价还是一万元吗？

blanks.en: Sorry, sir, its price has risen by 10%.
blanks.zh: 抱歉，先生，它的价格已经涨了百分之十。

blanks.en: Moving these boxes up to the fifth floor is really beyond me.
blanks.zh: 把这些箱子搬上五楼，我实在做不到。

blanks.en: They look so big.
blanks.zh: 它们看起来真大。

blanks.en: If only I hadn't had my ankle twisted yesterday.
blanks.zh: 要是我昨天没扭伤脚踝就好了。

blanks.en: What an unsung hero you are!
blanks.zh: 你真是个无名英雄！

blanks.en: You never told me that you have been financially assisting the students for years.
blanks.zh: 你从来没告诉过我，这些年你一直在经济上资助那些学生。

blanks.en: Let the matter rest.
blanks.zh: 这件事就别再提了。

blanks.en: It's just between you and me.
blanks.zh: 这事就你知我知。

blanks.en: I hope there is hot water in the hotel after 10.
blanks.zh: 希望酒店十点以后还有热水。

blanks.en: I like to have a shower before bed, especially in winter.
blanks.zh: 我喜欢睡前洗个淋浴，尤其是在冬天。

blanks.en: But the front desk says hot water is available till nine p.m.
blanks.zh: 可是前台说，热水只供应到晚上九点。

blanks.en: After each passage or conversation, you will be asked several questions.
blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话结束后，你需要回答几个问题。

blanks.en: The passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
blanks.zh: 短文和对话会读两遍，但问题只读一遍。

blanks.en: When you hear a question read the four possible answers on your paper, and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
blanks.zh: 听到问题后，阅读试卷上的四个备选答案，选出最能回答刚才所听问题的一项。

blanks.en: A home energy checkup helps determine where your house is losing energy and money.
blanks.zh: 家庭能源检查能帮助你查明，房屋在哪些地方浪费了能源和金钱。

blanks.en: When such problems are corrected, your home will be more energy-efficient.
blanks.zh: 解决这些问题后，你的家就会更加节能。

blanks.en: While a professional energy checkup provides a complete picture of your home's energy use, a diligent self-assessment can also help you find small problem areas.
blanks.zh: 专业能源检查能够全面展现家庭能耗情况，认真进行自行评估，也能帮你找出一些小问题所在。

blanks.en: First, make a list of obvious air leaks.
blanks.zh: 首先，列出明显漏风的地方。

blanks.en: Check for indoor air leaks, such as gaps along the edge of the flooring and at joints of the walls and ceiling.
blanks.zh: 检查室内漏风处，例如地板边缘的缝隙，以及墙壁和天花板的接缝。

blanks.en: Also, check for leaks on the outside of your home, especially in areas where two different building materials meet.
blanks.zh: 还要检查房屋外部的漏风处，尤其是两种不同建筑材料相接的地方。

blanks.en: Finally, remember to check other places for leaks, including windows, doors and switches.
blanks.zh: 最后，别忘了检查其他漏风处，包括窗户、门和开关周围。

blanks.en: The potential energy savings from reducing leaks in a home may range from 10% to 20% per year.
blanks.zh: 减少房屋漏风，每年有可能节省百分之十到百分之二十的能源。

blanks.en: This do-it-yourself home energy checkup will not be as thorough as a professional home energy assessment, but it can help you highlight some of the easier areas to address.
blanks.zh: 这种自行进行的家庭能源检查，虽然没有专业评估那么全面，却能帮你找出一些较容易处理的问题。

blanks.en: When walking through your home, keep a checklist of the areas you have inspected and the problems you have found.
blanks.zh: 在家里逐处查看时，把检查过的地方和发现的问题记录在清单上。

blanks.en: This list will help you decide which energy efficiency upgrade should be given priority to.
blanks.zh: 这份清单能帮你决定，哪项节能改造应该优先进行。

blanks.en: Which of the following is the most probable way to save energy in a house?
blanks.zh: 以下哪一种最有可能有效节省家庭能源？

blanks.en: Why does the speaker recommend you to keep a checklist?
blanks.zh: 为什么说话者建议你保留一份检查清单？

blanks.en: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
blanks.zh: 说话者主要在谈论什么？

blanks.en: Seamus Heaney was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1995 when he was teaching at Harvard University.
blanks.zh: 一九九五年，谢默斯·希尼在哈佛大学任教时获得了诺贝尔文学奖。

blanks.en: On the day when Harvard celebrated its 375th anniversary, before a large audience, he recited his poem composed in 1986 for the university's 350th anniversary.
blanks.zh: 在哈佛庆祝建校三百七十五周年那天，他当着众多观众的面，朗诵了自己一九八六年为该校三百五十周年校庆创作的诗。

blanks.en: This 1986 poem relies on the power of repeating words and sounds.
blanks.zh: 这首一九八六年的诗，依靠词语和声音反复的力量。

blanks.en: Heaney said in an interview, “There's a kind of bell-ringing quality to the poem, which makes it easy on the ear.”
blanks.zh: 希尼在一次访谈中说：“这首诗有一种铃声般的韵味，听起来悦耳动听。”

blanks.en: He remembered writing just two poems during his early years at Harvard, when he taught and read a lot.
blanks.zh: 他记得，早年在哈佛时只写过两首诗，那段时间他经常教学和阅读。

blanks.en: One poem is the anniversary poem, and the other is about learning the alphabet at primary school.
blanks.zh: 一首是校庆诗，另一首讲的是在小学学习字母。

blanks.en: Heaney also recalled the physical Harvard, where he had many happy moments.
blanks.zh: 希尼还回忆起哈佛校园本身，在那里他度过了许多快乐的时光。

blanks.en: He said, “I still remember the excitement of driving around the campus and seeing the outlines of the houses.”
blanks.zh: 他说：“我依然记得，开车绕校园行驶、看着一幢幢房屋轮廓时的那种兴奋。”

blanks.en: And I enjoyed a few quiet corners on campus where I would sit down and take a nap.
blanks.zh: 我也很喜欢校园里几处安静的角落，可以在那里坐下来打个盹。

blanks.en: The library at Adams House, for one, and the Woodberry Poetry Room, for another.
blanks.zh: 比如亚当斯楼的图书馆，再比如伍德贝里诗歌室。

blanks.en: Then there was the yard.
blanks.zh: 还有那片庭院。

blanks.en: It was the inspiration for the anniversary poem, and also a place that reminded me of my own boyhood in the countryside, because it used to be a cow yard.
blanks.zh: 那是校庆诗的灵感来源，也让我想起自己在乡下的童年，因为那里过去是养牛的院子。

blanks.en: For what purpose did Seamus Heaney compose his nineteen eighty-six poem?
blanks.zh: 谢默斯·希尼创作一九八六年那首诗，是为了什么？

blanks.en: What is a feature of Seamus Heaney's nineteen eighty-six poem?
blanks.zh: 谢默斯·希尼一九八六年那首诗有什么特点？

blanks.en: What can be learned about Seamus Heaney?
blanks.zh: 关于谢默斯·希尼，可以了解到什么？

blanks.en: It's been a week since you arrived at the city.
blanks.zh: 你来到这座城市已经一个星期了。

blanks.en: Do you like your office?
blanks.zh: 你喜欢自己的办公室吗？

blanks.en: Yeah, it's great to have so much room, and I love the sea view.
blanks.zh: 喜欢，空间这么宽敞真好，而且我很喜欢这里的海景。

blanks.en: I'm glad to hear that.
blanks.zh: 听你这么说，我很高兴。

blanks.en: Do you need any equipment or supplies?
blanks.zh: 你需要什么设备或用品吗？

blanks.en: Actually, there are a few things I've been thinking about.
blanks.zh: 其实，有几样东西我一直在考虑。

blanks.en: Okay, what do you need?
blanks.zh: 好的，你需要什么？

blanks.en: Well, I'll give a presentation at an online conference next week.

blanks.zh: 能给电脑配一个网络摄像头吗？

blanks.en: It is already at the top of our agenda.
blanks.zh: 这已经列在我们的首要待办事项里了。

blanks.en: We want to encourage using technology to communicate with overseas scholars, rather than expensive travelling.
blanks.zh: 我们希望鼓励利用技术与海外学者交流，而不是花大钱出行。

blanks.en: It's so much easier and cheaper to do things that way.
blanks.zh: 那样做方便得多，也便宜得多。

blanks.en: The department chair likes to hear that kind of thinking.
blanks.zh: 系主任喜欢听到这种想法。

blanks.en: Well, I hope I'm not asking too much, but can I get a new chair?
blanks.zh: 嗯，希望我没有要求太多，不过能给我换把新椅子吗？

blanks.en: This one is really uncomfortable.
blanks.zh: 这把椅子实在不舒服。

blanks.en: I think that's an old chair.
blanks.zh: 我想那是把旧椅子了。

blanks.en: Is there a specific kind you want?
blanks.zh: 你想要哪一种具体的款式？

blanks.en: Like a folding chair or a rocking one?
blanks.zh: 比如折叠椅，还是摇椅？

blanks.en: I'd just like one that rises up and down and has arms.
blanks.zh: 我就想要一把能升降、带扶手的椅子。

blanks.en: Sure, I got it.
blanks.zh: 好的，我明白了。

blanks.en: It's been a week since you arrived at the city.
blanks.zh: 你来到这座城市已经一个星期了。

blanks.en: Do you like your office?
blanks.zh: 你喜欢自己的办公室吗？

blanks.en: Yeah, it's great to have so much room, and I love the sea view.
blanks.zh: 喜欢，空间这么宽敞真好，而且我很喜欢这里的海景。

blanks.en: I'm glad to hear that.
blanks.zh: 听你这么说，我很高兴。

blanks.en: Do you need any equipment or supplies?
blanks.zh: 你需要什么设备或用品吗？

blanks.en: Actually, there are a few things I've been thinking about.
blanks.zh: 其实，有几样东西我一直在考虑。

blanks.en: Okay, what do you need?
blanks.zh: 好的，你需要什么？

blanks.en: Well, I'll give a presentation at an online conference next week.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我下周要在一次线上会议上作报告。

blanks.zh: 好的，我明白了。

blanks.en: What does the man say about his office?
blanks.zh: 男士对自己的办公室说了什么？

blanks.en: Why does the man need a web camera for his computer?
blanks.zh: 男士为什么需要给电脑配网络摄像头？

blanks.en: What kind of chair does the man want?
blanks.zh: 男士想要什么样的椅子？

blanks.en: What are the speakers mainly talking about?
blanks.zh: 两位说话者主要在讨论什么？

blanks.en: Seems like I'm running a fever.
blanks.zh: 我好像发烧了。

blanks.en: I'll give you a blood test first.
blanks.zh: 我先给你验一下血。

blanks.en: Are you checking out some colleges?
blanks.zh: 你在考察一些大学吗？

blanks.en: East Lake College is a pretty neat school.
blanks.zh: 东湖学院是一所挺不错的学校。

blanks.en: But they don't offer many majors.
blanks.zh: 但他们开设的专业不多。

blanks.en: I thought my work had been valued by the company.
blanks.zh: 我原以为公司一直很重视我的工作。

blanks.en: Sorry to hear that.
blanks.zh: 听到这个消息我很遗憾。

blanks.en: But it's not the end of the world.
blanks.zh: 不过，这又不是世界末日。

blanks.en: Do you happen to know the title of this oil painting?
blanks.zh: 你知道这幅油画的名字吗？

blanks.en: Maybe an early eighteenth-century work.
blanks.zh: 也许是十八世纪早期的作品。

blanks.en: You can look it up in the catalogue.
blanks.zh: 你可以查一下目录。

blanks.en: Oh, it looks like the traffic is really bad.
blanks.zh: 哦，看起来交通很糟糕。

blanks.en: Still another hour to get to your office.
blanks.zh: 到你的办公室还要一个小时。

blanks.en: Okay, then I will go by subway.
blanks.zh: 好吧，那我去坐地铁。

blanks.en: Please stop at the next crossroads, and I will get out there.
blanks.zh: 请在下个十字路口停车，我在那里下车。

blanks.en: What's the assignment for today, Miss Taylor?
blanks.zh: 泰勒老师，今天的作业是什么？

blanks.en: Well, read chapter nine in your textbook, and get prepared to discuss what you've read next Monday.
blanks.zh: 嗯，阅读课本第九章，并准备好下星期一讨论你们读过的内容。

blanks.en: Would you please email me tomorrow?
blanks.zh: 你能明天给我发封电子邮件吗？

blanks.en: Let's fix the date for our next conference.
blanks.zh: 我们把下次会议的日期定下来。

blanks.en: My computer is broken.
blanks.zh: 我的电脑坏了。

blanks.en: Can I call you?
blanks.zh: 我可以给你打电话吗？

blanks.en: Mum, where are my blue shoes?
blanks.zh: 妈妈，我的蓝鞋在哪儿？

blanks.en: I'll be late for school.
blanks.zh: 我要上学迟到了。

blanks.en: I washed them this morning.
blanks.zh: 我今天早上把它们洗了。

blanks.en: Last night you told me you'd have a day off school today.
blanks.zh: 你昨晚告诉我，你今天学校放假一天。

blanks.en: I've gained weight since I started to work at Pizza Kitchen.
blanks.zh: 自从到披萨厨房工作以后，我就长胖了。

blanks.en: I know they offer employees free pizzas for meals, but you could pack your own healthy lunch.
blanks.zh: 我知道他们给员工提供免费的披萨餐，但你可以自己带一份健康的午饭。

blanks.en: Have you booked a twin room in West Hotel for our holiday?
blanks.zh: 你在西方酒店订好我们度假用的双床间了吗？

blanks.en: But that hotel is never full in March.
blanks.zh: 不过，那家酒店三月份从来都住不满。

blanks.en: After each passage or conversation you will be asked several questions.
blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话后，都会提出几个问题。

blanks.en: The passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
blanks.zh: 短文和对话会读两遍，但问题只读一遍。

blanks.en: When you hear a question, read the four possible answers on your paper, and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
blanks.zh: 听到一个问题后，请阅读试卷上的四个备选答案，选出最能回答所听问题的一项。

blanks.en: It's a daily struggle known to office workers the world over.
blanks.zh: 这是世界各地上班族每天都会遇到的困扰。

blanks.en: A productive morning rewarded with a decent lunch, and then, at about three PM, there comes the irresistible sleepiness.
blanks.zh: 一上午高效工作后，美美地吃顿午饭犒劳自己；然后，到了下午三点左右，难以抵挡的困意就来了。

blanks.en: A short nap can promote alertness and improve performance, which are important when you're at work.
blanks.zh: 小睡片刻可以提高警觉性、改善表现，这些在工作时都很重要。

blanks.en: Now many companies with a strong commitment to employee wellness have realized the benefits of on-site napping.
blanks.zh: 现在，许多十分重视员工健康的公司都意识到了在工作场所小睡的好处。

blanks.en: UU Corporation, a consulting company, has a flexible approach.
blanks.zh: 优优公司是一家咨询公司，采用了灵活的办法。

blanks.en: Employees can take a nap for thirty minutes at most, any time between one p.m. and four p.m.
blanks.zh: 员工可以在下午一点至四点之间的任何时间，小睡最多三十分钟。

blanks.en: Another company, Tim and Jerry's, which already offers employees personal trainers, now supplies a room with a bed and pillows that employees can use as needed.
blanks.zh: 另一家名为蒂姆与杰里的公司，已经为员工配备了私人健身教练，现在又提供了一间放着床和枕头的房间，供员工按需使用。

blanks.en: One of its representatives says, “If people need to catch a little nap during the day, we're behind it.”
blanks.zh: 该公司的一位代表说：“如果员工白天需要稍微打个盹，我们是支持的。”

blanks.en: An IT firm, New Link, allows its employees to take a twenty-minute power nap at their desks.
blanks.zh: 新联这家信息技术公司，允许员工在办公桌前小睡二十分钟，以恢复精力。

blanks.en: Introduced two years ago, the policy has proved a huge hit.
blanks.zh: 这项政策两年前推出，已经广受欢迎。

blanks.en: Mr. Lin, an accountant in New Link, told a local newspaper, “If I use a calculator when I'm sleepy, I have to double-check my work, for fear of making mistakes.”
blanks.zh: 新联公司的会计林先生告诉当地一家报纸：“犯困时用计算器，我得再仔细核对一次工作，生怕出错。”

blanks.en: So it takes longer.
blanks.zh: 所以就更费时间。

blanks.en: Thanks to the policy, my work performance has improved.
blanks.zh: 多亏这项政策，我的工作表现提高了。

blanks.en: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
blanks.zh: 说话者主要在谈论什么？

blanks.en: Which of the following can the employees of UU Corporation do at work?
blanks.zh: 优优公司的员工在工作时可以做下列哪件事？

blanks.en: What can be learned about Mr. Lin?
blanks.zh: 关于林先生，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.en: Search engines have completely changed how we access information and who we get it from.
blanks.zh: 搜索引擎彻底改变了我们获取信息的方式和来源。

blanks.en: They're fast, easy and great, but there are so many questions you can't look up online.
blanks.zh: 它们快捷、方便又好用，但还是有很多问题，你无法在网上查到答案。

blanks.en: Some are too complex because they have two or more parts, and others are impossible to search because you can't remember a name or an exact year.
blanks.zh: 有些问题过于复杂，因为它们包含两个或更多部分；还有些问题无法搜索，因为你记不住姓名或确切年份。

blanks.en: So you get too many results to make your search useful.
blanks.zh: 这样一来，结果就太多了，搜索也就帮不上忙了。

blanks.en: That's when APL can make a difference.
blanks.zh: 这时候，APL就能发挥作用了。

blanks.en: With APL, you can put questions to an information specialist at the Pearl Library.
blanks.zh: 通过APL，你可以向明珠图书馆的信息专员提问。

blanks.en: For over forty years, APL has been answering people's questions by looking things up in a variety of texts recordings and other resources.
blanks.zh: 四十多年来，APL一直通过查阅各类文本、录音及其他资源来回答人们的问题。

blanks.en: And these people are expert researchers, so they know where to look for information, which is key in providing a really good, quality answer.
blanks.zh: 而且，这些人都是专业研究人员，知道该到哪里查找信息，这是提供真正优质答案的关键。

blanks.en: Sometimes accuracy is more important than getting millions of results in a second.
blanks.zh: 有时候，准确性比一秒内得到数百万条结果更重要。

blanks.en: Then how can you access APL?
blanks.zh: 那么，你该如何使用APL呢？

blanks.en: One of the ten information specialists will answer your question, even if the question has multiple parts.
blanks.zh: 十位信息专员中的一位会回答你的问题，即使问题包含多个部分。

blanks.en: And even if you're missing some key information.
blanks.zh: 即使你缺少某些关键信息，也同样如此。

blanks.en: That's the benefit of a human over a computer.
blanks.zh: 这就是人相对于电脑的优势。

blanks.en: Plus, if you need some recommended reading, they've got that covered too.
blanks.zh: 另外，如果你想要推荐读物，他们也能帮你提供。

blanks.en: What are you going to do this summer, Sue?
blanks.zh: 苏，你今年夏天打算做什么？

blanks.en: Well, I can work full time at my uncle's restaurant if I want to.
blanks.zh: 嗯，如果我愿意，可以在叔叔的餐馆全职工作。

blanks.en: The money is pretty good.
blanks.zh: 工资挺不错。

blanks.en: But I'm thinking of getting some experience in my field.
blanks.zh: 但我在考虑积累一些本专业领域的经验。

blanks.en: I'm graduating next year.
blanks.zh: 我明年就毕业了。

blanks.en: Maybe you should try a different summer job.
blanks.zh: 也许你应该试一份不同的暑期工作。

blanks.en: It would mean a pay cut, but it'd be worth it.
blanks.zh: 那意味着工资会减少，但值得这样做。

blanks.en: Not only do you get experience, you make all kinds of contacts.
blanks.zh: 你不仅能积累经验，还能建立各种人脉。

blanks.en: But I just have no idea how to find a suitable one.
blanks.zh: 但我完全不知道怎么找一份合适的工作。

blanks.en: Why not go to the summer job fair?
blanks.zh: 为什么不去暑期招聘会看看呢？

blanks.en: Hang on, I've got the leaflet in my bag.
blanks.zh: 等一下，我包里有宣传单。

blanks.en: It's next week, on the sixteenth, at the student center, from nine a.m. to three p.m.
blanks.zh: 招聘会下周十六日在学生活动中心举行，时间是上午九点至下午三点。

blanks.en: Should I dress as if I'm going to an interview?
blanks.zh: 我该穿得像去面试那样吗？

blanks.en: It doesn't mention how you should dress.
blanks.zh: 上面没提该怎么穿。

blanks.en: Shall I bring my resume?
blanks.zh: 我要带上简历吗？

blanks.en: It's not required, but it's a good idea.
blanks.zh: 没有要求，但带上也不错。

blanks.en: Does it say what kinds of summer jobs are available?
blanks.zh: 上面写了有哪些暑期工作吗？

blanks.en: You know, I want to be a teacher.
blanks.zh: 你知道，我想当老师。

blanks.en: You can try to get hired at a summer camp.
blanks.zh: 你可以试着去应聘夏令营的工作。

blanks.en: Several are listed on there.
blanks.zh: 上面列出了好几个夏令营。

blanks.en: You won't have any trouble.
blanks.zh: 你不会有什么困难的。

blanks.en: You're at the top of your class.
blanks.zh: 你是班里的尖子生。
blanks.answer: at the top of your class

blanks.en: Thanks for the vote of confidence.
blanks.zh: 谢谢你这么信任我。

blanks.en: What are you going to do this summer, Sue?
blanks.zh: 苏，你今年夏天打算做什么？

blanks.en: Well, I can work full time at my uncle's restaurant if I want to.
blanks.zh: 嗯，如果我愿意，可以在叔叔的餐馆全职工作。

blanks.en: The money is pretty good.
blanks.zh: 工资挺不错。

blanks.en: But I'm thinking of getting some experience in my field.
blanks.zh: 但我在考虑积累一些本专业领域的经验。

blanks.en: I'm graduating next year.
blanks.zh: 我明年就毕业了。

blanks.en: Maybe you should try a different summer job.
blanks.zh: 也许你应该试一份不同的暑期工作。

blanks.en: It would mean a pay cut, but it'd be worth it.
blanks.zh: 那意味着工资会减少，但值得这样做。

blanks.en: Not only do you get experience, you make all kinds of contacts.
blanks.zh: 你不仅能积累经验，还能建立各种人脉。

blanks.en: But I just have no idea how to find a suitable one.
blanks.zh: 但我完全不知道怎么找一份合适的工作。

blanks.en: Why not go to the summer job fair?
blanks.zh: 为什么不去暑期招聘会看看呢？

blanks.en: I've got the leaflet in my bag.
blanks.zh: 我包里有宣传单。

blanks.en: It's next week, on the 16th, at the Student Center, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
blanks.zh: 招聘会下周十六日在学生活动中心举行，时间是上午九点至下午三点。

blanks.en: Should I dress as if I'm going to an interview?
blanks.zh: 我该穿得像去面试那样吗？

blanks.en: It doesn't mention how you should dress.
blanks.zh: 上面没提该怎么穿。

blanks.en: Shall I bring my resume?
blanks.zh: 我要带上简历吗？

blanks.en: It's not required, but it's a good idea.
blanks.zh: 没有要求，但带上也不错。

blanks.en: Does it say what kinds of summer jobs are available?
blanks.zh: 上面写了有哪些暑期工作吗？

blanks.en: You know, I want to be a teacher.
blanks.zh: 你知道，我想当老师。

blanks.en: You can try to get hired at a summer camp.
blanks.zh: 你可以试着去应聘夏令营的工作。

blanks.en: Several are listed on there.
blanks.zh: 上面列出了好几个夏令营。

blanks.en: You won't have any trouble.
blanks.zh: 你不会有什么困难的。

blanks.en: You're at the top of your class.
blanks.zh: 你是班里的尖子生。
blanks.answer: at the top of your class

blanks.en: Thanks for the vote of confidence.
blanks.zh: 谢谢你这么信任我。

blanks.en: What are the speakers mainly talking about?
blanks.zh: 说话者主要在谈论什么？

blanks.en: According to the man, why should the woman find a different summer job?
blanks.zh: 根据男士的看法，为什么女士应该换一份暑期工作？

blanks.en: What can be learned about the summer job fair?
blanks.zh: 关于这场暑期招聘会，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.en: Why does the man recommend the woman to work at a summer camp?
blanks.zh: 为什么男士推荐女士去夏令营工作？

blanks.en: This is the concert hall, not City Hall.
blanks.zh: 这里是音乐厅，不是市政厅。

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'm looking for a size twelve dress.
blanks.zh: 我想找一件十二号的连衣裙。

blanks.en: Oh, let me see: an eight, a ten.
blanks.zh: 哦，让我看看，有八号的、十号的。

blanks.en: I have the prettiest dress here in a twelve.
blanks.zh: 我这里最漂亮的一件连衣裙正好是十二号的。

blanks.en: Do you think you can take care of everything in the office today?
blanks.zh: 你觉得今天办公室里的事你能全都照看好吗？

blanks.en: Just go home and take a rest.
blanks.zh: 你就回家休息吧。

blanks.en: If there is anything I feel I cannot handle, I will call you.
blanks.zh: 如果有什么事我觉得自己处理不了，我会给你打电话。

blanks.en: We have a half-day tour, a full-day tour, and an evening tour.
blanks.zh: 我们有半日游、一日游和晚间游。

blanks.en: What is the schedule of the half-day tour?
blanks.zh: 半日游的行程安排是怎样的？

blanks.en: It sets out at 8:30 a.m. and returns at 2 p.m.
blanks.zh: 上午八点半出发，下午两点返回。

blanks.en: Now, what seems to be the trouble, Mrs. Stevens?
blanks.zh: 那么，史蒂文斯太太，您是哪里不舒服呢？

blanks.en: I've been very dizzy lately, and last night I had some chest pain.
blanks.zh: 我最近一直头晕得厉害，昨天晚上还有些胸痛。

blanks.en: Don't worry, let me have a look.
blanks.zh: 别担心，让我检查一下。

blanks.en: That was a great match.
blanks.zh: 刚才那场比赛真精彩。

blanks.en: I really like watching tennis games.
blanks.zh: 我真喜欢看网球比赛。

blanks.en: I think tennis is an exciting sport.
blanks.zh: 我觉得网球是一项令人兴奋的运动。

blanks.en: Do you play tennis, John?
blanks.zh: 约翰，你打网球吗？

blanks.en: How about a game on Tuesday afternoon?
blanks.zh: 周二下午打一场怎么样？

blanks.en: Mrs. White, I'm afraid we have to put you on a strict diet.
blanks.zh: 怀特太太，恐怕我们必须让您严格控制饮食。

blanks.en: From now on, you are going to have to stay away from salty food.
blanks.zh: 从现在起，您必须避免吃咸的食物。

blanks.en: Does that mean I can't have any more fast food?
blanks.zh: 那是不是说，我不能再吃快餐了？

blanks.en: You can't have any fried food or steaks.
blanks.zh: 您不能吃任何油炸食品，也不能吃牛排。

blanks.en: What about breakfast food like eggs and sausages?
blanks.zh: 那鸡蛋、香肠这类早餐食物呢？

blanks.en: Those are all bad for you, but you can have porridge, bread, and orange juice.
blanks.zh: 那些都对您不好，不过您可以喝粥、吃面包、喝橙汁。

blanks.en: Well, what about lunch and dinner?
blanks.zh: 那午餐和晚餐呢？

blanks.en: Have a salad for lunch.
blanks.zh: 午餐吃沙拉吧。

blanks.en: As for dinner, you can have all the vegetables you want.
blanks.zh: 至于晚餐，蔬菜您想吃多少都可以。

blanks.en: Fish and chicken are also okay.
blanks.zh: 鱼和鸡肉也可以吃。

blanks.en: Can I still have ice cream?
blanks.zh: 我还能吃冰淇淋吗？

blanks.en: Yes, but not too much.
blanks.zh: 可以，不过不能吃太多。

blanks.en: Well, Daniel, have you ever felt nervous on stage?
blanks.zh: 丹尼尔，你在台上紧张过吗？

blanks.en: Do you remember that play I was in a few years ago?
blanks.zh: 你记得我几年前演的那出戏吗？

blanks.en: I knew my lines, but I was terrified to have to recite them in front of an audience.
blanks.zh: 我记得台词，但一想到要在观众面前背出来，就怕得要命。

blanks.en: As soon as I saw the crowd of people down there, my heart beat so fast that I was unable to say a single word.
blanks.zh: 一看到台下那么多人，我的心就跳得特别快，连一个字也说不出来。

blanks.en: That's how I feel just thinking about the spelling competition next week.
blanks.zh: 我光是想到下周的拼写比赛，就已经是这种感觉了。

blanks.en: I didn't know you made it to the finals.
blanks.zh: 我还不知道你进了决赛呢。

blanks.en: I'm worried I'll get nervous and freeze on stage.
blanks.zh: 我担心自己会紧张，在台上僵住。

blanks.en: I might forget how to spell everything, even my own name.
blanks.zh: 我可能会忘记所有词怎么拼，连自己的名字也不例外。

blanks.en: I don't know what to do.
blanks.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

blanks.en: Nancy, I know that you're not going to forget how to spell your name.
blanks.zh: 南希，我知道你不会忘记自己的名字怎么拼。

blanks.en: I'll help you get through this.
blanks.zh: 我会帮你渡过这一关。

blanks.en: I'll go to the school hall with you to practice.
blanks.zh: 我会陪你去学校礼堂练习。

blanks.en: Then I'll teach you an exercise my baseball coach taught me.
blanks.zh: 然后，我会教你一个我棒球教练教给我的训练方法。

blanks.en: Believe me, it works.
blanks.zh: 相信我，这方法管用。

blanks.en: I feel much better now.
blanks.zh: 我现在感觉好多了。

blanks.en: Hello, ladies and gentlemen.
blanks.zh: 各位女士、先生，大家好。

blanks.en: Today we have invited Professor Stone to talk about the role of elderly people in our society.
blanks.zh: 今天我们邀请了斯通教授来谈谈老年人在社会中的作用。

blanks.en: Welcome to our show, Professor Stone.
blanks.zh: 欢迎来到我们的节目，斯通教授。

blanks.en: To begin with, I'd like to tell a story from my own life.
blanks.zh: 首先，我想讲一个我自己生活中的故事。

blanks.en: Several years ago, when my grandparents were well into their eighties, they were no longer able to care for themselves very well.
blanks.zh: 几年前，我的祖父母都已经八十多岁了，无法再很好地照顾自己。

blanks.en: My grandfather was afraid of leaving the only home they had known for the past sixty years.
blanks.zh: 祖父害怕离开他们过去六十年来唯一熟悉的家。

blanks.en: The idea of having to sell their home and move into a retirement home was an extremely painful experience for them.
blanks.zh: 一想到要卖掉房子、搬进养老院，他们就感到极其痛苦。

blanks.en: Indeed, old age for them and many older Americans can mean not only the possible failure of one's health, but the loss of identity and self-worth.
blanks.zh: 的确，对他们和许多美国老人来说，年老不仅可能意味着健康衰退，还意味着失去身份认同和自我价值感。

blanks.en: What do you have to say about the problem of old age?
blanks.zh: 对于年老的问题，您有什么想说的吗？

blanks.en: Many experts have given talks here that have focused on the medical care and the development of public services for senior citizens.
blanks.zh: 很多专家曾在这里发言，重点讨论老年人的医疗照护和公共服务的发展。

blanks.en: Today, I'd like to focus my comments on the meaningful roles the elderly can play and should play in our society.
blanks.zh: 今天，我想把发言重点放在老年人能够、也应该在社会中发挥的有意义的作用上。

blanks.en: Talking about personal relationships, well, I'd naturally think of my relationship with my mother.
blanks.zh: 说到人际关系，嗯，我自然会想到自己与母亲的关系。

blanks.en: Whenever I need help, my mother is always there for me.
blanks.zh: 无论什么时候我需要帮助，母亲总会在身边支持我。

blanks.en: She often tells me that I can be anyone I want, as long as I'm confident of myself.
blanks.zh: 她常告诉我，只要相信自己，我就能成为自己想成为的任何人。

blanks.en: She sees my talent and pushes me to do the best I possibly can.
blanks.zh: 她看到我的才华，也督促我尽自己最大的努力。

blanks.en: As I was growing up, we were often on the move.
blanks.zh: 在我成长的过程中，我们常常搬家。

blanks.en: I had to admit that moving so often made me feel lonely, but my mother did everything she could to help me feel happy.
blanks.zh: 我不得不承认，经常搬家让我感到孤独，但母亲竭尽所能让我开心。

blanks.en: In fact, so much travelling was really a good thing because it made us close.
blanks.zh: 事实上，经常四处奔波反倒是件好事，因为这让我们更加亲密。

blanks.en: I respect my mother so much, as she never treats me as a child, but as an equal.
blanks.zh: 我非常尊重母亲，因为她从不把我当孩子，而是把我看作平等的人。

blanks.en: She gives me the freedom to make mistakes and to learn from them all.
blanks.zh: 她给我犯错的自由，也让我从这些错误中学习。

blanks.en: Unlike friendships that can fade or break, I know I'll always be connected to my mother no matter what I face.
blanks.zh: 友谊可能会淡去或破裂，但我知道，无论面对什么，我和母亲的联系都会一直存在。

blanks.en: She is not just a role model, but someone I love.
blanks.zh: 她不仅是我的榜样，也是我深爱的人。

blanks.en: In fact, so much travelling was really a good thing because it made us close.
blanks.zh: 事实上，经常四处奔波反倒是件好事，因为这让我们更加亲密。

blanks.en: I respect my mother so much, as she never treats me as a child, but as an equal.
blanks.zh: 我非常尊重母亲，因为她从不把我当孩子，而是把我看作平等的人。

blanks.en: She gives me the freedom to make mistakes and to learn from them all.
blanks.zh: 她给我犯错的自由，也让我从这些错误中学习。

blanks.en: Unlike friendships that can fade or break, I know I'll always be connected to my mother no matter what I face.
blanks.zh: 友谊可能会淡去或破裂，但我知道，无论面对什么，我和母亲的联系都会一直存在。

blanks.en: She is not just a role model, but someone I love.
blanks.zh: 她不仅是我的榜样，也是我深爱的人。

blanks.en: My best friend worked there, and I went to visit her.
blanks.zh: 我最好的朋友在那儿工作，我是去看望她的。

blanks.en: It was a good chance to practice my Spanish.
blanks.zh: 那也是练习西班牙语的好机会。

blanks.en: Ruth, I've got this terrible cold and I have to see a doctor.
blanks.zh: 露丝，我感冒得很厉害，得去看医生。

blanks.en: Could you help me hand in my lab report to Doctor Davidson?
blanks.zh: 你能帮我把实验报告交给戴维森博士吗？

blanks.en: Just take care of yourself and don't worry about the class.
blanks.zh: 照顾好自己，别担心课上的事。

blanks.en: Marie, if no one takes care of your children while you're away, Jennifer and I will be glad to have them stay with us.
blanks.zh: 玛丽，如果你外出期间没人照看孩子，我和詹妮弗很乐意让他们住在我们家。

blanks.en: That's very kind of you, but they've already left for their grandma's.
blanks.zh: 你们真是太好了，不过孩子们已经去奶奶家了。

blanks.en: You know, Suzy lives close by.
blanks.zh: 你知道，苏西就住在附近。

blanks.en: Hurry up with your food, Sally.
blanks.zh: 萨莉，快点吃。

blanks.en: They say there's a big storm coming.
blanks.zh: 听说有一场大暴风雨要来了。

blanks.en: We'd better get home before that.
blanks.zh: 我们最好在那之前到家。

blanks.en: Let's get back to the car.
blanks.zh: 我们回车上去吧。

blanks.en: Could you carry these shopping bags?
blanks.zh: 你能拿一下这些购物袋吗？

blanks.en: We deep-fried fish three days ago in the kitchen, but the unpleasant smell stays.
blanks.zh: 我们三天前在厨房炸过鱼，可那股难闻的气味还没散。

blanks.en: There's a method you can try.
blanks.zh: 有个办法你可以试试。

blanks.en: Every time you make coffee, dry the leftover coffee grounds and keep them in small bowls.
blanks.zh: 每次煮完咖啡，把剩下的咖啡渣晾干，放在小碗里。

blanks.en: Then place the bowls in the kitchen.
blanks.zh: 然后把碗放在厨房里。

blanks.en: Are you a football fan, Gomez?
blanks.zh: 戈麦斯，你是足球迷吗？

blanks.en: I go to the stadium whenever there's a good game.
blanks.zh: 只要有精彩比赛，我就会去体育场。

blanks.en: And if I can't get a ticket, I watch the game on TV.
blanks.zh: 如果买不到票，我就在电视上看比赛。

blanks.en: That way, they are less exciting, though.
blanks.zh: 不过，那样看就没那么激动人心了。

blanks.en: Is the ticket expensive?
blanks.zh: 门票贵吗？

blanks.en: It usually costs about twenty to fifty dollars.
blanks.zh: 通常大约二十到五十美元。

blanks.en: Last time I paid twenty five.
blanks.zh: 我上次花了二十五美元。

blanks.en: That's not very expensive.
blanks.zh: 那倒不是很贵。

blanks.en: Maybe we can go together sometime.
blanks.zh: 也许我们什么时候可以一起去。

blanks.en: It'll be more fun to watch the game with a friend.
blanks.zh: 和朋友一起看比赛会更有意思。

blanks.en: You were out the whole afternoon, Alex.
blanks.zh: 亚历克斯，你整个下午都不在。

blanks.en: What did you do?
blanks.zh: 你做什么去了？

blanks.en: I took a walk by myself.
blanks.zh: 我一个人去散步了。

blanks.en: You just kept walking and walking for four hours?
blanks.zh: 你就这样一直走了四个小时？

blanks.en: Actually, it's not so boring.
blanks.zh: 其实没有那么无聊。

blanks.en: Walking in the woods is a grand adventure.
blanks.zh: 在树林里散步是一次绝妙的探险。

blanks.en: Your feet can take you to the most amazing places.
blanks.zh: 双脚能带你去最令人惊叹的地方。

blanks.en: What did you do in the woods?
blanks.zh: 你在树林里做了什么？

blanks.en: I smelled the flowers, looked at the birds, and yeah, I picked many tree leaves.
blanks.zh: 我闻了花香，看了鸟，还捡了不少树叶。

blanks.en: I will make bookmarks with them.
blanks.zh: 我要用它们做书签。

blanks.en: Then I met Bob at the lake.
blanks.zh: 后来我在湖边遇到了鲍勃。

blanks.en: He was fishing while his kids were having a swim.
blanks.zh: 他在钓鱼，孩子们在游泳。

blanks.en: Did you talk to him?
blanks.zh: 你和他说话了吗？

blanks.en: No, I walked on and took a lot of pictures.
blanks.zh: 没有，我继续往前走，拍了很多照片。

blanks.en: There's just so much out there to see.
blanks.zh: 外面实在有太多值得看的东西了。

blanks.en: David, how was your holiday?
blanks.zh: 戴维，假期过得怎么样？

blanks.en: I climbed Mount Fuji.
blanks.zh: 我登上了富士山。

blanks.en: It was really beautiful.
blanks.zh: 那里真的很美。

blanks.en: Now I can check one more thing off my list.
blanks.zh: 现在，我的清单上又可以勾掉一件事了。

blanks.en: When I was twelve, I made a list of things I wanted to do someday.
blanks.zh: 十二岁时，我列了一份清单，写下将来想做的事。

blanks.en: How many of the things on your list have you done so far?
blanks.zh: 到目前为止，清单上的事你已经做了多少件？

blanks.en: Here I am on top of Mount Fuji, and here I am in a hot air balloon.
blanks.zh: 这张是我在富士山顶，这张是我在热气球里。

blanks.en: I've always wanted to go up in a hot air balloon.
blanks.zh: 我一直都想乘热气球升空。

blanks.en: What are your plans for the next holiday?
blanks.zh: 下一个假期你有什么计划？

blanks.en: I'm thinking of deep-sea diving in Australia.
blanks.zh: 我在考虑去澳大利亚深海潜水。

blanks.en: Do you have any other suggestions?
blanks.zh: 你还有其他建议吗？

blanks.en: You really ought to take a boat down the Amazon.
blanks.zh: 你真应该乘船沿亚马孙河顺流而下。

blanks.en: You'll see a lot of interesting animals and beautiful trees.
blanks.zh: 你会看到许多有趣的动物和美丽的树木。

blanks.en: It's one of the best places I've been to.
blanks.zh: 那是我去过的最棒的地方之一。

blanks.en: Okay, I'll put it on my list.
blanks.zh: 好，我会把它加进清单。

blanks.en: Are you attending the conference tomorrow morning at the Shelton Hotel?
blanks.zh: 你要参加明早在谢尔顿酒店举行的会议吗？

blanks.en: Yeah, but when I arrived home five minutes ago I found that my car wouldn't start.
blanks.zh: 是的，不过五分钟前我回到家时，发现汽车发动不起来了。

blanks.en: And John is in Brighton on business.
blanks.zh: 而约翰在布赖顿出差。

blanks.en: Do you know what's wrong with the car?
blanks.zh: 你知道汽车出了什么问题吗？

blanks.en: I'm not exactly sure.
blanks.zh: 我不太确定。

blanks.en: I think there's a problem with the engine.
blanks.zh: 我觉得发动机有问题。

blanks.en: When shall I be at your place?
blanks.zh: 我什么时候到你家？

blanks.en: Well, what about eight o'clock?
blanks.zh: 嗯，八点怎么样？

blanks.en: From my place to Shelton, we have to drive through the quarters, so we'd better leave early to avoid the traffic.
blanks.zh: 从我家到谢尔顿酒店，我们得穿过那些街区，所以最好早点出发，避开拥堵。

blanks.en: It takes twenty minutes to reach your place.
blanks.zh: 到你家要二十分钟。

blanks.en: So I'll set off at seven forty.
blanks.zh: 那我就七点四十分出发。

blanks.en: By the way, do you also need me to drive you home tomorrow afternoon?
blanks.zh: 顺便问一下，明天下午你还需要我开车送你回家吗？

blanks.en: Today I'll talk about how to improve your pronunciation.
blanks.zh: 今天我来谈谈怎样改善你们的发音。

blanks.en: Language researchers say pronunciation and fluency are the biggest barriers, followed by grammar, in effective spoken English.
blanks.zh: 语言研究者说，在有效的英语口语交流中，最大的障碍是发音和流利程度，其次是语法。

blanks.en: However, most people don't regard pronunciation as a very important part of communication skills.
blanks.zh: 然而，大多数人并不认为发音是沟通技能中很重要的一部分。

blanks.en: They're more focused on vocabulary.
blanks.zh: 他们更关注词汇。

blanks.en: One reason is that most people are not even aware of their mispronunciations.
blanks.zh: 原因之一是，大多数人甚至没有意识到自己存在发音错误。

blanks.en: So it's important to first find out the words you mispronounce.
blanks.zh: 所以，首先找出自己发音有误的单词很重要。

blanks.en: You should listen to experts.
blanks.zh: 你应该听专家怎么说。

blanks.en: By experts I mean those who are less likely to make pronunciation mistakes.
blanks.zh: 我说的专家，是指那些不太容易犯发音错误的人。

blanks.en: When listening to them, pay attention to words that sound strange—strange because you pronounce the same words differently.
blanks.zh: 听他们说话时，注意那些听起来有些陌生的词；之所以陌生，是因为你对同一个词的发音和他们不同。

blanks.en: When you come across such words, check a dictionary to confirm their exact pronunciations.
blanks.zh: 遇到这样的单词时，查一查词典，确认它们的准确发音。

blanks.en: You can also search for difficult-to-pronounce words and names, and make a list of them.
blanks.zh: 你也可以搜索那些难发音的单词和名字，把它们列成清单。

blanks.en: The last suggestion is to read aloud.
blanks.zh: 最后一条建议是大声朗读。

blanks.en: Now you've got the correct pronunciations of the words.
blanks.zh: 现在你已经知道了这些单词的正确发音。

blanks.en: It's time to practice reading them every day.
blanks.zh: 该每天练习朗读这些单词了。
