blanks.zh: 最后一条建议是大声朗读。

blanks.en: Now you've got the correct pronunciations of the words.
blanks.zh: 现在你已经知道了这些单词的正确发音。

blanks.en: It's time to practice reading them every day.
blanks.zh: 该每天练习朗读这些单词了。

blanks.en: Did you go to the football game yesterday?
blanks.zh: 你昨天去看足球赛了吗？

blanks.en: No, I couldn't make it.
blanks.zh: 没有，我没能去成。

blanks.en: I was stuck in the lab.
blanks.zh: 我在实验室里脱不开身。

blanks.en: You missed a really good game.
blanks.zh: 你错过了一场非常精彩的比赛。

blanks.en: Our school team played very well.
blanks.zh: 我们校队踢得很好。

blanks.en: Did you hear the weather forecast for tomorrow?
blanks.zh: 你听了明天的天气预报吗？

blanks.en: Is it going to be windy?
blanks.zh: 明天会刮风吗？

blanks.en: No, there will be high clouds in the morning and heavy showers in the afternoon and evening.
blanks.zh: 不会，上午会有高云，下午和晚上会有强阵雨。

blanks.en: Kate, let's go for a picnic somewhere this weekend.
blanks.zh: 凯特，这周末我们找个地方去野餐吧。

blanks.en: Good idea. Can Jack go with us?
blanks.zh: 好主意。杰克能和我们一起去吗？

blanks.en: He studied hard for his exam in the past two weeks.
blanks.zh: 过去两周，他为了考试一直很用功。

blanks.en: I don't think so.
blanks.zh: 我想不行。

blanks.en: He's going on a trip this weekend with his school.
blanks.zh: 这周末他要参加学校组织的旅行。

blanks.en: Hello, is it Emma?
blanks.zh: 喂，是艾玛吗？

blanks.en: This is Robert Allen from Johnson's Electronics.
blanks.zh: 我是约翰逊电子公司的罗伯特·艾伦。

blanks.en: Hello, Robert. What can I do for you?
blanks.zh: 你好，罗伯特，有什么事吗？
blanks.answer: What can I do for you

blanks.en: It's this visit by Mr. Johnson.
blanks.zh: 是关于约翰逊先生这次来访的事。

blanks.en: I'm afraid he's had an emergency and won't be able to make it this time.
blanks.zh: 他遇到了紧急情况，恐怕这次来不了了。

blanks.en: Have you been waiting long?
blanks.zh: 你等了很久吗？

blanks.en: No, just a few minutes.
blanks.zh: 没有，就几分钟。

blanks.en: How was the flight?
blanks.zh: 飞行还顺利吗？

blanks.en: It was fine, thanks.
blanks.zh: 挺好的，谢谢。

blanks.en: I slept through the whole flight, actually, and I feel much better.
blanks.zh: 其实整个航程我都在睡觉，现在感觉好多了。

blanks.en: What are we having for dinner tonight, Jane?
blanks.zh: 简，我们今晚吃什么？

blanks.en: Something will come to mind once I start.
blanks.zh: 等我开始做的时候，就会想到做什么了。

blanks.en: I feel like eating French fries, or maybe ham sandwich.
blanks.zh: 我想吃薯条，或者火腿三明治。

blanks.en: Actually, I was thinking of making something healthy, say, fish and vegetables.
blanks.zh: 其实我在考虑做点健康的，比如鱼和蔬菜。

blanks.en: Well, in that case, I'll have whatever you make.
blanks.zh: 那好吧，你做什么我就吃什么。

blanks.en: I've heard that you're going to Milan for a business trip next week.
blanks.zh: 我听说你下周要去米兰出差。

blanks.en: I'm also planning a trip to Rome for sightseeing after that.
blanks.zh: 那之后我还计划去罗马观光。

blanks.en: Oh, I'm just back from Rome.
blanks.zh: 哦，我刚从罗马回来。

blanks.en: The city has made some new rules.
blanks.zh: 那座城市制定了一些新规定。

blanks.en: For example, people who dress up as Roman soldiers and charge for photos won't be allowed near hot tourist spots, and street performers can't sing or play loud music on public transport.
blanks.zh: 比如，装扮成古罗马士兵并收钱与人合影的人，不许出现在热门景点附近；街头艺人也不能在公共交通工具上唱歌或大声演奏音乐。

blanks.en: Another rule bans tourists from eating in public places.
blanks.zh: 另一条规定禁止游客在公共场所吃东西。

blanks.en: Eating in public is inappropriate and can lead to littering.
blanks.zh: 在公共场所吃东西不合适，还可能导致乱扔垃圾。

blanks.en: Last year, Florence made a rule saying that tourists could face fines of up to five hundred euros if caught eating in the street.
blanks.zh: 去年，佛罗伦萨规定，游客如果被发现在街上吃东西，可能面临最高五百欧元的罚款。

blanks.en: Wow, that's big money, but it's understandable.
blanks.zh: 哇，那可是一大笔钱，不过也能理解。

blanks.en: I heard you were going to withdraw from the speech class.
blanks.zh: 我听说你打算退出演讲课。

blanks.en: Well, Miss McDaniel, I don't think I can make it.
blanks.zh: 嗯，麦克丹尼尔老师，我觉得我做不到。

blanks.en: Public speaking scares me.
blanks.zh: 我害怕当众演讲。

blanks.en: I just can't get in front of a group and talk.
blanks.zh: 我就是没法站到一群人面前讲话。

blanks.en: What is it you fear about speaking in front of a group?
blanks.zh: 在一群人面前讲话，究竟是什么让你害怕？

blanks.en: I'm afraid I'll look silly if I forget a word, or say something stupid, or if I shake, turn red.
blanks.zh: 我担心，如果忘了某个词、说了什么蠢话，或者发抖、脸红，我会显得很傻。

blanks.en: What would happen if you did one of these things?
blanks.zh: 如果你出现了其中一种情况，会怎么样？

blanks.en: People would laugh at me.
blanks.zh: 别人会嘲笑我。

blanks.en: Well, Frank, your fear is really not based on fact.
blanks.zh: 弗兰克，其实你的恐惧并没有事实依据。

blanks.en: I once asked my students what they would do if someone in class forgot a word or made a mistake.
blanks.zh: 我曾经问过学生，如果班里有人忘了某个词或者说错了，他们会怎么做。

blanks.en: They said they would feel bad for the speaker, for they knew they would be in the speaker's shoes some day.
blanks.zh: 他们说会替那位发言的同学难受，因为他们知道自己总有一天也会处在同样的境地。

blanks.en: Does that make you feel better?
blanks.zh: 这样说让你好受一些了吗？

blanks.en: I hope you'll stay in the class and try a bit more.
blanks.zh: 我希望你留下来继续上课，再多尝试一点。

blanks.en: How many applications did we get, Mary?
blanks.zh: 玛丽，我们收到了多少份申请？

blanks.en: Well, overall we've got over two hundred.
blanks.zh: 嗯，一共收到了两百多份。

blanks.en: Yes, but most of which we can reject right away.
blanks.zh: 是的，不过大部分我们可以直接回绝。

blanks.en: People who don't have the right experience, qualifications, that kind of thing.
blanks.zh: 比如那些不具备相关经验、资历之类条件的人。

blanks.en: And so I drew up a short list of twelve candidates.
blanks.zh: 所以，我拟了一份十二人的候选人名单。

blanks.en: Are we going to interview all of them?
blanks.zh: 我们要面试所有这些人吗？

blanks.en: I think we should, but certainly I'll let you have a look first.
blanks.zh: 我觉得应该，不过我当然会先让你看一看。

blanks.en: Well, I think we've got some pretty strong candidates.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我认为有几位候选人的条件相当出色。

blanks.en: They have the right kind of qualification?
blanks.zh: 他们具备我们需要的资历？

blanks.en: I'd certainly say so.
blanks.zh: 我当然认为是这样。

blanks.en: A strong educational background, experience in sales, language skills.
blanks.zh: 很好的教育背景、销售经验和语言技能。

blanks.en: I look forward to meeting all of them.
blanks.zh: 我很期待与他们所有人见面。

blanks.en: So, I'd say we do the standard interview format.
blanks.zh: 那么，我看我们就采用标准的面试形式。

blanks.en: A few general questions, then on to specifics.
blanks.zh: 先问几个一般性问题，再谈具体事项。

blanks.en: We could also ask them to give a short presentation.
blanks.zh: 我们还可以让他们作一个简短的展示。

blanks.en: I'm really looking forward to this.
blanks.zh: 我真的很期待。

blanks.en: This is CBA News Radio.
blanks.zh: 这里是CBA新闻广播。

blanks.en: Here comes something interesting.
blanks.zh: 下面有一条有趣的消息。

blanks.en: Yesterday a teenage girl named Terra Gallo from Cumberland got some unexpected news when she received a handwritten letter from a fisherman saying that her message in a bottle had been found in Spain.
blanks.zh: 昨天，坎伯兰一名叫特拉·加洛的少女收到了一封渔民的手写信，意外得知自己的漂流瓶在西班牙被找到了。

blanks.en: Gallo and her sister put messages into bottles and threw them into the ocean while visiting their aunt on Monhegan Island three years ago.
blanks.zh: 三年前，加洛姐妹俩去蒙希根岛探望姨妈时，把写好的留言放进瓶子里，扔进了海里。

blanks.en: The girls had forgotten about the bottles until they were surprised by the fisherman's letter.
blanks.zh: 女孩们早已忘了那些瓶子，直到渔民的来信让她们大吃一惊。

blanks.en: Gallo, now fourteen, studied maps and discovered her message travelled about three thousand miles.
blanks.zh: 如今十四岁的加洛查阅地图后发现，她的留言漂流了大约三千英里。

blanks.en: Gallo's message asked that whoever found her bottle should put their own message inside with hers, and send it back out to sea.
blanks.zh: 加洛的留言写道，无论谁捡到这个瓶子，都请把自己的留言和她的放在一起，再把瓶子投回海里。

blanks.en: The fisherman said in his letter that he had carried out her wishes.
blanks.zh: 渔民在信中说，他已经照她的愿望做了。

blanks.en: My best friend worked there, and I went to visit her.
blanks.zh: 我最好的朋友那时在那里工作，我去看她了。

blanks.en: It was a good chance to practise my Spanish.
blanks.zh: 那是练习西班牙语的好机会。

blanks.en: Ruth, I've got this terrible cold, and I have to see a doctor.
blanks.zh: 露丝，我得了重感冒，必须去看医生。

blanks.en: I'm afraid I can't go to the class.
blanks.zh: 恐怕我没法去上课了。

blanks.en: Could you help me hand in my lab report to Dr. Davidson?
blanks.zh: 你能帮我把实验报告交给戴维森博士吗？

blanks.en: Just take care of yourself and don't worry about the class.
blanks.zh: 照顾好自己，别担心上课的事。

blanks.en: Marie, if no one takes care of your children while you are away, Jennifer and I will be glad to have them stay with us.
blanks.zh: 玛丽，如果你不在家时没人照顾孩子，詹妮弗和我都很愿意让他们来我们家住。

blanks.en: That's very kind of you.
blanks.zh: 你真是太好了。

blanks.en: But they've already left for their grandma's.
blanks.zh: 不过，他们已经动身去奶奶家了。

blanks.en: You know, Suzy lives close by.
blanks.zh: 你知道的，苏西就住在附近。

blanks.en: Hurry up with your food, Sally.
blanks.zh: 萨莉，快点吃。

blanks.en: They say there's a big storm coming.
blanks.zh: 听说马上要有大暴风雨了。

blanks.en: We'd better get home before that.
blanks.zh: 我们最好赶在那之前回家。

blanks.en: Let's get back to the car.
blanks.zh: 我们回车上去吧。

blanks.en: Could you carry these shopping bags?
blanks.zh: 你能帮忙提这些购物袋吗？

blanks.en: We deep-fried fish three days ago in the kitchen, but the unpleasant smell stays.
blanks.zh: 三天前我们在厨房炸过鱼，可那股难闻的气味一直没散。

blanks.en: There's a method you can try.
blanks.zh: 有个办法你可以试试。

blanks.en: Every time you make coffee, dry the leftover coffee grounds and keep them in small bowls.
blanks.zh: 每次煮完咖啡，把剩下的咖啡渣晾干，装在小碗里。

blanks.en: Then place the bowls in the kitchen.
blanks.zh: 然后把这些碗放在厨房里。

blanks.en: Are you a football fan, Gomez?
blanks.zh: 戈梅斯，你是足球迷吗？

blanks.en: I go to the stadium whenever there's a good game.
blanks.zh: 每逢有精彩的比赛，我都会去体育场。

blanks.en: And if I can't get a ticket, I watch the game on TV.
blanks.zh: 如果买不到票，我就在电视上看。

blanks.en: That way, they are less exciting, though.
blanks.zh: 不过，那样看就没那么激动人心了。

blanks.en: Is the ticket expensive?
blanks.zh: 门票贵吗？

blanks.en: It usually costs about $20 to $50.
blanks.zh: 通常大约二十到五十美元。

blanks.en: Last time, I paid $25.
blanks.zh: 上次我花了二十五美元。

blanks.en: That's not very expensive.
blanks.zh: 那不算很贵。

blanks.en: Maybe we can go together sometime.
blanks.zh: 也许哪天我们可以一起去。

blanks.en: It'll be more fun to watch a game with a friend.
blanks.zh: 和朋友一起看比赛会更有意思。

blanks.en: You were out the whole afternoon, Alex.
blanks.zh: 亚历克斯，你整个下午都不在。

blanks.en: I took a walk by myself.
blanks.zh: 我一个人去散步了。

blanks.en: You just kept walking and walking for four hours?
blanks.zh: 你就这样一直走了四个小时？

blanks.en: Actually, it's not so boring.
blanks.zh: 其实没有那么无聊。

blanks.en: Walking in the woods is a grand adventure.
blanks.zh: 在树林里漫步是一次很棒的探险。

blanks.en: Your feet can take you to the most amazing places.
blanks.zh: 你的双脚能带你去最神奇的地方。

blanks.en: What did you do in the woods?
blanks.zh: 你在树林里做了什么？

blanks.en: I smelled the flowers, looked at the birds, and yeah, I picked many tree leaves.
blanks.zh: 我闻了闻花香，看了看鸟，哦，对了，还捡了很多树叶。

blanks.en: I will make bookmarks with them.
blanks.zh: 我要用它们做书签。

blanks.en: Then I met Bob at the lake.
blanks.zh: 后来我在湖边碰到了鲍勃。

blanks.en: He was fishing while his kids were having a swim.
blanks.zh: 他在钓鱼，孩子们在游泳。

blanks.en: Did you talk to him?
blanks.zh: 你和他说话了吗？

blanks.en: I walked on and took a lot of pictures.
blanks.zh: 我继续往前走，拍了很多照片。

blanks.en: There's just so much out there to see.
blanks.zh: 外面真有太多值得看的东西了。

blanks.en: David, how was your holiday?
blanks.zh: 戴维，你的假期过得怎么样？

blanks.en: I climbed Mount Fuji.
blanks.zh: 我登上了富士山。

blanks.en: It was really beautiful.
blanks.zh: 那里真的很美。

blanks.en: Now I can check one more thing off my list.
blanks.zh: 现在我又能从清单上划掉一项了。

blanks.en: When I was twelve I made a list of things I wanted to do some day.
blanks.zh: 十二岁时，我列了一张清单，写下自己将来想做的事。

blanks.en: How many of the things on your list have you done so far?
blanks.zh: 到现在为止，你已经完成清单上的多少项了？

blanks.en: Would you like to see them?
blanks.zh: 你想看看吗？

blanks.en: Here I am on top of Mount Fuji, and here I am in a hot air balloon.
blanks.zh: 这张是我在富士山顶，这张是我乘坐热气球。

blanks.en: I've always wanted to go up in a hot air balloon.
blanks.zh: 我一直想坐着热气球升空。

blanks.en: What are your plans for the next holiday?
blanks.zh: 下次假期你有什么计划？

blanks.en: I'm thinking of deep-sea diving in Australia.
blanks.zh: 我在考虑去澳大利亚深海潜水。

blanks.en: Do you have any other suggestions?
blanks.zh: 你还有别的建议吗？

blanks.en: You really ought to take a boat down the Amazon.
blanks.zh: 你真的应该坐船沿着亚马孙河顺流而下。

blanks.en: You'll see a lot of interesting animals and beautiful trees.
blanks.zh: 你会看到许多有趣的动物和美丽的树木。

blanks.en: It's one of the best places I've been to.
blanks.zh: 那是我去过的最棒的地方之一。

blanks.en: Okay, I'll put it on my list.
blanks.zh: 好，我会把它写进清单。

blanks.en: Are you attending the conference tomorrow morning at the Shelton Hotel?
blanks.zh: 你明天上午会去谢尔顿酒店参加会议吗？

blanks.en: But when I arrived home five minutes ago, I found that my car wouldn't start, and John is in Brighton on business.
blanks.zh: 可是，五分钟前我到家时，发现车发动不起来了，而约翰正在布赖顿出差。

blanks.en: Do you know what's wrong with the car?
blanks.zh: 你知道车哪里出问题了吗？

blanks.en: I'm not exactly sure.
blanks.zh: 我还不太确定。

blanks.en: I think there's a problem with the engine.
blanks.zh: 我觉得发动机出了问题。

blanks.en: When shall I be at your place?
blanks.zh: 我什么时候到你家？

blanks.en: Well, what about eight o'clock?
blanks.zh: 嗯，八点怎么样？

blanks.en: From my place to Shelton we have to drive through the quarters.
blanks.zh: 从我家到谢尔顿，我们得开车穿过几个城区。

blanks.en: So we'd better leave early to avoid the traffic.
blanks.zh: 所以我们最好早点出发，避开交通拥堵。

blanks.en: It takes twenty minutes to reach your place, so I'll set off at seven forty.
blanks.zh: 到你家需要二十分钟，所以我会七点四十出发。

blanks.en: By the way, do you also need me to drive you home tomorrow afternoon?
blanks.zh: 对了，明天下午你还需要我开车送你回家吗？

blanks.en: No, John will be back then, and he'll get me home.
blanks.zh: 不用了，约翰那时就回来了，他会接我回家。

blanks.en: Today, I'll talk about how to improve your pronunciation.
blanks.zh: 今天，我来讲讲怎样改善发音。

blanks.en: Language researchers say pronunciation and fluency are the biggest barriers, followed by grammar, in effective spoken English.
blanks.zh: 语言研究者说，要有效地用英语口语交流，最大的障碍是发音和流利程度，其次是语法。

blanks.en: However, most people don't regard pronunciation as a very important part of communication skills.
blanks.zh: 然而，大多数人并不把发音看作沟通技能中很重要的一部分。

blanks.en: They're more focused on vocabulary.
blanks.zh: 他们更注重词汇。

blanks.en: One reason is that most people are not even aware of their mispronunciations.
blanks.zh: 一个原因是，大多数人甚至意识不到自己有哪些发音错误。

blanks.en: So, it's important to first find out the words you mispronounce.
blanks.zh: 所以，首先找出自己读错的词很重要。

blanks.en: You should listen to experts.
blanks.zh: 你应该听听专家怎么读。

blanks.en: By experts, I mean those who are less likely to make pronunciation mistakes.
blanks.zh: 我说的专家，是指那些不太可能犯发音错误的人。

blanks.en: When listening to them, pay attention to words that sound strange — strange because you pronounce the same words differently.
blanks.zh: 听他们说话时，要留意那些你听着觉得陌生的词；之所以陌生，是因为你自己读这些词时发音不一样。

blanks.en: When you come across such words, check a dictionary to confirm their exact pronunciations.
blanks.zh: 遇到这样的词时，查词典确认它们准确的读音。

blanks.en: You can also search for difficult-to-pronounce words and names and make a list of them.
blanks.zh: 你还可以搜索难读的单词和名字，把它们列成清单。

blanks.en: The last suggestion is to read aloud.
blanks.zh: 最后一个建议是大声朗读。

blanks.en: Now you've got the correct pronunciations of the words; it's time to practice reading them every day.
blanks.zh: 现在你已经知道这些词的正确读音，就该每天练习朗读了。

blanks.en: Please have a seat here.
blanks.zh: 请坐这里。

blanks.en: I've taken the pills as you instructed, but I still keep sneezing.
blanks.zh: 我按您嘱咐吃了药，但还是不停打喷嚏。

blanks.en: Jane was reported missing yesterday, but it turned out to be a false alarm.
blanks.zh: 昨天有人报告说简失踪了，但后来证实只是虚惊一场。

blanks.en: You can't imagine how worried I was yesterday.
blanks.zh: 你简直想象不到我昨天有多担心。

blanks.en: I never fancy you playing the violin so wonderfully.
blanks.zh: 没想到你小提琴拉得这么好。

blanks.en: This year's competition is just around the corner.
blanks.zh: 今年的比赛马上就要到了。

blanks.en: Don't you think the ticket is cheaper for this week's ballet show?
blanks.zh: 你不觉得这周芭蕾演出的票更便宜吗？

blanks.en: Cheaper? Maybe for you.
blanks.zh: 便宜？对你来说也许是吧。

blanks.en: The rhythm is slow and weird.
blanks.zh: 节奏又慢又怪。

blanks.en: Who on earth wrote it?
blanks.zh: 这到底是谁写的？

blanks.en: I'm in the dark as much as you are.
blanks.zh: 我和你一样，也是一头雾水。

blanks.en: What do you think of our most valuable player of this year?
blanks.zh: 你觉得我们今年的最有价值球员怎么样？

blanks.en: Every time I thought we would win, I was discouraged.
blanks.zh: 每次我以为我们能赢，结果都很泄气。

blanks.en: Is the position you mentioned last month still vacant?
blanks.zh: 你上个月说的那个职位还空着吗？

blanks.en: If only you had asked me yesterday.
blanks.zh: 你要是昨天问我就好了。

blanks.en: You always have bad timing.
blanks.zh: 你总是赶不上好时候。

blanks.en: I am taking a badminton class this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 我今天下午要去上羽毛球课。

blanks.en: Do you want to go with me?
blanks.zh: 你想和我一起去吗？

blanks.en: I need to do some exercise to lose weight.
blanks.zh: 我得做点运动减肥。

blanks.en: Wow, that's a big assignment we've got for the project.
blanks.zh: 哇，这个项目布置给我们的任务可真够大的。

blanks.en: It isn't due until next month.
blanks.zh: 下个月才到截止日期。

blanks.en: Excuse me, can you tell me how to get to the nearest Bank of China?
blanks.zh: 打扰一下，请问最近的中国银行怎么走？

blanks.en: It's over there, but it's open on weekdays only.
blanks.zh: 就在那边，但只在工作日营业。

blanks.en: You'd better go the day after tomorrow.
blanks.zh: 你最好后天去。

blanks.en: After each passage or conversation you will be asked several questions.
blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话之后，你会听到几个问题。

blanks.en: The passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
blanks.zh: 短文和对话会播放两遍，但问题只读一遍。

blanks.en: When you hear a question, read the four possible answers on your paper, and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
blanks.zh: 听到问题后，阅读试卷上的四个备选答案，选出你所听到的问题的最佳答案。

blanks.en: When you order a pizza online, it goes through quite a journey before arriving at your door from kitchen oven to warming counter to the back seat of a car.
blanks.zh: 你在网上订一份披萨后，它要经过一番辗转才能送到你家，从厨房烤箱到保温台，再到汽车后座。

blanks.en: That is why it can be only slightly warm by the time you take your first bite.
blanks.zh: 所以，当你吃第一口时，它可能只剩一点温热了。

blanks.en: A pizza house in New York has fixed that.
blanks.zh: 纽约一家披萨店解决了这个问题。

blanks.en: Its secret weapons are robots.
blanks.zh: 它的秘密武器是机器人。

blanks.en: After a customer places an online order, the request comes into its central kitchen at its headquarters.
blanks.zh: 顾客在网上下单后，订单会传到其总部的中央厨房。

blanks.en: There, robots and a few humans on staff start preparing the pizza.
blanks.zh: 在那里，机器人和几名工作人员开始制作披萨。

blanks.en: Each robot has a name and a duty, like spreading the sauce, or putting the pizzas into the oven.
blanks.zh: 每个机器人都有名字和职责，比如抹酱料，或把披萨放进烤箱。

blanks.en: Each pizza is baked first for ninety seconds in an eight hundred degree oven.
blanks.zh: 每份披萨先在800度的烤箱中烤90秒。

blanks.en: Then the half-baked pizza is loaded into one of the mobile ovens in the truck.
blanks.zh: 然后，半熟的披萨被放入货车上的一个移动烤箱中。

blanks.en: Another robot takes over the task of loading and reloading the pizza into the truck's oven.
blanks.zh: 另一个机器人接手把披萨装进、再装进货车烤箱的任务。

blanks.en: When the truck is four minutes away from its destination, the oven containing the order will turn on to finish cooking the pizza.
blanks.zh: 货车距离目的地还有四分钟时，装有这份订单的烤箱就会启动，把披萨彻底烤熟。

blanks.en: Thanks to the assistance of robots, delivery orders take an average of twenty minutes, ten minutes less than before.
blanks.zh: 有了机器人的帮助，外送订单平均只需二十分钟，比以前少十分钟。

blanks.en: The pizzas are hot when they reach you.
blanks.zh: 披萨送到你手里时还是热的。

blanks.en: What problem has the Pizza House in New York solved?
blanks.zh: 纽约这家披萨店解决了什么问题？

blanks.en: On average, how long did it take the Pizza House to deliver an order in the past?
blanks.zh: 过去，这家披萨店送一份订单平均要花多长时间？

blanks.en: What can we learn about the Pizza House?
blanks.zh: 关于这家披萨店，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.en: The next time you end up on the slowest moving queue at the supermarket, don't blame your bad luck anymore.
blanks.zh: 下次你在超市排进了移动最慢的队伍，别再怪自己运气差了。

blanks.en: According to queuing theorists, mathematicians who predict queue lengths and waiting times, you are not alone in such an unpleasant situation.
blanks.zh: 按照排队理论专家，也就是那些预测队伍长度和等待时间的数学家的说法，遇到这种不愉快情况的不只有你。

blanks.en: Queuing theory explains why there's probably no way you can always be in the fastest line.
blanks.zh: 排队理论解释了为什么你恐怕没法总排在最快的队伍里。

blanks.en: The explanation goes something like this.
blanks.zh: 解释大致是这样的。

blanks.en: A supermarket tries to have enough checkout counters open to get all their customers through with minimum delay.
blanks.zh: 超市会尽量开足收银台，让所有顾客尽可能少等一会儿就能结账。

blanks.en: Despite the well-trained workforce and ever-upgrading security systems, there are always going to be busy periods.
blanks.zh: 尽管员工训练有素，安保系统也不断升级，但总会有繁忙的时候。

blanks.en: Because supermarkets don't have the physical space to add more checkout lines during these busier times, their system becomes overloaded.
blanks.zh: 由于超市没有空间在繁忙时段增加收银通道，结账系统就会超负荷运转。

blanks.en: One small interruption, such as a price check or chatty customer, results in a chain of reactions to affect the entire line behind them.
blanks.zh: 一次小小的中断，比如核查价格，或遇上一位爱聊天的顾客，都会引起连锁反应，影响其后整条队伍。

blanks.en: If there are three lines at a store, these delays will happen randomly at different checkout counters.
blanks.zh: 如果商店有三条队伍，这些延误会随机出现在不同的收银台。

blanks.en: The chances of your line being the quickest are only one in three.
blanks.zh: 你的队伍最快的概率只有三分之一。

blanks.en: So you are not just imagining it.
blanks.zh: 所以，这并不是你的错觉。

blanks.en: Another line probably is moving faster than yours.
blanks.zh: 另一条队伍很可能确实比你的快。

blanks.en: Jake, I want to talk to you about our little brother George.
blanks.zh: 杰克，我想跟你谈谈我们的弟弟乔治。

blanks.en: What's the matter with him?
blanks.zh: 他怎么了？

blanks.en: I'm worried about him.
blanks.zh: 我很担心他。

blanks.en: He's been in low spirits for weeks.
blanks.zh: 他已经情绪低落好几个星期了。

blanks.en: He's changeable like the weather.
blanks.zh: 他的情绪就像天气一样多变。

blanks.en: Jake, he's our brother, and we are supposed to be there for him, aren't we?
blanks.zh: 杰克，他是我们的弟弟，我们应该在他身边支持他，不是吗？

blanks.en: But you know how independent he is.
blanks.zh: 但你知道他有多独立。

blanks.en: We can't help him if he doesn't want it, can we?
blanks.zh: 如果他不愿意，我们也帮不了他，对吧？

blanks.en: Well, I feel guilty.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我觉得内疚。

blanks.en: He is family, after all.
blanks.zh: 毕竟，他是我们的家人。

blanks.en: We mustn't ignore problems in the family, or they will just get bigger.
blanks.zh: 我们不能忽视家里的问题，否则问题只会越来越严重。

blanks.en: Do you want me to encourage him to consult a psychologist?
blanks.zh: 你想让我鼓励他去咨询心理专家吗？

blanks.en: No, you don't have to do that.
blanks.zh: 不，你不用那样做。

blanks.en: He coops all things inside.
blanks.zh: 他把所有心事都憋在心里。

blanks.en: Just talking will help him so much.
blanks.zh: 光是聊一聊就能对他有很大的帮助。

blanks.en: He's very unhappy about not getting the promotion he was promised.
blanks.zh: 他没得到答应给他的晋升机会，因此非常不开心。

blanks.en: We should get George to know every cloud has a silver lining.
blanks.zh: 我们应该让乔治知道，凡事总有好的一面。
blanks.answer: every cloud has a silver lining

blanks.en: Well, he can't get any better chance in his terrible apartment, can he?
blanks.zh: 嗯，他窝在那间糟糕的公寓里，是不可能获得更好机会的，对吧？

blanks.en: Watching baseball twenty four hours a day?
blanks.zh: 一天二十四小时看棒球？

blanks.en: Please, Jake, I hate to see George like that.
blanks.zh: 拜托，杰克，我不愿意看到乔治那个样子。

blanks.en: Do something next week.
blanks.zh: 下周做点什么吧。

blanks.en: You must get him out of that apartment.
blanks.zh: 你一定要让他走出那间公寓。

blanks.en: I hope you'll help me like this if the same thing happens to me.
blanks.zh: 如果同样的事发生在我身上，我希望你也能这样帮我。

blanks.en: Take a seat, please.
blanks.zh: 请坐。

blanks.en: I want to have my hair cut and dyed black today.
blanks.zh: 今天我想剪个头发，再染成黑色。

blanks.en: Where does the conversation most probably take place?
blanks.zh: 这段对话最有可能发生在哪里？

blanks.en: Excuse me, where is the dining hall?
blanks.zh: 打扰一下，食堂在哪里？

blanks.en: On the first floor of the dormitory building, but I'm afraid it's closed now.
blanks.zh: 在宿舍楼一楼，不过恐怕现在已经关门了。

blanks.en: Anyway, the coffee shop next to the library is still open.
blanks.zh: 不过，图书馆旁边的咖啡馆还开着。

blanks.en: Which place does the man imply the woman should go to?
blanks.zh: 男士暗示女士应该去哪个地方？

blanks.en: Did you see my passport?
blanks.zh: 你看到我的护照了吗？

blanks.en: I can't find it anywhere in my handbag.
blanks.zh: 我在手提包里怎么找都找不到。

blanks.en: I remember you used it yesterday to pay for those shoes with your credit card.
blanks.zh: 我记得你昨天用信用卡买那几双鞋时用过护照。

blanks.en: What is the woman looking for?
blanks.zh: 女士在找什么？

blanks.en: That's the best lecture I've ever been to.
blanks.zh: 那是我听过的最精彩的讲座。

blanks.en: I've really enjoyed it.
blanks.zh: 我真的很喜欢。

blanks.en: But you fell asleep right after it started.
blanks.zh: 可是讲座刚开始，你就睡着了。

blanks.en: What can we learn from the conversation?
blanks.zh: 从对话中我们可以得知什么？

blanks.en: Shall we go shopping or take some snacks?
blanks.zh: 我们去购物，还是吃点零食？

blanks.en: Whatever you decide is cool with me.
blanks.zh: 你怎么决定我都没意见。

blanks.en: What does the man mean?
blanks.zh: 男士是什么意思？

blanks.en: Look, page after page of advertisements.
blanks.zh: 看，一页接一页都是广告。

blanks.en: It's a waste of time reading them.
blanks.zh: 看这些广告纯粹是浪费时间。

blanks.en: Well, though some may cheat people into buying products, many are quite informative.
blanks.zh: 嗯，虽然有些广告可能诱骗消费者购买商品，但很多广告确实提供了有用的信息。

blanks.en: What is the woman's opinion of advertisements?
blanks.zh: 女士对广告有什么看法？

blanks.en: Hi Wang, welcome back.
blanks.zh: 嗨，小王，欢迎回来。

blanks.en: How was your training program in Shanghai?
blanks.zh: 你在上海参加的培训怎么样？

blanks.en: It was fruitful, although I didn't have much time to walk around as expected.
blanks.zh: 很有收获，不过没能像预想的那样有时间四处逛逛。

blanks.en: How does the man feel about his training program?
blanks.zh: 男士对自己的培训有什么感受？

blanks.en: Would you like to come round for dinner on my birthday?
blanks.zh: 我生日那天，你愿意来我家吃晚饭吗？

blanks.en: But for the school charity sale on that very day, I would come.
blanks.zh: 要不是学校义卖正好在那天，我就会去了。

blanks.en: What does the man mean?
blanks.zh: 男士是什么意思？

blanks.en: You kept coughing all night.
blanks.zh: 你咳嗽了一整夜。

blanks.en: Didn't you take the pills?
blanks.zh: 你没吃药吗？

blanks.en: I couldn't see the point.
blanks.zh: 我觉得吃药没什么用。

blanks.en: What does the man imply?
blanks.zh: 男士暗示了什么？

blanks.en: You were on the phone for an hour.
blanks.zh: 你打了一个小时的电话。

blanks.en: It was my mum.
blanks.zh: 是我妈妈打来的。

blanks.en: Rarely do we run out of conversation.
blanks.zh: 我们很少会没话聊。

blanks.en: What can we learn about the man?
blanks.zh: 关于男士，我们能了解到什么？

blanks.zh: 每篇短文或每段对话结束后，你需要回答几个问题。

blanks.zh: 短文和对话将播放两遍，问题只念一遍。

blanks.en: Every year in the US, about 133 million pounds of food goes to waste.
blanks.zh: 在美国，每年大约有一亿三千三百万磅的食物被浪费。

blanks.en: A lot of it is fruits and vegetables, like three-legged carrots and forked strawberries.
blanks.zh: 其中很多是水果和蔬菜，比如长着三条“腿”的胡萝卜和分叉的草莓。

blanks.en: They are deserted simply because they are not pretty enough to be displayed on store shelves.
blanks.zh: 它们被丢弃，只是因为外形不够漂亮，无法摆上商店的货架。

blanks.en: If you look at the big picture, about a third of the planet's food goes to waste for the same reason.
blanks.zh: 从整体来看，地球上大约三分之一的食物都是出于同样的原因而被浪费。

blanks.en: That's enough to feed 2 billion people.
blanks.zh: 这些食物足够养活二十亿人。

blanks.en: Now a company called Imperfect Me is trying to change that situation.
blanks.zh: 现在，一家名叫“不完美的我”的公司正试图改变这种状况。

blanks.en: The company collects ugly fruits and vegetables from farmers and markets and sells them to local residents at a deep discount.
blanks.zh: 这家公司从农民和市场那里收购外形不佳的果蔬，再以大幅优惠的价格卖给当地居民。

blanks.en: It can be 30 to 50% off the regular price.
blanks.zh: 价格可以比正常售价低百分之三十到五十。

blanks.en: Similar campaigns are underway in places like Boston, as well as Portugal and the UK.
blanks.zh: 波士顿，以及葡萄牙、英国等地，也在开展类似的行动。

blanks.en: For now, most chain supermarkets don't carry ugly fruits and vegetables.
blanks.zh: 目前，大多数连锁超市还不销售这些外形不佳的果蔬。

blanks.en: But Steve Clark of Imperfect Me hopes the supermarkets will come around because customers want such food.
blanks.zh: 但“不完美的我”公司的史蒂夫·克拉克希望超市能改变想法，因为顾客想要这样的食品。

blanks.en: He says it is really easy to convince people when they realize they can pay a lower price to get the same kind of taste and health.
blanks.zh: 他说，当人们意识到花更少的钱也能吃到同样美味、健康的食物时，就很容易说服他们了。

blanks.zh: 这篇短文主要讲什么？

blanks.en: A city in England has started an ambitious plan to plant as many as one million trees every year for the next decade.
blanks.zh: 英格兰的一座城市启动了一项雄心勃勃的计划，未来十年每年种植多达一百万棵树。

blanks.en: The project is called the City of Trees.
blanks.zh: 这个项目名叫“树木之城”。

blanks.en: Project director Tony Brown explained that the green venture has three main aims.
blanks.zh: 项目负责人托尼·布朗解释说，这项环保行动有三个主要目标。

blanks.en: He said, "One is to plant a tree for every man, woman, and child over the next decade."
blanks.zh: 他说：“第一个目标是在未来十年里，为每一位居民，包括大人和孩子，种一棵树。”

blanks.en: Next, we are very much focused on bringing existing woodland into management because it doesn't make any sense to plant new woodland if you can't manage what you've got already.
blanks.zh: 其次，我们非常注重把现有林地纳入管理，因为如果连已有的林地都管不好，再种新的林地也没有意义。

blanks.en: Finally, we want to engage people a lot more in their natural environment, that is, in planting trees, in managing areas.
blanks.zh: 最后，我们希望人们能更多地参与周围的自然环境事务，也就是参与植树和区域管理。

blanks.en: And in understanding more about the benefits that trees and woodlands bring to our society.
blanks.zh: 也更多地了解树木和林地为社会带来的好处。

blanks.en: Mr. Brown further outlined the reasons for the recently launched environmental project.
blanks.zh: 布朗先生进一步概述了最近发起这项环保项目的原因。

blanks.en: He said, "Our city wants to be a world-class region."
blanks.zh: 他说：“我们这座城市希望成为世界一流的地区。”

blanks.en: We have a lot of fantastic economic development going on, but the natural environment needs to keep up with that.
blanks.zh: 我们的经济发展势头非常好，但自然环境也需要跟上。

blanks.en: He believes the project will reconnect people with trees and the natural world.
blanks.zh: 他相信，这个项目将让人们重新亲近树木和自然。

blanks.en: Provide benefits to health and reduce stress.
blanks.zh: 还将有益健康，并减轻压力。

blanks.en: He said, "Woodlands can do great things in terms of air pollution reduction and can help to protect against noise pollution."
blanks.zh: 他说：“林地对减少空气污染大有帮助，还能帮助抵御噪声污染。”

blanks.en: They can also help cities and towns reduce the urban heat island effect and flooding.
blanks.zh: 它们还可以帮助城镇减轻城市热岛效应和洪涝灾害。

blanks.en: How can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮你的吗？

blanks.en: Uh, I think my car has been stolen.
blanks.zh: 呃，我想我的车被偷了。

blanks.en: Can you give me the details?
blanks.zh: 能告诉我具体情况吗？

blanks.en: It's a red minivan.
blanks.zh: 是一辆红色的小型客货车。

blanks.en: When and where did you last see it?
blanks.zh: 你最后一次见到它是什么时候，在哪里？

blanks.en: This morning I left it in front of number one classroom building.
blanks.zh: 今天早上，我把车停在了一号教学楼前面。

blanks.en: It appears your van was in the staff-only parking zone.
blanks.zh: 看来，你的车停在了教职工专用停车区。

blanks.en: I was a bit late for my class.
blanks.zh: 我当时上课有点迟到了。

blanks.en: I had to find a place so I could get to my classroom quickly.
blanks.zh: 我得赶紧找个地方停车，好快点赶到教室。

blanks.en: But since you shouldn't have left your car there, it was moved away.
blanks.zh: 但既然你本不该把车停在那里，车就被移走了。

blanks.en: Well, go to the campus traffic office.
blanks.zh: 嗯，去校园交通管理办公室。

blanks.en: That's opposite the administration building and on the left side of the stadium.
blanks.zh: 就在行政楼对面，体育场的左边。

blanks.en: Please bring your student card along.
blanks.zh: 请带上你的学生证。

blanks.en: Do I have to pay a fine?
blanks.zh: 我需要交罚款吗？

blanks.en: I'm sorry to say yes.
blanks.zh: 很遗憾，需要交。

blanks.en: There's a parking fine.
blanks.zh: 有一笔停车罚款。

blanks.en: And before taking your car, you also have to pay for the storage fee.
blanks.zh: 取车前，你还得付保管费。

blanks.en: Okay, how much will that be?
blanks.zh: 好吧，要多少钱？

blanks.en: The storage fee is $5 per day.
blanks.zh: 保管费每天五美元。

blanks.en: So you'd better pick up your car today, if possible.
blanks.zh: 所以，如果可以，你最好今天就把车取走。

blanks.en: The fine is $50, but if you pay within three days, the fine is reduced to $20.
blanks.zh: 罚款是五十美元，不过如果在三天内缴纳，就减为二十美元。

blanks.zh: 男士应该去哪里取回自己的车？

blanks.zh: 如果男士今天下午取车，总共要付多少钱？

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: Yes, I'd like to try this jacket on, please.
blanks.zh: 我想试穿一下这件夹克，谢谢。

blanks.en: The changing rooms are over there.
blanks.zh: 试衣间在那边。

blanks.en: Tom, your music is too loud.
blanks.zh: 汤姆，你的音乐声太大了。

blanks.en: Our band is practicing for the show, Mom.
blanks.zh: 妈妈，我们乐队在为演出排练。

blanks.en: But it's already the middle of the night.
blanks.zh: 可是已经半夜了。

blanks.en: Okay, we'll cut it off right away.
blanks.zh: 好吧，我们马上停下来。

blanks.en: You look pretty busy.
blanks.zh: 你看起来挺忙的。

blanks.en: We're putting together an office party this Friday evening.
blanks.zh: 我们在筹备这周五晚上的办公室聚会。

blanks.en: There'll be about thirty people, and I'm the organizer.
blanks.zh: 大约有三十个人参加，我是组织者。

blanks.en: But it's probably best not to overwork yourself.
blanks.zh: 不过，你最好还是别让自己太累。

blanks.en: Did you say you're going to take a vacation next week?
blanks.zh: 你刚才是不是说下周要去度假？

blanks.en: Actually, I'm leaving for San Francisco this weekend.
blanks.zh: 其实，我这周末就要去旧金山了。

blanks.en: But I can't get away until the end of August.
blanks.zh: 可我得到八月底才能抽身。

blanks.en: Donna, have you booked the flight to London for me?
blanks.zh: 唐娜，你帮我订好去伦敦的机票了吗？

blanks.en: Do you need a ride to the airport?
blanks.zh: 需要我开车送你去机场吗？

blanks.en: I will park my car at the airport.
blanks.zh: 我会把自己的车停在机场。

blanks.en: I'm afraid I'll be a little late tonight.
blanks.zh: 恐怕我今晚会晚一点到。

blanks.en: Remember I said earlier that I would pick you up at six?
blanks.zh: 记得我之前说六点去接你吗？

blanks.en: Now I'm going to meet you at about a quarter to seven, as there's been a problem here at work.
blanks.zh: 现在得改成大约六点四十五分见你，因为我工作上出了点问题。

blanks.en: The film begins at eight.
blanks.zh: 电影八点开始。

blanks.en: Get something to eat before I arrive, okay?
blanks.zh: 我到之前你先吃点东西，好吗？

blanks.en: I've decided to leave the company.
blanks.zh: 我决定离开公司了。

blanks.en: I had an amazing time here, but it is time for me to move on.
blanks.zh: 我在这里过得非常愉快，但现在该去寻求新的发展了。

blanks.en: Well, you know, I've got a new job in a big engineering firm.
blanks.zh: 嗯，你知道，我在一家大型工程公司找到了一份新工作。

blanks.en: It's a management position.
blanks.zh: 是个管理职位。

blanks.en: In that case, I think that I understand your decision and you have my support.
blanks.zh: 既然这样，我想我能理解你的决定，也支持你。

blanks.en: But I can work here two more weeks.
blanks.zh: 不过我可以在这里再工作两周。

blanks.en: Will you be able to finish your present project?
blanks.zh: 你能完成手头的项目吗？

blanks.en: And if you hire someone within ten days, I'd be happy to provide training in my areas.
blanks.zh: 如果你们能在十天内招到人，我很乐意就我负责的工作给新人做培训。

blanks.en: How are you feeling?
blanks.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样？

blanks.en: But you did so well to get second place in today's car race.
blanks.zh: 不过，你今天的汽车比赛拿了第二名，表现很好。

blanks.en: Well, I came out here aiming for the gold.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我来这里是冲着金牌来的。

blanks.en: I got third place last time and it was not the result I had hoped for.
blanks.zh: 我上次得了第三名，那并不是我原本期望的成绩。

blanks.en: You were looking extremely good at the start.
blanks.zh: 比赛刚开始时，你看起来表现非常好。

blanks.en: The car was a bit out of control.
blanks.zh: 车有点失控了。

blanks.en: Some people might have given up at that point.
blanks.zh: 有些人在那种时候可能就放弃了。

blanks.en: I was determined to do it to finish the round.
blanks.zh: 我当时下定决心要坚持下来，跑完这一轮。

blanks.en: Tomorrow's going to be tough, much tougher than today.
blanks.zh: 明天会很艰难，比今天艰难得多。

blanks.en: Well, I think you showed great determination today.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我觉得你今天表现出了很强的决心。

blanks.en: Good luck for tomorrow, and thanks for speaking to us.
blanks.zh: 祝你明天好运，也谢谢你接受我们的采访。

blanks.en: So what is your new apartment like, Terry?
blanks.zh: 特里，你的新公寓怎么样？

blanks.en: There are two bedrooms, a nice kitchen, and a living room.
blanks.zh: 有两间卧室、一间不错的厨房，还有一间客厅。

blanks.en: Yeah, and there is a grocery store next to the apartment building.
blanks.zh: 是啊，而且公寓楼旁边就有一家食品杂货店。

blanks.en: And there is a laundry and a fast food restaurant across the street, so it is a quick way to get a meal.
blanks.zh: 街对面还有一家洗衣店和一家快餐店，所以买点吃的很方便。

blanks.en: How much do you pay in rent?
blanks.zh: 你房租付多少？

blanks.en: Well, I have a roommate, so I pay half the rent.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我和别人合租，所以只付一半房租。

blanks.en: That is, two hundred and seventy-five dollars a month, with gas, water, and electricity included.
blanks.zh: 也就是每月二百七十五美元，包含燃气、水和电费。

blanks.en: And the Internet and satellite TV are separate.
blanks.zh: 网络和卫星电视的费用另算。

blanks.en: That's really a wonderful price.
blanks.zh: 这个价格真划算。

blanks.en: How on earth did you find a place like that?
blanks.zh: 你到底是怎么找到这么个地方的？

blanks.en: I just found it online.
blanks.zh: 我就是在网上找到的。

blanks.en: Hello, I'm Jeff Anderson from Coventry, England, and in today's programme I'd like to share with you a special kind of English culture: the football.
blanks.zh: 大家好，我是来自英格兰考文垂的杰夫·安德森，在今天的节目中，我想和大家分享一种独特的英国文化——足球。

blanks.en: A lot of people in England are crazy about football.
blanks.zh: 英格兰很多人都对足球十分着迷。

blanks.en: During the football season, whenever there is a big match, all the flags for local football teams, such as Liverpool and Newcastle, are hung outside every window, or even spread proudly on T-shirts or scarves.
blanks.zh: 足球赛季期间，每逢大赛，利物浦、纽卡斯尔等当地球队的旗帜就会挂满家家户户的窗外，甚至被骄傲地展示在T恤和围巾上。

blanks.en: There is an atmosphere of excitement in the air.
blanks.zh: 空气中洋溢着兴奋的气氛。

blanks.en: Groups of young men crowd into dark, packed pubs, staring at television screens.
blanks.zh: 一群群年轻男子挤进昏暗而拥挤的酒吧，紧盯着电视屏幕。

blanks.en: Of course they are covered head to toe in the colours of their team.
blanks.zh: 当然，他们从头到脚都穿戴着自己球队的代表色。

blanks.en: They shout and scream in sadness when their team loses a goal, or with joy when there is a moment of success.
blanks.zh: 球队失球时，他们悲伤地喊叫；球队取得成功时，他们则欢呼雀跃。

blanks.en: You do not have to be a fan of football to get caught up in the excitement.
blanks.zh: 你不必是球迷，也会被这种兴奋的气氛感染。

blanks.en: As far as victories are concerned, England had its big moment in nineteen sixty six in Wembley Stadium.
blanks.zh: 说到胜利，英格兰在一九六六年的温布利球场迎来了辉煌时刻。

blanks.en: The World Cup victory is in the hearts and minds of all football fans.
blanks.zh: 那次世界杯夺冠，是所有球迷心中难忘的记忆。

blanks.en: Now, whenever England is playing a big match, red and white covers every inch of every pub: a symbol of hope, the English flag.
blanks.zh: 如今，每当英格兰队参加大赛，红白两色就会覆盖每家酒吧的每一寸空间；那是希望的象征——英格兰旗。

blanks.en: While football has never been something I am particularly interested in, for years I've had to pretend excitement and pick a team to support.
blanks.zh: 虽然足球从来不是我特别感兴趣的事，但这些年来，我不得不装出兴奋的样子，选一支球队来支持。

blanks.en: You cannot say you don't like or do not follow football in England.
blanks.zh: 在英格兰，你不能说自己不喜欢足球或不关注足球。

blanks.en: As often this would lead to a long dialogue in which someone would begin telling you why you should support their team.
blanks.zh: 因为这往往会引出一场长谈，对方会开始告诉你为什么应该支持他们的球队。

blanks.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the nearest supermarket?
blanks.zh: 打扰一下，最近的超市怎么走？

blanks.en: Go past the post office, and it's on your left.
blanks.zh: 经过邮局后，它就在你左边。

blanks.en: I don't know how you did it, Carl, but the TV works beautifully now.
blanks.zh: 卡尔，我不知道你是怎么做到的，不过电视现在运行得好极了。

blanks.en: You should get a medal for your work.
blanks.zh: 你的这番劳动真该获一枚奖章。

blanks.en: It wasn't hard at all.
blanks.zh: 一点也不难。

blanks.en: It was much easier than preparing for the test.
blanks.zh: 这比准备考试容易多了。

blanks.en: What can I do for you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以为您效劳的吗？
blanks.answer: What can I do for you

blanks.en: Well, the sleeves of this jacket are too long.
blanks.zh: 嗯，这件夹克的袖子太长了。

blanks.en: Can you make them shorter?
blanks.zh: 您能把它们改短些吗？

blanks.en: Let me take a look.
blanks.zh: 让我看一看。

blanks.en: Okay, I can do it for twenty dollars.
blanks.zh: 好的，改一下收二十美元。

blanks.en: Excuse me, could you tell me what time Flight AF three five gets in?
blanks.zh: 打扰一下，您能告诉我AF三五航班什么时候到达吗？

blanks.en: Well, it's due in at six twenty PM, but the announcement said just now that it has a thirty-minute delay because of the bad weather.
blanks.zh: 嗯，原定下午六点二十分到，但刚才的广播说，由于天气恶劣，航班要延误三十分钟。

blanks.en: Miss Miller, could you tell me how I can improve this article?
blanks.zh: 米勒老师，您能告诉我怎样改进这篇文章吗？

blanks.en: I got a B plus.
blanks.zh: 我得了个B加。

blanks.en: It's quite good, actually.
blanks.zh: 其实已经相当不错了。

blanks.en: The language use is good and the main points are covered.
blanks.zh: 语言运用不错，要点也都写到了。

blanks.en: There's just too much repetition.
blanks.zh: 只是重复的内容太多了。

blanks.en: You could have said everything within two pages.
blanks.zh: 你本来用两页以内就能把所有内容说清楚。

blanks.en: So Bill, what do you usually do on the weekend?
blanks.zh: 比尔，你周末通常做什么？

blanks.en: I often go to the movies with friends on Friday night.
blanks.zh: 星期五晚上，我常和朋友去看电影。

blanks.en: How about you, Sarah?
blanks.zh: 萨拉，你呢？

blanks.en: Well, I love seeing musical plays on Broadway with my friends.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我喜欢和朋友到百老汇看音乐剧。

blanks.en: I saw one when I moved to New York, and another when my parents came to visit, but none ever since.
blanks.zh: 我搬到纽约时看过一部，父母来探望时又看过一部，但那以后就再也没看过了。

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: Could I speak to Mike please?
blanks.zh: 请问我能和迈克通话吗？

blanks.en: I'm afraid he's not available at the moment.
blanks.zh: 恐怕他现在没空接电话。

blanks.en: Would you leave a message?
blanks.zh: 您要留个口信吗？

blanks.en: Yes, I'm calling to cancel a meeting we scheduled for this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 好的，我打电话是想取消我们原定今天下午开的会。

blanks.en: Could I have your name again?
blanks.zh: 能请您再说一遍姓名吗？

blanks.en: Can I help you, sir?
blanks.zh: 先生，有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'd like to buy a camera.
blanks.zh: 我想买一台摄像机。

blanks.en: We have ordinary cameras, movie cameras, and video cameras.
blanks.zh: 我们有普通照相机、电影摄影机和摄像机。

blanks.en: They are all digital.
blanks.zh: 它们都是数码的。

blanks.en: Well, I am thinking of a video camera.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我考虑买一台摄像机。

blanks.en: How much do you want to spend, sir?
blanks.zh: 先生，您打算花多少钱？

blanks.en: Oh, I'm not really sure.
blanks.zh: 哦，我还不太确定。

blanks.en: What is the price?
blanks.zh: 价格是多少？

blanks.en: Well, that depends on the model and anything else you want to have with it.
blanks.zh: 嗯，那取决于型号，以及您想另外配些什么。

blanks.en: How about this one?
blanks.zh: 这一款怎么样？

blanks.en: It has one of the new memory sticks and a protective case for filming under water so you can take it when you go diving.
blanks.zh: 它配有一根新款存储棒，还有一个供水下拍摄用的保护套，因此潜水时也可以带着它。

blanks.en: Does it have autofocus?
blanks.zh: 它有自动对焦功能吗？

blanks.en: The underwater filming is important for me, actually.
blanks.zh: 其实，水下拍摄对我来说很重要。

blanks.en: How much is this?
blanks.zh: 这一款多少钱？

blanks.en: It costs six hundred and fifty euros.
blanks.zh: 六百五十欧元。

blanks.en: Oh, that's a bit expensive for me.
blanks.zh: 哦，对我来说有点贵。

blanks.en: Have you got anything similar but less expensive?
blanks.zh: 你们有类似但便宜些的吗？

blanks.en: Well, here's the sale of the week.
blanks.zh: 嗯，这是本周的特价商品。

blanks.en: It's excellent for the price.
blanks.zh: 以这个价格来说，它很不错。

blanks.en: Only four hundred and seventy euros, and it includes…
blanks.zh: 只要四百七十欧元，而且还包括……

blanks.en: A big dog celebrates a big birthday this year.
blanks.zh: 今年，一只大狗要过一个意义重大的生日。

blanks.en: Clifford, the big red dog, first appeared fifty years ago, along with Emily Elizabeth, the little girl who loves him.
blanks.zh: 大红狗克利福德五十年前首次亮相，一同出现的还有爱着它的小女孩埃米莉·伊丽莎白。

blanks.en: Today we have Norman Bridwell to talk with NPR's reporter on his dog's fiftieth birthday.
blanks.zh: 今天，在这只大狗五十岁生日之际，我们请来诺曼·布里德韦尔，与美国全国公共广播电台的记者交谈。

blanks.en: So, Norman, tell us how it all started.
blanks.zh: 那么，诺曼，给我们讲讲这一切是怎么开始的。

blanks.en: Well, it was nineteen sixty two, and I was a struggling, not very successful artist in New York.
blanks.zh: 嗯，那是一九六二年，我当时是纽约一名苦苦谋生、并不怎么成功的画家。

blanks.en: My wife suggested that I try my hand at painting for children's books.
blanks.zh: 我妻子建议我尝试为儿童图书画插画。

blanks.en: So I did ten paintings and took them to publishers.
blanks.zh: 于是我画了十幅画，拿去给出版商看。

blanks.en: I was turned down everywhere, except at one publisher, where a young woman told me I wasn't very good, so, if I wanted to paint for a book, I'd need to write one on my own.
blanks.zh: 除了有一家以外，其他出版商全拒绝了我；在那家出版社，一位年轻女士对我说，我画得不够好，所以要想给书画插画，就得自己写一本。

blanks.en: Um, the woman pointed to a painting I'd done of a little girl with a big red dog, and she said, “Maybe that's a story.”
blanks.zh: 嗯，那位女士指着我画的一幅小女孩和一只大红狗的画，说：“也许这就是一个故事。”

blanks.en: And I went home, and over that weekend I wrote the story Clifford the Big Red Dog.
blanks.zh: 于是我回了家，就在那个周末写出了《大红狗克利福德》这个故事。

blanks.en: And was shocked when it was accepted for publication, because I'd never written anything before.
blanks.zh: 这部作品被接受出版时，我震惊了，因为我以前从没写过任何东西。

blanks.en: How wonderful! Yes, it was.
blanks.zh: 太棒了！是啊，确实如此。

blanks.en: My wife was also in shock when she did realize it wasn't a dream.
blanks.zh: 我妻子也很震惊，那时她才真切地意识到这并不是梦。

blanks.en: But it was just luck.
blanks.zh: 但那只是运气。

blanks.en: But that luck turned into ninety Clifford books that have sold one hundred and twenty six million copies in thirteen languages.
blanks.zh: 但这份运气最终成就了九十本克利福德图书，被译成十三种语言，售出一亿两千六百万册。

blanks.en: But that luck turned into 90 Clifford books that have sold 126 million copies in 13 languages.

blanks.en: Hello, everyone. Today I am going to talk about small talk, that is, short conversations people often have with strangers they meet.
blanks.zh: 大家好，今天我要谈谈闲聊，也就是人们与遇到的陌生人之间常有的简短交谈。

blanks.en: Such exchanges occur at bus stops, on buses, while waiting in line, almost anywhere that strangers gather close together.
blanks.zh: 这样的交谈会发生在公交车站、公交车上、排队等候时，几乎任何陌生人聚在一起的地方都会有。

blanks.en: As a matter of fact, these short conversations are a good way for people to say hello and express friendliness.
blanks.zh: 事实上，这些简短的交谈是人们打招呼、表达友好的好方式。

blanks.en: Such conversations usually cover a wide range of topics.
blanks.zh: 这类交谈通常涉及广泛的话题。

blanks.en: The topics may include weather, customer service, movies, TV shows, local sports, or latest news.
blanks.zh: 话题可能包括天气、客户服务、电影、电视节目、当地体育活动或最新新闻。

blanks.en: But you should always keep it in your mind that private questions about salaries, family life, religious beliefs, and politics should be avoided during these conversations.
blanks.zh: 但你应始终记住，在这些交谈中应避免谈论薪水、家庭生活、宗教信仰和政治等私人问题。

blanks.en: Besides, it's better to ask open-ended questions.
blanks.zh: 此外，最好问开放式问题。

blanks.en: If you ask visitors, “Do you like our city?”
blanks.zh: 如果你问来访者：“你喜欢我们这座城市吗？”

blanks.en: They may say simply, “Yes.”
blanks.zh: 他们可能只会回答：“喜欢。”

blanks.en: On the other hand, if you ask, “What do you think of our city?”
blanks.zh: 另一方面，如果你问：“你觉得我们这座城市怎么样？”

blanks.en: they will have more freedom in answering.
blanks.zh: 他们回答时就会有更大的自由。

blanks.en: This type of question also shows that you are interested in them.
blanks.zh: 这类问题也表明你对他们感兴趣。

blanks.en: If you appear interested in what people are saying, they feel more comfortable talking with you.
blanks.zh: 如果你对别人所说的内容表现出兴趣，他们和你交谈时就会感到更自在。

blanks.zh: 打扰一下，最近的超市怎么走？

blanks.en: Go past the post office, and it's on your left.
blanks.zh: 经过邮局后，它就在你左边。

blanks.zh: 其实已经相当不错了。

blanks.zh: 语言运用不错，要点也都写到了。

blanks.en: There's just too much repetition.
blanks.zh: 只是重复的内容太多了。

blanks.en: You could have said everything within two pages.
blanks.zh: 你本来用两页以内就能把所有内容说清楚。

blanks.en: So Bill, what do you usually do on the weekend?
blanks.zh: 比尔，你周末通常做什么？

blanks.en: I often go to the movies with friends on Friday night.
blanks.zh: 星期五晚上，我常和朋友去看电影。

blanks.en: How about you, Sarah?
blanks.zh: 萨拉，你呢？

blanks.en: Well, I love seeing musical plays on Broadway with my friends.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我喜欢和朋友到百老汇看音乐剧。

blanks.en: I saw one when I moved to New York, and another when my parents came to visit, but none ever since.
blanks.zh: 我搬到纽约时看过一部，父母来探望时又看过一部，但那以后就再也没看过了。

blanks.en: Can I help you?
blanks.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: Could I speak to Mike please?
blanks.zh: 请问我能和迈克通话吗？

blanks.en: I'm afraid he's not available at the moment.
blanks.zh: 恐怕他现在没空接电话。

blanks.en: Would you leave a message?
blanks.zh: 您要留个口信吗？

blanks.en: Yes, I'm calling to cancel a meeting we scheduled for this afternoon.
blanks.zh: 好的，我打电话是想取消我们原定今天下午开的会。

blanks.en: Could I have your name again?
blanks.zh: 能请您再说一遍姓名吗？

blanks.en: Can I help you, sir?
blanks.zh: 先生，有什么可以帮您的吗？

blanks.en: I'd like to buy a camera.
blanks.zh: 我想买一台摄像机。

blanks.en: We have ordinary cameras, movie cameras, and video cameras.
blanks.zh: 我们有普通照相机、电影摄影机和摄像机。

blanks.en: They are all digital.
blanks.zh: 它们都是数码的。

blanks.en: Well, I am thinking of a video camera.
blanks.zh: 嗯，我考虑买一台摄像机。

blanks.en: How much do you want to spend, sir?
blanks.zh: 先生，您打算花多少钱？

blanks.en: Oh, I'm not really sure.
blanks.zh: 哦，我还不太确定。

blanks.en: What is the price?
blanks.zh: 价格是多少？

blanks.en: Well, that depends on the model and anything else you want to have with it.
blanks.zh: 嗯，那取决于型号，以及您想另外配些什么。

blanks.en: How about this one?
blanks.zh: 这一款怎么样？

blanks.en: It has one of the new memory sticks and a protective case for filming under water so you can take it when you go diving.
blanks.zh: 它配有一根新款存储棒，还有一个供水下拍摄用的保护套，因此潜水时也可以带着它。

blanks.en: Does it have autofocus?
blanks.zh: 它有自动对焦功能吗？

blanks.en: The underwater filming is important for me, actually.
blanks.zh: 其实，水下拍摄对我来说很重要。

blanks.en: How much is this?
blanks.zh: 这一款多少钱？

blanks.en: It costs six hundred and fifty euros.
blanks.zh: 六百五十欧元。

blanks.en: Oh, that's a bit expensive for me.
blanks.zh: 哦，对我来说有点贵。

blanks.en: Have you got anything similar but less expensive?
blanks.zh: 你们有类似但便宜些的吗？

blanks.en: Well, here's the sale of the week.
blanks.zh: 嗯，这是本周的特价商品。

blanks.en: It's excellent for the price.
blanks.zh: 以这个价格来说，它很不错。

blanks.en: Only four hundred and seventy euros, and it includes…
blanks.zh: 只要四百七十欧元，而且还包括……

blanks.en: A big dog celebrates a big birthday this year.
blanks.zh: 今年，一只大狗要过一个意义重大的生日。

blanks.en: Clifford, the big red dog, first appeared fifty years ago, along with Emily Elizabeth, the little girl who loves him.
blanks.zh: 大红狗克利福德五十年前首次亮相，一同出现的还有爱着它的小女孩埃米莉·伊丽莎白。

blanks.en: Today we have Norman Bridwell to talk with NPR's reporter on his dog's fiftieth birthday.
blanks.zh: 今天，在这只大狗五十岁生日之际，我们请来诺曼·布里德韦尔，与美国全国公共广播电台的记者交谈。

blanks.en: So, Norman, tell us how it all started.
blanks.zh: 那么，诺曼，给我们讲讲这一切是怎么开始的。

blanks.en: Well, it was nineteen sixty two, and I was a struggling, not very successful artist in New York.
blanks.zh: 嗯，那是一九六二年，我当时是纽约一名苦苦谋生、并不怎么成功的画家。

blanks.en: My wife suggested that I try my hand at painting for children's books.
blanks.zh: 我妻子建议我尝试为儿童图书画插画。

blanks.en: So I did ten paintings and took them to publishers.
blanks.zh: 于是我画了十幅画，拿去给出版商看。

blanks.en: I was turned down everywhere, except at one publisher, where a young woman told me I wasn't very good, so, if I wanted to paint for a book, I'd need to write one on my own.
blanks.zh: 除了有一家以外，其他出版商全拒绝了我；在那家出版社，一位年轻女士对我说，我画得不够好，所以要想给书画插画，就得自己写一本。

blanks.en: Um, the woman pointed to a painting I'd done of a little girl with a big red dog, and she said, “Maybe that's a story.”
blanks.zh: 嗯，那位女士指着我画的一幅小女孩和一只大红狗的画，说：“也许这就是一个故事。”

blanks.en: And I went home, and over that weekend I wrote the story Clifford the Big Red Dog.
blanks.zh: 于是我回了家，就在那个周末写出了《大红狗克利福德》这个故事。

blanks.en: And was shocked when it was accepted for publication, because I'd never written anything before.
blanks.zh: 这部作品被接受出版时，我震惊了，因为我以前从没写过任何东西。

blanks.en: How wonderful! Yes, it was.
blanks.zh: 太棒了！是啊，确实如此。

blanks.en: My wife was also in shock when she did realize it wasn't a dream.
blanks.zh: 我妻子也很震惊，那时她才真切地意识到这并不是梦。

blanks.en: But it was just luck.
blanks.zh: 但那只是运气。

blanks.en: But that luck turned into ninety Clifford books that have sold one hundred and twenty six million copies in thirteen languages.
blanks.zh: 但这份运气最终成就了九十本克利福德图书，被译成十三种语言，售出一亿两千六百万册。

blanks.zh: 今年，一只大狗要过一个意义重大的生日。

blanks.en: Clifford, the big red dog, first appeared fifty years ago, along with Emily Elizabeth, the little girl who loves him.
blanks.zh: 大红狗克利福德五十年前首次亮相，一同出现的还有爱着它的小女孩埃米莉·伊丽莎白。
